name: GRE
source: GRE 紅寶書單詞（僅英文，依原書順序）+ ECDICT 完整釋義 + word-atlas 例句

tr: vt. 降低...的地位, 降低...的品格, 貶抑, 使謙卑
def: v cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of

tr: vt. 使不安, 使羞愧, 使困窘
def: v cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious

tr: vt. 減少, 減輕, 減弱, 廢除, 打折扣
vi. 減輕, 減弱, 減少, 失效, 被廢除
def: v. become less in amount or intensity

tr: n. 減少, 減輕, 緩和, 折扣, 撤消, 中止
[化] 廢料; 失效
def: n. the act of abating

tr: vt. 縮寫, 使...簡略, 縮短
vi. 使用縮寫詞
def: v. shorten

tr: vt. 正式放棄
vi. 退位, 退出, 辭職
def: v. give up, such as power, as of monarchs and emperors, or duties and obligations

tr: a. 偏離正路的, 偏離常軌的, 畸變的
[化] 異常的
def: n. one whose behavior departs substantially from the norm of a group
s. markedly different from an accepted norm

tr: vt. 教唆, 煽動, 慫恿, 幫助, 支持
def: v. assist or encourage, usually in some wrongdoing

tr: n. 中止, 暫擱, 停止, 歸屬待定
[化] 潛態
def: n. temporary cessation or suspension

tr: vt. 憎惡, 痛恨, 迴避, 拒絕
def: v. find repugnant

tr: a. 令人憎恨的, 可惡的, 厭惡的, 相牴觸的, 不一致的
def: s. offensive to the mind

tr: a. 絕望無助的, 可憐的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的
[法] 卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可憐的
def: s. of the most contemptible kind
s. most unfortunate or miserable
s. showing utter resignation or hopelessness

tr: vt. 發誓斷絕, 公開放棄
[法] 誓絕, 棄絕, 公開放棄
def: v. formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure

tr: a. 著火的, 閃亮的, 激昂的
adv. 著火, 閃耀
def: s. keenly excited (especially sexually) or indicating excitement
s. lighted up by or as by fire or flame
s. resembling flame in brilliance or color

tr: vt. 放棄, 捨棄, 剋制(慾望)
def: v. surrender (power or a position)
v. deny or renounce

tr: vt. 廢止, 革除, 消滅
[經] 廢除, 取消, 裁撤
廢除；取消
def: v. do away with
to officially end a law, system, or established practice

ex.en: Our library has abolished fines for returning books late.
ex.zh: 我們的圖書館已經取消了逾期還書罰款。

ex.en: Some economists argue that governments should abolish subsidies that encourage excessive consumption of fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 一些經濟學家主張，政府應廢除鼓勵過度消耗化石燃料的補貼。

col: abolish a tax｜取消某項稅收
words.tip: 常接法律、制度或慣例，不用於取消普通預約。

tr: n. 廢除, 廢奴運動
[醫] 禁止, 消失
def: n. the act of abolishing a system or practice or institution (especially abolishing slavery)

tr: vt. 厭惡, 憎惡
def: v find repugnant

tr: a. 流產的, 墮胎的, 失敗的
[醫] 流產的; 頓挫的
def: s. failing to accomplish an intended result

tr: vi. 大量存在, 富於, 充滿
大量存在；充滿
def: v. be abundant or plentiful; exist in large quantities
v. be in a state of movement or action
To exist in large quantities or be very common

ex.en: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我們屋後的田野裡都開滿野花。

ex.en: Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
ex.zh: 在日照穩定且沿海風力強勁的地區，可再生能源的發展機會十分豐富。

col: abound in wildlife｜野生動物豐富
words.tip: 不及物動詞；某地充滿某物用abound in/with。

tr: adv. 光明正大地, 率直地
a. 光明正大的, 率直的
def: s. without concealment or deception; honest

tr: vt. 擦傷, 磨損, 磨
[醫] 擦除, 擦破; 磨損, 磨除
def: v. wear away

tr: n. 研磨料
a. 有研磨作用的
def: n. a substance that abrades or wears down
s. causing abrasion

tr: adv. 並肩地, 並列地
def: s. being up to particular standard or level especially in being up to date in knowledge
r. alongside each other, facing in the same direction

tr: vt. 縮短, 刪節, 減少, 剝奪
[法] 剝奪; 節略
刪節；節略
def: v. reduce in scope while retaining essential elements
v. lessen, diminish, or curtail
To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

ex.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社為較年幼的讀者推出了這部小說的刪節版。

ex.en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
ex.zh: 出版社經常刪節經典小說，使閱讀經驗有限的學生更容易讀懂。

words.tip: 刪去部分內容但保留主幹，不等同於寫摘要。

tr: vt. 廢除, 取消
[經] 取消, 廢除, 不生效(的法令)
正式廢除；撤銷
def: v. revoke formally
To officially end a law, agreement, or established right.

ex.en: The council voted to abrogate the outdated parking regulation.
ex.zh: 議會投票決定廢除那項過時的停車規定。

ex.en: Governments should not abrogate international agreements without carefully considering the consequences for regional stability and public trust.
ex.zh: 政府不應在未認真考慮對地區穩定和公眾信任的影響時廢止國際協議。

words.tip: 正式用語，常以法律、條約或協議作賓語。

tr: a. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不連貫的
突然的；意外的
生硬的；唐突的
def: s. marked by sudden changes in subject and sharp transitions
s. exceedingly sudden and unexpected
s. extremely steep

ex.en: The bus came to an abrupt stop outside our house.
ex.zh: 公交車在我們家門外突然停了下來。

ex.en: Abrupt changes in government policy can create uncertainty for businesses and discourage long-term investment.
ex.zh: 政府政策的突然變化可能給企業帶來不確定性，並抑制長期投資。

words.tip: 形容變化指“突然的”；形容語氣或態度指“生硬的”。

tr: vi. 潛逃, 逃匿
[經] (為躲避罪責,債務等)潛逃
def: v. run away; usually includes taking something or somebody along

tr: a. 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不經心的
vt. 使缺席
缺席的；不在的
缺少的；不存在的
def: v. go away or leave
a. not being in a specified place
s. lost in thought; showing preoccupation

ex.en: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
ex.zh: 莉娜因身體不適沒有來上課。

ex.en: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 經常缺課的學生可能需要額外幫助，才能跟上同學的學習進度。

words.tip: 表示缺席某場合用absent from，不用absent in。

tr: vt. 宣告...無罪, 赦免, 免除
[經] 免償(債務), 解除
def: v. let off the hook

tr: vi. 自制, 戒絕, 棄權, 迴避
def: v. refrain from voting
v. choose not to consume

tr: a. 有節制的, 節約的
def: a. sparing in consumption of especially food and drink
s. marked by temperance in indulgence

tr: n. 戒絕, 迴避, 棄權
def: n the trait of abstaining (especially from alcohol)

tr: a. 抽象的, 深奧的
n. 摘要, 抽象概念
vt. 摘要, 提煉, 使抽象化
[計] 摘錄; 摘要; 抽象
抽象的
def: v. consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically
v. consider apart from a particular case or instance
v. give an abstract (of)

ex.en: She uses toys to explain abstract ideas to children.
ex.zh: 她用玩具向孩子們解釋抽象概念。

ex.en: Reading the abstract helps researchers decide whether a study is relevant to their own work.
ex.zh: 閱讀摘要有助於研究人員判斷一項研究是否與自己的工作相關。

words.tip: 形容詞和名詞重音在首音節；動詞重音在後。

tr: a. 難解的, 深奧的
def: s. difficult to penetrate; incomprehensible to one of ordinary understanding or knowledge

tr: a. 荒謬的, 不合理的, 可笑的
n. 荒誕
荒謬的；不合理的
def: n. a situation in which life seems irrational and meaningless
s. inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense
s. incongruous; inviting ridicule

ex.en: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
ex.zh: 商店這麼近還要開車去，似乎太不合理了。

ex.en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
ex.zh: 不提高服務質量或降低出行成本，卻指望公共交通使用量增加，這是不合理的。

words.tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

tr: n. 濫用, 虐待, 惡習, 辱罵
vt. 濫用, 辱罵, 虐待
def: n. a rude expression intended to offend or hurt
v. use foul or abusive language towards
v. use wrongly or improperly or excessively

tr: a. 惡言謾罵的, 被濫用的, 腐敗的, 虐待的
def: s. expressing offensive reproach
s. characterized by physical or psychological maltreatment

tr: v. 鄰接, 毗鄰
def: v lie adjacent to another or share a boundary

tr: a. 深不可測的, 無底的
def: s. very great; limitless
s. resembling an abyss in depth; so deep as to be unmeasurable

tr: a. 學院的, 學術的, 不切實際的
n. 大學生, 大學教師, 學者, 學會會員
學業的；學術的
大學教師；學者
純理論的；無實際意義的
def: a. associated with academia or an academy
s. hypothetical or theoretical and not expected to produce an immediate or practical result
s. marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects

ex.en: The school praised her academic progress this year.
ex.zh: 學校表揚了她今年在學業上的進步。

ex.en: Universities should support students' emotional wellbeing rather than focusing exclusively on academic achievement and examination results.
ex.zh: 大學應關注學生的心理健康，而不是隻重視學業成就和考試成績。

words.tip: 作名詞指大學教師或研究者，通常不指大學生。

tr: a. [植]不結果的,無果實的
def: s producing no fruit

tr: vi. 同意, 正式加入, 就任, 繼任
同意；應允
就任；即位
def: v. take on duties or office
to formally agree to a request, demand, or proposal
to take an important official position, especially as a ruler

ex.en: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
ex.zh: 房東終於答應了我們提出的維修要求。

ex.en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
ex.zh: 當公眾對國家機構的信任下降時，政府可能會同意提高透明度的要求。

col: accede to a request｜答應請求
words.tip: 正式用語，通常接to；勿與exceed（超過）混淆。

tr: v. 加速, 促進
加速；使加快
def: v. move faster
v. cause to move faster
to move faster or make something happen more quickly

ex.en: The bus accelerated as it left the village.
ex.zh: 公共汽車駛離村莊時加快了速度。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can accelerate the transition towards cleaner and more efficient urban travel.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通可以加快向更清潔、更高效的城市出行方式轉型。

words.tip: 既可指車輛加速，也可指進程加快；可及物或不及物。

tr: vt. 以重音念, 強調, 重讀
def: v to stress, single out as important
v put stress on; utter with an accent

tr: a. 易接近的, 可進入的, 可使用的, 易受影響的, 可理解的
可進入的；可使用的
易懂的
def: a. capable of being reached
s. capable of being read with comprehension
s. easily obtained

ex.en: The garden is accessible through a small wooden gate.
ex.zh: 穿過一扇小木門就能進入花園。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide digital resources that are accessible to users with a wide range of abilities.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館應提供各種能力水平的用戶都能使用的數字資源。

col: accessible to everyone｜人人可使用的
words.tip: 常用accessible to sb；易懂的內容也可用此詞。

tr: n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 從犯, 同謀
a. 附屬的, 補充的, 同謀的, 幫兇的, 非主要的, 副的
[計] 附件
配件；附件
服飾配件
def: n. clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing
n. a supplementary component that improves capability
n. someone who helps another person commit a crime

ex.en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
ex.zh: 這個小巧的相機配件能讓我拍照時保持穩定。

ex.en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
ex.zh: 消費者常常在沒有必要的情況下更換電子配件，增加了廢棄物和全球對原材料的需求。

col: an accessory to a crime｜犯罪的從犯
words.tip: 配件常用複數accessories；從犯後常接to。

tr: a. 意外的, 偶然的, 非主要的, 附屬的
n. 臨時記號, 次要方面
def: n. a musical notation that makes a note sharp or flat or natural although that is not part of the key signature
s. happening by chance or unexpectedly or unintentionally

tr: n. 喝彩, 歡呼, 贊同
v. 歡呼, 喝彩, 稱讚
公開讚譽；高度評價
公開稱讚；高度讚揚
def: n. enthusiastic approval
v. praise vociferously
strong public praise for someone or something

ex.en: Her first film won acclaim at the local festival.
ex.zh: 她的首部電影在當地電影節上贏得了讚譽。

ex.en: The new public library has received widespread acclaim for its accessible design and sustainable construction.
ex.zh: 這座新公共圖書館因其無障礙設計和可持續建築方式而廣受讚譽。

words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；動詞常用be acclaimed as被譽為。

tr: vt. 使適應, 使服水土
vi. 服水土, 適應新環境
def: v get used to a certain climate

tr: n. 榮譽, 讚美, 騎士爵位的授予禮, 連譜號
def: n a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction

tr: vt. 陪伴, 伴隨, 補充, 為...伴奏
vi. 伴奏, 伴唱
陪同；陪伴
伴隨；與……同時發生
為……伴奏
def: v. go or travel along with
Go somewhere with someone.
Exist or happen together with something else.

ex.en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天姐姐會陪我去診所。

ex.en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 城市擴張應配合公共交通投資，以防止交通擁堵並改善就業可達性。

col: accompany on the piano｜用鋼琴伴奏
words.tip: 直接接人作賓語，不說accompany with someone。

tr: n. 共犯, 同謀
[醫] 協同菌
def: n. a person who joins with another in carrying out some plan (especially an unethical or illegal plan)

tr: vt. 完成, 達到, 實現, 使完美
完成；實現
def: v put in effect
v to gain with effort
to successfully finish something or achieve a goal

ex.en: We accomplished everything before the guests arrived for dinner.
ex.zh: 客人來吃晚飯前，我們把所有事情都辦好了。

ex.en: Students can accomplish more when teachers provide clear goals and regular feedback on their progress.
ex.zh: 教師提供明確目標並定期反饋學習進展時，學生能取得更多成果。

col: accomplish a great deal｜取得很大成果
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接任務或目標，不接不定式。

tr: a. 完成的, 實現的, 有造詣的, 熟練的, 善社交的
def: s. highly skilled
s. successfully completed or brought to an end
s. settled securely and unconditionally

tr: vt. 信託, 確認, 歸結於, 委派
[經] 發行信用證, 信託, 委託
def: v. grant credentials to
v. provide or send (envoys or embassadors) with official credentials
v. ascribe an achievement to

tr: vi. 連生, 合生, 附依
vt. 使依附, 使連接
a. 合生的
def: v. grow together (of plants and organs)
v. grow or become attached by accretion

tr: vi. 自然增加, 產生
[經] 應計, 產生, 出現
逐漸積累；逐漸獲得
def: v. grow by addition
v. come into the possession of
To increase gradually, or receive benefits over time

ex.en: Interest accrues monthly on the money in this account.
ex.zh: 這個賬戶裡的錢每月都會產生利息。

ex.en: The benefits of early education accrue over many years, improving both individual opportunities and wider social outcomes.
ex.zh: 早期教育的益處會多年累積，既改善個人發展機會，也帶來更廣泛的社會效益。

words.tip: 常用於利息、收益等逐漸累積；accrue to表示歸於。

tr: v. 積聚, 堆積
def: v. collect or gather

tr: n. 精確, 正確
[計] 準確度
準確性；精確度
def: n. the quality of being near to the true value
n. (mathematics) the number of significant figures given in a number
the quality of being correct or free from errors

ex.en: Please check the accuracy of these measurements before cutting.
ex.zh: 裁剪之前，請檢查這些測量數據是否準確。

ex.en: The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.
ex.zh: 氣候預測的準確性部分取決於長期收集的數據質量。

col: check the accuracy of｜核查……的準確性
a high degree of accuracy｜高度準確
words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；形容詞是accurate。

tr: a. 正確的, 精確的
[經] 準確的, 精確的
準確的；精確的
精準的；命中目標的
def: a. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
s. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth; strictly correct
correct and free from mistakes

ex.en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
ex.zh: 這臺廚房秤的精度足以用來做麵包。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 準確的空氣質量信息能幫助居民在充分知情的情況下決定是否進行戶外鍛鍊。

words.tip: accurate強調準確無誤；precise更強調細節精確。

tr: vt. 指責, 控告, 歸咎於
vi. 指責, 控告
def: v. bring an accusation against; level a charge against

tr: vt. 使習慣於
使習慣於
def: v make psychologically or physically used (to something)
To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.

ex.en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
ex.zh: 我慢慢讓自己習慣了開窗睡覺。

ex.en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
ex.zh: 學校可以定期佈置需要共同承擔責任的任務，讓學生習慣合作。

col: accustom yourself to｜使自己習慣於
words.tip: accustom oneself to中to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 倦怠, 漠然
[醫] 淡漠憂鬱症
def: n apathy and inactivity in the practice of virtue (personified as one of the deadly sins)

tr: a. 酸的, 尖刻的
def: s sour or bitter in taste
s harsh or corrosive in tone

tr: n. 澀, 酸, 尖刻
[化] 澀度
def: n. a sharp bitterness
n. a sharp sour taste

tr: vt. 承認, 告知收悉, 答謝, 報償
[經] 承認, 答謝, 收到的通知
def: v. report the receipt of
v. express obligation, thanks, or gratitude for
v. accept as legally binding and valid

tr: n. 侍僧, 助手
def: n. someone who assists a priest or minister in a liturgical service; a cleric ordained in the highest of the minor orders in the Roman Catholic Church but not in the Anglican Church or the Eastern Orthodox Churches

tr: a. 聽覺的, 聲學的, 音響的
[醫] 聽的; 聲學的
def: n. a remedy for hearing loss or deafness
a. of or relating to the science of acoustics

tr: vi. 默許, 默然同意
def: v to agree or express agreement

tr: n. 默許, 默認
[法] 默許, 默認
def: n. acceptance without protest

tr: a. 默許的, 默認的, 默從的

ex.zh: 當室內空氣質量降至可接受水平以下時，智能傳感器可以自動啟動通風系統。

ex.zh: 我姐姐很擅長修理舊自行車。

ex.zh: 擅長使用數字工具的教師能夠調整課程，以滿足更多樣的學習需求。

ex.zh: 這臺小取暖器足以讓我的臥室保持暖和。

ex.zh: 一位獨立專家將裁決我們在維修問題上的爭議。

ex.zh: 獨立機構應裁決消費者與企業之間的糾紛，確保投訴得到公平且一致的處理。

ex.zh: 價格可負擔的可再生能源的出現，促使各國政府重新審視對化石燃料的依賴。

ex.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們的渡輪航班取消了。

ex.zh: 這家麵包店在當地電臺為自家的新鮮麵包做廣告。

ex.zh: 這張航拍照片拍出了我們河邊的房子。

ex.zh: 航空調查讓研究人員能夠監測偏遠地區的森林流失，而不驚擾野生動物。

ex.zh: 我們當地的自行車俱樂部隸屬於一個全國性組織。

ex.en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
ex.zh: 小型研究機構常與大學建立隸屬關係，以獲得使用專業設備和藉助學術專長的機會。

col: be affiliated with｜與……有隸屬關係
a local affiliate｜地方附屬機構
words.tip: 名詞詞尾讀 /ət/，動詞詞尾讀 /eɪt/。

tr: n. 聯繫, 從屬關係

n. (anthropology) kinship by marriage or adoption; not a blood relationship
n. (biology) state of relationship between organisms or groups of organisms resulting in resemblance in structure or structural parts

tr: n. 肯定, 斷言, 證實
[醫] 肯定, 確認

n. a judgment by a higher court that the judgment of a lower court was correct and should stand

ex.en: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
ex.zh: 每到鮮花盛開時，季節性過敏就讓我的哥哥備受困擾。

ex.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
ex.zh: 缺水問題持續困擾農村社區，限制農業生產，並加重當地家庭的負擔。

words.tip: 常用被動be afflicted with，後接疾病或困境。

tr: n. 苦惱, 折磨, 苦惱的事由

n. a condition of suffering or distress due to ill health
n. a cause of great suffering and distress

tr: a. 豐富的, 富裕的
n. 支流, 富人
def: n. an affluent person; a person who is financially well off
s. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value

tr: [計] 普及型
負擔得起的

Not too expensive for someone to pay for.

ex.en: This small flat is affordable on my current salary.
ex.zh: 以我目前的工資，租得起這套小公寓。

ex.en: Governments should provide affordable housing so that essential workers can live close to their workplaces.
ex.zh: 政府應提供可負擔的住房，讓必要服務崗位的工作人員能住在工作地點附近。

col: affordable healthcare｜負擔得起的醫療服務
words.tip: 強調價格在承受範圍內，不一定意味著絕對便宜。

tr: n. 公開侮辱, 輕蔑

s. tending to spread quickly
s. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight

ex.en: The aggressive dog growled whenever anyone approached its gate.
ex.zh: 每當有人靠近大門，那隻兇悍的狗就會低吼。

ex.en: Aggressive marketing campaigns may increase sales, but they can also encourage unnecessary consumption and household debt.
ex.zh: 強勢營銷活動可能提高銷量，但也可能助長不必要的消費和家庭負債。

words.tip: 形容行為常含貶義；商業語境可指強勢進取。

n. a state of agitation or turbulent change or development

ex.en: Her agitation grew as she searched for her missing keys.
ex.zh: 她尋找丟失的鑰匙時，變得越來越焦躁。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise may increase agitation and reduce residents' ability to concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 長期接觸交通噪聲可能加劇居民的煩躁情緒，降低他們在家中的專注力。

col: in a state of agitation｜處於焦躁狀態

adv. 急切地, 渴望

[醫] 瀕死苦悶; 劇痛
def: n. intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain
n. a state of acute pain

s. prepared to agree or consent
pleasant and enjoyable

ex.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園裡聊天，度過了一個愉快的下午。

ex.en: Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果管理者解釋好處並回應員工的顧慮，員工可能會更願意接受組織變革。

col: agreeable to a proposal｜贊同某項提議
words.tip: be agreeable to sth表示願意接受某事，語氣較正式。

tr: n. 瘧疾, 打冷顫

n. a warning serves to make you more alert to danger

[法] 轉讓, 讓與, 疏遠
使疏遠；使失去支持
def: v. make withdrawn or isolated or emotionally dissociated
Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you

ex.en: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
ex.zh: 他不停地抱怨，連最親近的朋友都疏遠了他。

ex.en: Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府未能清楚解釋公共交通政策的好處，這些政策可能會失去居民的支持。

col: alienate someone from｜使某人與……疏遠
words.tip: 常指使人疏遠或失去支持，不表示挪用。

tr: n. 疏遠, 離間, 轉讓
[醫] 精神錯亂
疏離感；疏遠
異化
def: n. the feeling of being alienated from other people
n. separation resulting from hostility
n. (law) the voluntary and absolute transfer of title and possession of real property from one person to another

ex.en: Joining a local choir eased her sense of alienation.
ex.zh: 加入當地合唱團緩解了她的疏離感。

ex.en: Rapid urban development can deepen residents' alienation when familiar neighbourhoods are replaced by anonymous apartment blocks.
ex.zh: 當熟悉的街區被缺乏特色的公寓樓取代時，快速的城市開發可能加深居民的疏離感。

col: alienation from society｜與社會的疏離
words.tip: 日常多指疏離感；哲學、社會學中可指異化。

tr: n. 忠貞, 效忠
忠誠；效忠
def: n. the loyalty that citizens owe to their country (or subjects to their sovereign)
Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
ex.zh: 儘管移居國外，他仍忠於家鄉的俱樂部。

ex.en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
ex.zh: 政治立場上的忠誠會影響選民如何解讀經濟政策，以及如何評價當選官員的表現。

words.tip: 效忠對象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

tr: n. 寓言
def: n. an expressive style that uses fictional characters and events to describe some subject by suggestive resemblances; an extended metaphor

對……過敏的
過敏引起的
def: a. characterized by or caused by allergy
s. having an allergy or peculiar or excessive susceptibility (especially to a specific factor)
Having an allergy to a particular substance

ex.en: I am allergic to cats, so I keep my distance.
ex.zh: 我對貓過敏，所以會和貓保持距離。

ex.en: Restaurants should provide accurate ingredient information to protect customers who are allergic to common foods.
ex.zh: 餐館應提供準確的配料信息，以保護對常見食物過敏的顧客。

words.tip: 說對某物過敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

tr: vt. 減輕, 使緩和
減輕；緩解
def: v provide physical relief, as from pain
v make easier
to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe

ex.en: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
ex.zh: 洗個熱水澡幫助緩解了我的肩膀痠痛。

ex.en: Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
ex.zh: 增加可負擔住房可以減輕低收入家庭的壓力，並降低無家可歸的風險。

words.tip: 直接接痛苦或問題；表示減輕，不一定徹底消除。

tr: vt. 分派, 分配
[計] 分配
分配；撥出
def: v. distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose
To assign resources to particular people, activities, or purposes.

ex.en: We allocated one cupboard to all our baking equipment.
ex.zh: 我們專門騰出了一個櫥櫃來放所有烘焙用具。

ex.en: Local authorities should allocate more funding to public transport in areas with limited access to essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府應向基本服務不易獲取的地區投入更多公共交通資金。

words.tip: allocate sth to sb/sth表示將某物分配給某人或某項用途。

tr: vt. 分配, 分攤指定

限額；定量
體諒；酌情考慮
def: n. an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)
n. a sum granted as reimbursement for expenses
n. an amount added or deducted on the basis of qualifying circumstances

ex.en: My weekly allowance covers bus fares and occasional snacks.
ex.zh: 我每週的零用錢夠支付公交車費，偶爾還能買些零食。

ex.en: A housing allowance can help essential workers afford accommodation in cities where rents are particularly high.
ex.zh: 住房津貼能夠幫助必要崗位的工作人員負擔租金特別高的城市中的住宿費用。

words.tip: 零用錢義常見於美式英語；英式常用pocket money。

tr: n. 合金
vt. 將...鑄成合金, 減低成色
vi. 合鑄
合金
使成合金

v. make an alloy of
A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.

ex.en: This bicycle frame is made from a lightweight alloy.
ex.zh: 這輛自行車的車架由輕質合金製成。

ex.en: Engineers are developing stronger alloys to reduce vehicle weight and improve fuel efficiency.
ex.zh: 工程師正在開發更堅固的合金，以減輕車輛重量並提高燃油效率。

words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞常讀/əˈlɔɪ/。

tr: vi. 暗指, 提及
間接提及；暗指
def: v. make a more or less disguised reference to
to refer to something without mentioning it directly

ex.en: He alluded to a surprise but gave no details.
ex.zh: 他暗示會有個驚喜，但沒有透露細節。

ex.en: The report alludes to funding difficulties without explaining how they might affect the proposed transport improvements.
ex.zh: 報告間接提及資金困難，卻沒有解釋這些困難可能如何影響擬議的交通改善項目。

col: allude to a problem｜間接提及問題
allude to the past｜隱約談及過去
words.tip: 固定用allude to，不直接接賓語；勿混elude。

tr: vt. 引誘, 吸引
n. 魅力, 誘惑力
def: n. the power to entice or attract through personal charm

tr: a. 吸引人的, 誘人的, 迷人的
def: s. highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire

tr: n. 提及, 暗指
def: n. passing reference or indirect mention

tr: a. 暗指的, 引用典故的
def: s. characterized by indirect references

vi. 結盟
盟友；同盟國；支持者
結盟；聯合
def: n. a friendly nation
n. an associate who provides cooperation or assistance
v. become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage

ex.en: My neighbour became an ally in saving the park.
ex.zh: 在保護公園這件事上，我的鄰居成了我的盟友。

ex.en: Local charities can be valuable allies for governments seeking to reduce poverty and improve social inclusion.
ex.zh: 對於致力於減貧和促進社會包容的政府而言，當地慈善機構可以成為重要盟友。

words.tip: 名詞重音通常在前；動詞通常讀/əˈlaɪ/。

tr: a. 遠離的, 冷淡的

def: s. remote in manner
r. in an aloof manner

改變；修改
改衣服

v. remove the ovaries of
To change, or make something different.

ex.en: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
ex.zh: 你能改一下這條褲子，讓它更合身嗎？

ex.en: Rising temperatures may alter rainfall patterns and create serious challenges for farmers in dry regions.
ex.zh: 氣溫上升可能改變降雨模式，給乾旱地區的農民帶來嚴峻挑戰。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭壇”，勿混。

tr: a. 引起改變的, 變質的

def: s tending to cure or restore to health

tr: a. 交替的, 輪流的, 間隔的

def: v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions
v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions
v. do something in turns

tr: n. 利他主義, 利他

tr: n. 汞合金, 汞齊
[化] 汞齊; 汞合金

n. a combination or blend of diverse things

tr: v. 使汞齊化, 合併
def: s. joined together into a whole

業餘的

n. an athlete who does not play for pay
s. engaged in as a pastime

ex.en: Although an amateur, she takes beautiful photographs of birds.
ex.zh: 雖然是業餘愛好者，她拍的鳥類照片卻很漂亮。

ex.en: Amateur sports clubs provide affordable opportunities for physical activity and help strengthen relationships within local communities.
ex.zh: 業餘體育俱樂部提供費用低廉的鍛鍊機會，並有助於加強社區居民之間的聯繫。

ex.zh: 魔術師巧妙的戲法總能讓孩子們驚歎不已。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 醫療技術的進步不斷令研究人員驚歎，也為病情複雜的患者帶來新的希望。

col: never cease to amaze｜始終令人驚歎
words.tip: 人感到驚奇用amazed；事物令人驚奇用amazing。

tr: a. 兩手俱利的, 搞兩面派的

def: a. equally skillful with each hand
s. marked by deliberate deceptiveness especially by pretending one set of feelings and acting under the influence of another

n the atmosphere of an environment

tr: n. 不明確, 含糊

n. unclearness by virtue of having more than one meaning

tr: a. 不明確的, 模稜兩可的
[法] 意思含糊的, 模稜兩可的, 曖昧的
有歧義的；含糊的

s. having no intrinsic or objective meaning; not organized in conventional patterns

ex.en: His ambiguous reply left us unsure whether to come.
ex.zh: 他的回答含糊不清，讓我們拿不準該不該來。

ex.en: Ambiguous wording in public health advice can confuse readers and reduce their confidence in official guidance.
ex.zh: 公共衛生建議中的含糊措辭可能讓讀者困惑，並降低他們對官方指導的信任。

words.tip: 側重可作多種解讀；vague側重細節不清。

tr: a. 有野心的, 抱負不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
有抱負的；雄心勃勃的
宏大的；艱鉅的
def: a. having a strong desire for success or achievement
s. requiring full use of your abilities or resources
strongly wanting to achieve success

ex.en: My ambitious sister hopes to run her own bakery.
ex.zh: 我那有抱負的姐姐希望經營自己的麵包店。

ex.en: The city has announced an ambitious plan to replace all diesel buses with electric vehicles within a decade.
ex.zh: 該市宣佈了一項宏大的計劃，要在十年內將所有柴油公交車更換為電動車。

col: ambitious young people｜有抱負的年輕人
words.tip: 形容人指有抱負；形容計劃則強調目標宏大、難度高。

tr: a. 矛盾的, 模稜兩可的
[醫] 矛盾情緒的
心情矛盾的；態度搖擺的
def: s. uncertain or unable to decide about what course to follow
having conflicting feelings about someone or something

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
ex.zh: 對於搬離家人這件事，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
ex.zh: 許多消費者對網購仍持矛盾態度，因為便利與隱私方面的擔憂需要權衡。

words.tip: 常接about；指好壞感受並存，不是毫不在意。

tr: n. 馬的緩行步態, 緩行漫步
vi. 馬緩行, 從容漫步
def: n. a leisurely walk (usually in some public place)
v. walk leisurely

tr: n. 埋伏, 伏兵, 伏擊
vt. 埋伏, 伏擊
vi. 埋伏
def: n. the act of concealing yourself and lying in wait to attack by surprise
v. wait in hiding to attack

tr: v. 改善, 改良, 改進
def: v to make better
v get better

tr: a. 服從的, 會接納的, 有義務的
[法] 服從的, 有責任的, 有服從義務的
def: s. disposed or willing to comply
s. readily reacting to suggestions and influences
s. open to being acted upon in a certain way

tr: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改過自新
修訂；修改
def: v. make amendments to
To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
ex.zh: 請修改預訂，增加一位客人。

ex.en: Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
ex.zh: 議會可能修訂現行法律，確保遠程工作者獲得與辦公室員工相同的保護。

words.tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理實物通常用mend。

tr: n. 修訂, 改善, 改良, 改正
[化] 調理劑; 修正
修訂；修正案
def: n. the act of amending or correcting
n. a statement that is added to or revises or improves a proposal or document (a bill or constitution etc.)
A change made to a law, document, or proposal.

ex.en: We agreed on one small amendment to the contract.
ex.zh: 我們就合同的一處小修改達成了一致。

ex.en: The proposed amendment would require employers to provide safer working conditions for temporary staff.
ex.zh: 擬議的修正案將要求僱主為臨時員工提供更安全的工作條件。

col: amendment to a law｜對法律的修訂
words.tip: 表示對某文件的修改，用amendment to。

tr: n. 和藹可親, 友善, 親切
def: n a cheerful and agreeable mood
n a disposition to be friendly and approachable (easy to talk to)

tr: a. 親切的, 和藹可親的
[法] 親和的, 和藹可親的
和藹可親的；友善的
def: s. disposed to please
Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.

ex.en: Our amiable neighbour always stops to chat by the gate.
ex.zh: 我們那位和藹的鄰居總會在門口停下來聊幾句。

ex.en: An amiable manner can help healthcare professionals build trust with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 親切的態度能幫助醫護人員與來自不同文化背景的患者建立信任。

words.tip: amiable多形容人；amicable多形容關係或協議。

tr: a. 友善的, 友好的
[法] 友好的, 和睦的, 溫和的
def: a. characterized by friendship and good will

tr: adv. 友善地
def: r. in an amicable manner

tr: n. 友好, 親善關係
def: n. a cordial disposition
n. a state of friendship and cordiality

tr: n. 健忘症, 記憶缺失
[醫] 記憶缺失, 遺忘[症]
def: n. partial or total loss of memory

tr: n. 大赦, 赦免
def: n. a period during which offenders are exempt from punishment
n. the formal act of liberating someone
v. grant a pardon to (a group of people)

tr: a. 無定形的, 無組織的
[化] 非晶形的; 無定形的
def: s. having no definite form or distinct shape
s. lacking the system or structure characteristic of living bodies
s. without real or apparent crystalline form

tr: a. 大量的, 充足的, 豐富的
充足的；充裕的
寬敞的；寬大的
def: a. more than enough in size or scope or capacity
s. affording an abundant supply
s. fairly large

ex.en: We have ample time for breakfast before the train leaves.
ex.zh: 火車出發前，我們有充足的時間吃早餐。

ex.en: Providing ample green space in residential areas can improve public health and encourage more active lifestyles.
ex.zh: 在住宅區提供充足的綠地能夠改善公眾健康，並鼓勵更積極的生活方式。

words.tip: ample強調足夠甚至有餘，常修飾time、space、evidence。

tr: vt. 增強, 放大, 擴大, 詳述
vi. 引伸
放大聲音或信號
增強；擴大影響
詳述；補充說明
def: v. increase the volume of
to make a sound or electrical signal stronger
to increase the strength or effect of something

ex.en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
ex.zh: 這個小音箱把我手機播放的音樂放大了。

ex.en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
ex.zh: 社交媒體能夠放大公眾對汙染的擔憂，促使地方政府更迅速地回應。

words.tip: 既可放大實際聲音，也可增強影響或情緒。

tr: vt. 消遣, 娛樂, 使發笑
逗樂；使發笑
使消遣；使不無聊
def: v. occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion
v. make (somebody) laugh
To make someone smile or laugh.

ex.en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗樂了在廚房等候的每個人。

ex.en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
ex.zh: 博物館的互動展品既能讓小遊客玩得開心，也能幫助他們理解複雜的科學概念。

col: keep someone amused｜讓某人不無聊
words.tip: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

tr: n. 止痛, 痛覺缺失

tr: n. 相似, 類似
[計] 模擬
類比；相似之處
def: n. an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others
n. drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
A comparison used to explain something through a similar example

ex.en: Her analogy compared our busy kitchen to a train station.
ex.zh: 她把我們忙碌的廚房比作火車站。

ex.en: Teachers often draw an analogy between electrical circuits and flowing water to explain unfamiliar scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教師常將電路與流水作類比，以解釋學生不熟悉的科學概念。

col: an analogy between｜兩者之間的類比
words.tip: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

tr: n. 無政府狀態, 政治混亂
[法] 混亂, 無秩序, 無政府狀態
def: n. a state of lawlessness and disorder (usually resulting from a failure of government)

tr: n. 令人厭惡的人, 強烈的遣責, 詛咒, 咒逐, 革出教門
def: n. a detested person
n. a formal ecclesiastical curse accompanied by excommunication

tr: a. 解剖的, 解剖學的, 構造上的
[醫] 解剖學的
def: n an expression that relates to anatomy
a of or relating to the structure of the body
a of or relating to the branch of morphology that studies the structure of organisms

tr: n. 祖先, 祖宗
祖先；祖宗
祖先物種；原型
def: n. someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
a family member who lived several generations before you
an earlier species or form from which something developed

ex.en: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
ex.zh: 我的一位祖先建造了這座古老的石屋。

ex.en: Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
ex.zh: 研究祖先如何適應環境變化，可以幫助我們理解人類的適應能力。

words.tip: ancestor指祖先；descendant指後代。

tr: a. 祖先的, 祖傳的
[法] 祖先的, 祖傳的
def: s. inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent
a. of or belonging to or inherited from an ancestor

tr: a. 從屬的, 輔助的, 副的
[經] 輔助的, 附屬的, 助手
def: s furnishing added support

tr: a. 軼事的, 愛談奇聞軼事的, 多軼事的
def: a. having the character of an anecdote

tr: n. 麻醉劑, 麻藥

def: n. a drug that causes temporary loss of bodily sensations

n. extreme distress of body or mind
v. suffer great pains or distress

瘦削的；骨感的
def: a. measured by an angle or by the rate of change of an angle
a. having angles or an angular shape
Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.

ex.en: The angular table looked striking beside our curved sofa.
ex.zh: 那張稜角分明的桌子放在我們的弧形沙發旁格外醒目。

ex.en: The museum's angular design contrasts sharply with the rounded forms commonly found in the surrounding landscape.
ex.zh: 這座博物館稜角分明的設計與周圍景觀中常見的圓潤形態形成鮮明對比。

words.tip: 形容外形稜角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

tr: vi. 批判, 責備
def: v. express blame or censure or make a harshly critical remark

tr: vt. 使有生氣, 賦予生命
a. 有生命的, 有生氣的
使有活力；使生動
把…製作成動畫
def: v. give new life or energy to
a. belonging to the class of nouns that denote living beings
a. endowed with animal life as distinguished from plant life

ex.en: Her funny stories always animate our family dinners.
ex.zh: 她的趣事總能讓家庭聚餐活躍起來。

ex.en: Teachers can animate classroom discussions by encouraging students to share experiences from their own communities.
ex.zh: 教師可以鼓勵學生分享各自社區的經歷，讓課堂討論活躍起來。

col: animate a character｜把角色製作成動畫
words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/meɪt/；形容詞末尾讀/mət/。

tr: a. 活生生的, 能活動的, 活潑的, 歡快的
def: a. having life or vigor or spirit
s. made to appear to move as living creatures do

tr: n. 活潑, 生氣, 激勵, 卡通製作
[計] 動畫
def: n. the condition of living or the state of being alive
n. the property of being able to survive and grow
n. quality of being active or spirited or alive and vigorous

tr: n. 仇恨, 憎惡, 敵意
def: n. a feeling of ill will arousing active hostility

tr: n. 基本態度, 敵意, 意向
[醫] 男性意象(精神分析用詞)
def: n a feeling of ill will arousing active hostility

tr: vt. 使退火
[醫] 退火, 煉韌
def: v. bring to a desired consistency, texture, or hardness by a process of gradually heating and cooling

tr: n. 附加物, 附屬建築物
vt. 附加, 蓋(印), 併吞
def: n. an addition that extends a main building
v. take (territory) as if by conquest
v. attach to

tr: vt. 消滅, 廢止
def: v kill in large numbers

tr: v. 作註解, 註釋
[計] 註釋
def: v. add explanatory notes to or supply with critical comments

tr: vt. 宣佈, 聲稱, 顯示, 預告
vi. 當報幕員, 宣佈參加競選
宣佈；公佈
def: v. make known; make an announcement
v. announce publicly or officially
v. give the names of

ex.en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
ex.zh: 今天午飯後，我們的老師宣佈了獲獎者。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府應儘早公佈重大政策調整，讓居民有充足的準備時間。

words.tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

tr: vt. 使惱怒, 騷擾
使惱怒；使煩躁
def: v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

ex.en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
ex.zh: 我想睡覺時，那些滴水的水龍頭讓我心煩。

ex.en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
ex.zh: 頻繁的網絡廣告會讓用戶感到煩躁，使他們不願再次訪問原本有用的教育網站。

words.tip: 人感到煩用annoyed；事物令人煩用annoying。

tr: vt. 廢除, 宣告無效, 取消
[經] 撤銷, 宣告無效
def: v declare invalid
v cancel officially

tr: a. 不規則的, 反常的
[醫] 異常的, 反常的
def: s. deviating from the general or common order or type

tr: n. 不規則, 反常事物, 畸形
[醫] 異常, 反常
def: n. deviation from the normal or common order or form or rule
n. a person who is unusual
n. (astronomy) position of a planet as defined by its angular distance from its perihelion (as observed from the sun)

def: n. the state of being anonymous

tr: n. 對立, 敵對, 敵意
[化] 拮抗作用; 消效作用

n. an actively expressed feeling of dislike and hostility
n. (biochemistry) interference in or inhibition of the physiological action of a chemical substance by another having a similar structure

tr: a. 對抗的, 敵對的
[化] 拮抗藥

s. characterized by antagonism or antipathy
a. arousing animosity or hostility

def: v. provoke the hostility of
v. act in opposition to

tr: n. 先, 居先, 先行

a. 先前的, 先行的
前事；先例
先行詞

n. anything that precedes something similar in time
n. the referent of an anaphor; a phrase or clause that is referred to by an anaphoric pronoun

ex.en: This simple wooden tool is an antecedent of modern machines.
ex.zh: 這件簡單的木製工具是現代機器的前身。

ex.en: Researchers examine the historical antecedents of urban inequality to understand why certain communities remain disadvantaged.
ex.zh: 研究人員考察城市不平等的歷史根源，以理解某些社區為何一直處於弱勢。

col: historical antecedents｜歷史先例；歷史根源
a pronoun's antecedent｜代詞的先行詞
words.tip: 語法中指代詞所指的先行詞；不宜直接等同祖先。

[經] 提前日期(比實際毋早的日期)
def: v be earlier in time; go back further
v establish something as being earlier relative to something else

tr: a. 前面的, 先前的
[醫] 前的

s. earlier in time

tr: n. 聖歌, 讚美詩
國歌；頌歌
宗教合唱曲；讚美詩
def: n. a song of devotion or loyalty (as to a nation or school)
A song expressing loyalty to a country or group
A religious song sung by a choir

ex.en: The crowd stood proudly as the national anthem began.
ex.zh: 國歌響起時，人群自豪地站了起來。

ex.en: Singing a national anthem at international sporting events can strengthen a shared sense of identity.
ex.zh: 在國際體育賽事上唱國歌可以增強共同的身份認同感。

col: the national anthem plays｜國歌奏響
words.tip: national anthem指國歌；宗教語境中可指合唱讚美詩。

tr: n. 抗生素
a. 抗生的

a. of or relating to antibiotic drugs

v. be excited or anxious about

[計] 先行
def: s. in anticipation

a. coming after the climax especially of a dramatic or narrative plot

n. the object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided

tr: n. 古物研究, 好古癖
def: n. Character of an antiquary; study or love of
antiquities.

tr: a. 陳舊的, 過時的, 年老的
陳舊過時的
def: v make obsolete or old-fashioned
v give an antique appearance to
s so extremely old as seeming to belong to an earlier period

ex.en: The office still relies on an antiquated heating system.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室仍然依賴一套陳舊過時的供暖系統。

ex.en: Replacing antiquated railway infrastructure could improve passenger safety and reduce delays across the national transport network.
ex.zh: 更換陳舊的鐵路基礎設施，可以提高乘客安全水平，並減少全國交通網絡的延誤。

words.tip: 含貶義，強調舊到不合時宜；antique可指珍貴古物。

古董；古玩
古董的；年代久遠的

v. shop for antiques
v. give an antique appearance to

ex.en: We found a beautiful antique in a small shop.
ex.zh: 我們在一家小店裡發現了一件漂亮的古董。

ex.en: Preserving antique furniture helps future generations understand traditional craftsmanship and the everyday lives of people in the past.
ex.zh: 保存古董傢俱有助於後代理解傳統工藝以及過去人們的日常生活。

ex.zh: 我們那位善於表達的鄰居在晚餐時把問題解釋得很清楚。

ex.zh: 學校應幫助學生清楚表達自己的觀點，同時鼓勵他們考慮不同的看法。

col: an articulate speaker｜表達清晰的演講者
words.tip: 形容詞詞尾讀/lət/，動詞詞尾讀/leɪt/。

tr: n. 人工製品
[醫] 人為現象, 人工產物
def: n. a man-made object taken as a whole

tr: n. 詭計, 技巧, 巧妙
def: n a deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture)

tr: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地產的
[醫] 人工的, 人造的, 偉牟
人造的；仿造的
不自然的；做作的
def: a. contrived by art rather than nature
s. artificially formal
s. not arising from natural growth or characterized by vital processes

ex.en: The artificial flowers looked surprisingly fresh on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上的仿真花看起來竟然像鮮花一樣。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中過量的人工照明會擾亂野生動物的行為，並使星星難以看清。

words.tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是藝術的。

tr: n. 工匠, 技工
[經] 熟練技術工, 匠人
def: n a skilled worker who practices some trade or handicraft

tr: n. 藝術性
def: n a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation

tr: n. 上升, 提高, 攀登, 上坡路
攀登；上升
地位提升；崛起
上坡路
def: n. an upward slope or grade (as in a road)
the act of climbing or moving upwards
a rise to a higher position, rank, or level

ex.en: We began our ascent just as the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太陽剛升起，我們就開始攀登。

ex.en: The rapid ascent of renewable energy reflects both technological progress and stronger public support for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的迅速崛起既反映了技術進步，也體現了公眾對環境保護更有力的支持。

col: a steep ascent｜陡峭的上坡路
words.tip: ascent指上升；同音詞assent指同意。

tr: n. 苦行者, 禁慾者, 修道者
a. 苦行的, 禁慾的
def: a. pertaining to or characteristic of an ascetic or the practice of rigorous self-discipline
s. practicing great self-denial

tr: n. 禁慾主義, 苦行生涯
[醫] 制欲主義
def: n. the doctrine that through renunciation of worldly pleasures it is possible to achieve a high spiritual or intellectual state
n. rigorous self-denial and active self-restraint

tr: vt. 歸因於, 歸咎於
[法] 歸咎於
把…歸因於
認為…具有；認定出自
def: v attribute or credit to
To consider something to be caused by a particular factor
To assign a quality, work, or statement to someone

ex.en: I ascribe my better sleep to regular evening walks.
ex.zh: 我認為睡眠改善得益於每晚定時散步。

ex.en: Researchers should not ascribe differences in academic performance solely to individual effort without considering social circumstances.
ex.zh: 研究人員不應在未考慮社會環境的情況下，將學業表現的差異完全歸因於個人努力。

col: ascribe success to｜將成功歸因於
ascribe a work to｜認定作品出自
words.tip: 固定結構ascribe A to B：把A歸因於B。

tr: n. 防腐劑
a. 無菌的
def: s. free of or using methods to keep free of pathological microorganisms

tr: a. 由灰燼構成的, 灰色的, 蒼白的
[機] 灰的, 似灰的
def: s. anemic looking from illness or emotion
s. made of wood of the ash tree

tr: a. 驢的, 像驢的, 愚蠢的
def: s. devoid of intelligence

tr: adv. 懷疑地, 斜眼看
def: s. (used especially of glances) directed to one side with or as if with doubt or suspicion or envy
r. with suspicion or disapproval
r. with a side or oblique glance

tr: a. 歪斜的
adv. 歪斜地
def: s. turned or twisted toward one side
r. turned or twisted to one side

tr: n. 外觀, 方面, 面貌, 方向
[醫] 方面, 局面; 外觀
def: n. a distinct feature or element in a problem
n. a characteristic to be considered
n. the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb

tr: n. 山楊
a. 山楊的, 顫抖的
def: n. any of several trees of the genus Populus having leaves on flattened stalks so that they flutter in the lightest wind

tr: n. 誹謗, 中傷, 灑水
[醫] 噴灑[法]
def: n. a disparaging remark
n. an abusive attack on a person's character or good name
n. the act of sprinkling water in baptism (rare)

tr: n. 懷抱大志者, 野心家
a. 上進的, 有野心的
def: n. an ambitious and aspiring young person
s. desiring or striving for recognition or advancement

tr: n. 熱望, 志向, 渴望
[醫] 吸入; 吸[引], 吸引術
抱負；志向
送氣
def: n. a will to succeed
n. a manner of articulation involving an audible release of breath
A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.

ex.en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她最大的願望是開一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 無論家庭收入如何，獲得負擔得起的高等教育都能幫助年輕人實現抱負。

words.tip: 抱負義常用複數；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

tr: vi. 渴望, 立志於
渴望；立志
def: v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
To strongly want to achieve something important.

ex.en: My younger sister aspires to become a wildlife photographer.
ex.zh: 我妹妹立志成為一名野生動物攝影師。

ex.en: Many young people aspire to careers that offer both financial security and opportunities to contribute to society.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人嚮往既能提供經濟保障，又能讓自己為社會作貢獻的職業。

col: aspire to do something｜立志做某事
aspire to a career in medicine｜立志從醫
words.tip: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to後也可接名詞。

tr: a. 有抱負的, 有志氣的
def: v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
s desiring or striving for recognition or advancement

tr: vt. 攻擊, 質問
[法] 攻擊, 襲擊, 著手解決
def: v. attack someone physically or emotionally

tr: n. 攻擊, 襲擊
vt. 襲擊, 攻擊
vi. 發動攻擊
襲擊；侵犯人身
襲擊；毆打
def: n. close fighting during the culmination of a military attack
n. a threatened or attempted physical attack by someone who appears to be able to cause bodily harm if not stopped
n. thoroughbred that won the triple crown in 1946

ex.en: A witness reported the assault to a nearby police officer.
ex.zh: 一名目擊者向附近的警察報告了這起襲擊事件。

ex.en: Better street lighting may reduce the risk of assault and help residents feel safer after dark.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可能降低人身襲擊風險，讓居民在天黑後更有安全感。

col: an assault on someone｜對某人的襲擊
report an assault｜報告襲擊事件
words.tip: 名詞常接on；動詞直接接人，不加介詞。

tr: vt. 集合, 收集, 裝配
vi. 集合
[計] 彙編
組裝；裝配
集合；召集
def: v. create by putting components or members together
v. get people together
to join separate parts together to make something

ex.en: We assembled the bookshelf before putting our books away.
ex.zh: 我們先組裝好書架，再把書收好。

ex.en: Manufacturers increasingly use robots to assemble electronic devices, improving consistency while reducing demand for some manual jobs.
ex.zh: 製造商越來越多地使用機器人組裝電子設備，在提高一致性的同時減少了對某些體力崗位的需求。

col: assemble in the hall｜在大廳集合
words.tip: 組裝物品時及物；表示人集合時也可不及物。

tr: n. 贊成
vi. 同意
def: n. agreement with a statement or proposal to do something
v. to agree or express agreement

tr: vt. 主張, 堅稱, 斷言
[法] 宣稱, 斷言, 維護
斷言；堅稱
維護；堅持行使
def: v. state categorically
v. insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
To state firmly that something is true.

ex.en: He asserted that he had already paid for lunch.
ex.zh: 他堅稱自己已經付過午餐錢了。

ex.en: Some educators assert that regular feedback improves student motivation more effectively than frequent formal examinations.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者堅稱，定期反饋比頻繁的正式考試更能有效提高學生的學習積極性。

col: assert your rights｜維護自己的權利
assert yourself｜堅定表達自己的立場
words.tip: assert強調堅定表態，不代表已經提供證據。

tr: n. 斷言, 主張
[法] 宣稱, 斷言, 維護
斷言；明確主張
堅持；維護
def: n. a declaration that is made emphatically (as if no supporting evidence were necessary)
a confident statement that something is true
the act of firmly expressing rights, authority, or independence

ex.en: Her assertion that the shop was closed proved wrong.
ex.zh: 她斷言商店已經關門，結果證明她錯了。

ex.en: The assertion that economic growth always improves wellbeing requires careful examination of social and environmental evidence.
ex.zh: 經濟增長總能改善福祉這一斷言，需要通過仔細審視社會和環境證據來檢驗。

col: challenge an assertion｜質疑某項斷言
words.tip: 常用the assertion that…；斷言不代表已有證據。

tr: a. 武斷的, 過分自信的
[法] 斷言的
def: a. aggressively self-assured

tr: vt. 估定, 對...徵稅, 評定
[經] 估計, 估價, 確定(稅款罰款等)的金額
評估；評定
估價；核定金額
def: v. charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine
v. estimate the value of (property) for taxation
Judge the quality, importance, or condition of something.

ex.en: The mechanic assessed the damage before repairing my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修理工先評估了損壞情況，然後才修我的自行車。

ex.en: Schools should assess students through varied tasks rather than relying entirely on final examinations.
ex.zh: 學校應通過多樣化的任務評定學生，而不是完全依賴期末考試。

words.tip: assess後直接接賓語；名詞形式是assessment。

tr: n. 評估, 估定, 評定的款額
[化] 評估
評估；評價
學習考核
def: n. an amount determined as payable
n. the market value set on assets
A judgement about something based on careful examination.

ex.en: The mechanic's assessment was that the brakes needed replacing.
ex.zh: 修理工的判斷是剎車需要更換。

ex.en: Continuous assessment can provide a broader picture of student progress than a single final examination.
ex.zh: 與單次期末考試相比，持續性考核能夠更全面地反映學生的進步。

col: carry out an assessment｜進行評估
words.tip: 評估某事用assessment of；動詞形式是assess。

tr: a. 勤勉的, 刻苦的
def: s. marked by care and persistent effort

tr: vt. 使同化, 吸收, 使相擬, 把...比作
vi. 被吸收, 被同化
吸收並理解
融入；使同化
def: v. become similar to one's environment
v. make similar
v. take (gas, light or heat) into a solution

ex.en: I need time to assimilate everything we learned today.
ex.zh: 我需要時間消化今天所學的所有內容。

ex.en: Students assimilate new information more effectively when teachers connect unfamiliar concepts with examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 教師將陌生概念與日常生活中的例子聯繫起來時，學生能更有效地吸收新知識。

words.tip: 知識可直接作賓語；融入群體常用into。

tr: n. 同伴, 夥伴, 關聯的事物
vt. 使聯合, 使發生聯繫
vi. 交往
[計] 關聯
聯想；聯繫
def: n. a person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor
n. a person with subordinate membership in a society, institution, or commercial enterprise
n. any event that usually accompanies or is closely connected with another

ex.en: I always associate the smell of cinnamon with home.
ex.zh: 我總是一聞到肉桂的氣味就想起家。

ex.en: Many consumers associate higher prices with better quality, although research suggests this connection is not always reliable.
ex.zh: 許多消費者把較高價格與較好品質聯繫起來，但研究表明，這種聯繫並非總是可靠。

col: associate A with B｜把A與B聯繫起來
words.tip: 動詞尾音/eɪt/；名詞、形容詞尾音/ət/。

tr: vt. 赦免, 宣佈...無罪, 補償
[法] 赦免, 釋放, 補償
def: v pronounce not guilty of criminal charges

tr: a. 各種各樣的, 分類的
def: s. consisting of a haphazard assortment of different kinds
s. of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity

tr: vt. 平息, 緩和, 減輕
def: v cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
v satisfy (thirst)
v provide physical relief, as from pain

tr: vt. 假定, 承擔, 呈現
vi. 裝腔作勢, 僭越
假定；想當然地認為
承擔；就任
呈現；具有
def: v. take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof
v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
v. take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect

ex.en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 別想當然地以為這家店週日營業。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不應假定所有家庭都有穩定的網絡連接或足夠的數字技能。

words.tip: assume常接that從句，強調未經證實便認為。

tr: vt. 保證, 使確信, 弄清楚, 擔保
[法] 確信, 保證, 保障
def: v. inform positively and with certainty and confidence
v. assure somebody of the truth of something with the intention of giving the listener confidence

tr: n. 確實, 確信, 自信
def: n great coolness and composure under strain

tr: n. 星號
[計] 星號, 星號通配符
星號
def: n. a star-shaped character * used in printing
A star-shaped symbol used to indicate a note or omission

ex.en: An asterisk beside the price points to extra delivery charges.
ex.zh: 價格旁的星號提示還有額外運費。

ex.en: Researchers often use an asterisk in tables to indicate results that meet a particular statistical threshold.
ex.zh: 研究人員常在表格中用星號標明達到特定統計閾值的結果。

col: mark with an asterisk｜用星號標記
words.tip: 詞尾是-risk，注意不要誤讀成-riks。

tr: n. 小行星, 海盤車

s. shaped like a star

tr: a. 散光的, 矯正散光的
[計] 象散
def: a. of or relating to a defect in the eye or in a lens caused by a deviation from spherical curvature which prevents light rays from meeting at a common focus and so results in distorted images

tr: vt. 使驚駭, 使大驚
def: v affect with wonder

tr: a. 令人驚駭的
def: s. bewildering or striking dumb with wonder

tr: adv. 迷途地, 入歧途地
[法] 誤入歧途地, 離開正道地
def: r. away from the right path or direction

tr: n. 占星術, 占星學
def: n. a pseudoscience claiming divination by the positions of the planets and sun and moon

tr: a. 天文學的, 龐大的
極其巨大的；天文數字的
天文學的
def: a relating or belonging to the science of astronomy
s inconceivably large
Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts.

ex.en: The hotel charged an astronomical price for one night.
ex.zh: 這家酒店一晚的收費高得驚人。

ex.en: The astronomical cost of housing in major cities can prevent young adults from achieving financial independence.
ex.zh: 大城市高得驚人的住房成本可能使年輕人無法實現經濟獨立。

col: astronomical sums｜天文數字般的金額
words.tip: 談費用時常表示高得驚人；也可表示天文學的。

tr: a. 敏銳的, 狡猾的
def: s. marked by practical hardheaded intelligence

tr: adv. 分開, 散, 碎
def: s. widely separated especially in space

tr: a. 不對稱的, 偏位的
[計] 非對稱的, 不對稱的, 不平衡的
不對稱的
不均衡的；不對等的
def: a characterized by asymmetry in the spatial arrangement or placement of parts or components
having sides or parts that do not match
unequal between people, groups, or sides

ex.en: The jacket has an asymmetric collar and deep pockets.
ex.zh: 這件夾克的領子不對稱，口袋很深。

ex.en: Asymmetric access to market information can place small businesses at a disadvantage when negotiating with larger firms.
ex.zh: 市場信息獲取的不對等，可能使小企業在與大公司談判時處於不利地位。

words.tip: 既可指形狀不對稱，也可指信息或力量不對等。

tr: n. 無神論
def: n. the doctrine or belief that there is no God
n. a lack of belief in the existence of God or gods

tr: n. 無神論者
def: n. someone who denies the existence of god
a. related to or characterized by or given to atheism

tr: a. 原子的, 原子能的
[醫] 原子的
原子的
原子能的；核能的
def: a. of or relating to or comprising atoms
s. immeasurably small
Relating to atoms, the basic units of chemical elements.

ex.en: Our teacher used coloured balls to explain atomic structure.
ex.zh: 老師用彩色小球來解釋原子結構。

ex.en: Understanding atomic structure has enabled scientists to develop advanced materials for medicine, electronics, and renewable energy technologies.
ex.zh: 對原子結構的理解使科學家得以開發用於醫學、電子技術和可再生能源技術的先進材料。

words.tip: atomic強調原子；nuclear更側重原子核或核能。

tr: a. 無調性的
def: a. characterized by avoidance of traditional western tonality

tr: vi. 補償, 彌補
[法] 賠償, 補償, 償還
def: v make amends for
v turn away from sin or do penitence

tr: n. 贖罪, 補償
[法] 補償, 贖回, 贖罪
def: n. compensation for a wrong

tr: a. 殘暴的, 兇惡的
def: s. shockingly brutal or cruel
s. exceptionally bad or displeasing
s. provoking horror

tr: n. 殘暴, 兇惡, 暴行
[法] 暴行, 殘酷, 殘忍
def: n. the quality of being shockingly cruel and inhumane
n. an act of atrocious cruelty

tr: n. 萎縮, 萎縮症
[醫] 萎縮
def: n. a decrease in size of an organ caused by disease or disuse
n. any weakening or degeneration (especially through lack of use)
v. undergo atrophy

tr: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附屬, 使喜愛, 系, 縛
vi. 附屬, 歸屬, 聯繫在一起
[計] 掛接服務器命令, 關聯, 掛接, 附加
固定；繫上；附上
賦予；認為具有
def: v. cause to be attached
v. be attached; be in contact with
v. become attached

ex.en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
ex.zh: 把這個小鈴鐺裝在自行車的車把上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 許多僱主招聘新員工時，更看重實際經驗而非學歷。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
words.tip: 常用attach A to B；郵件附件用attachment。

tr: a. 纖細的, 稀薄的, 稀釋的
vt. 使減弱, 使纖細
vi. 變稀薄, 變纖細, 減少
[計] 衰減
def: v. become weaker, in strength, value, or magnitude
s. reduced in strength

tr: n. 變稀薄, 變纖細, 衰減
[計] 衰減
def: n. weakening in force or intensity
n. the property of something that has been weakened or reduced in thickness or density

tr: vi. 證明, 表明, 作證
vt. 為...作證
def: v. provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes
v. authenticate, affirm to be true, genuine, or correct, as in an official capacity
v. establish or verify the usage of

tr: n. 服裝, 盛裝
vt. 使穿衣, 打扮
def: n. clothing of a distinctive style or for a particular occasion

tr: n. 屬性, 標誌, 定語
vt. 把...歸於, 認為...屬於
[計] 屬性
把…歸因於；認為是…所作
特徵；屬性

To regard something as caused or created by someone or something.
A quality or feature of a person or thing.

ex.en: She attributes her good health to daily walks.
ex.zh: 她把自己的健康歸功於每天散步。

ex.en: Researchers attribute the decline in local air pollution to stricter controls on industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 研究人員將當地空氣汙染的減少歸因於對工業排放更嚴格的管控。

col: attribute success to｜把成功歸因於
