def: n. the act of compelling by force of authority

tr: a. 強制的, 強壓的, 強迫的
[法] 強制的, 強迫的, 強行的
def: s. serving or intended to coerce

tr: a. 同時代的
n. 同時代的人
def: n a person of nearly the same age as another
s of the same period

tr: n. 保險箱, 金庫
vt. 把...鎖進箱子
def: n. an ornamental sunken panel in a ceiling or dome
n. a chest especially for storing valuables

tr: a. 使人首肯的, 使人信服的, 中肯切題的
[法] 有說服力的, 無法反駁的
def: s. powerfully persuasive

tr: v. 思考, 考慮
def: v. consider carefully and deeply; reflect upon; turn over in one's mind

tr: a. 認知的, 認識的
認知的
def: a. of or being or relating to or involving cognition
Related to mental processes such as learning, remembering, and understanding.

ex.en: These puzzles help my grandmother keep her cognitive skills sharp.
ex.zh: 這些益智遊戲幫助我祖母保持敏銳的認知能力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity may support cognitive development in children and help older adults maintain their memory.
ex.zh: 規律的身體活動可能促進兒童認知發展，並幫助老年人保持記憶力。

words.tip: 常修飾ability、development等，側重思維和記憶。

tr: a. 察知的, 認識到的, 有認識能力的
[法] 審理的, 審理權的, 有權審理的
def: a (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception

tr: n. 黏合(性), 連貫性, 一致性
[化] 相干性
連貫性；條理性
def: n. the state of cohering or sticking together
n. logical and orderly and consistent relation of parts
The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.

ex.en: Your story needs more coherence between its different parts.
ex.zh: 你故事中的各個部分需要銜接得更連貫。

ex.en: Clear paragraph structure improves the coherence of an essay and helps readers follow complex arguments.
ex.zh: 清晰的段落結構能增強文章的連貫性，幫助讀者理解複雜的論證。

words.tip: 側重邏輯連貫；cohesion側重語言或結構銜接。

tr: a. 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明瞭的，凝聚性的, 連貫的
連貫的；條理清楚的
def: a. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
s. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
a. (physics) of waves having a constant phase relation

ex.en: After some practice, he gave a clear, coherent explanation.
ex.zh: 經過一些練習，他給出了清晰而有條理的解釋。

ex.en: A coherent transport policy should connect investment in public services with long-term environmental and economic goals.
ex.zh: 一項協調一致的交通政策應將公共服務投資與長期環境和經濟目標聯繫起來。

col: a coherent argument｜條理清楚的論證
a coherent explanation｜連貫清晰的解釋
a coherent strategy｜協調一致的策略
words.tip: 強調內容邏輯連貫；cohesive更強調各部分銜接緊密。

tr: n. 結合, 黏聚, 內聚
[計] 內聚性
凝聚力；團結
篇章銜接
def: n. (botany) the process in some plants of parts growing together that are usually separate (such as petals)
n. (physics) the intermolecular force that holds together the molecules in a solid or liquid
The strength of connection that keeps a group together

ex.en: Our weekly team lunches helped build cohesion at work.
ex.zh: 我們每週的團隊午餐有助於增強工作中的凝聚力。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can strengthen social cohesion by encouraging regular interaction between residents from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空間能促進不同背景的居民經常交流，從而增強社會凝聚力。

words.tip: 寫作中cohesion指語言銜接，coherence指邏輯連貫。

tr: a. 黏合在一起的
[醫] 內聚的
有凝聚力的；緊密結合的
def: s. causing cohesion
s. cohering or tending to cohere; well integrated
united or closely connected as a whole

ex.en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
ex.zh: 定期練習幫助我們成為一支更有凝聚力的隊伍。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空間可以促進不同背景的人交流，從而幫助建設有凝聚力的社區。

words.tip: cohesive強調緊密結合；coherent強調條理清楚。

tr: a. 一致的, 符合的, 巧合的
def: s occurring or operating at the same time

tr: adv. 巧合地；一致地
def: r. happening at the same time

tr: a. 冷血的, (貶)無情的, 殘酷的
[醫] 冷血的
def: a. having cold blood (in animals whose body temperature is not internally regulated)

tr: vi. 合作, 勾結
[法] 合作, 合著, 通敵
合作；協作
與敵方勾結
def: v. work together on a common enterprise of project
v. cooperate as a traitor
work with others to create or achieve something

ex.en: We collaborate on recipes for our weekend cooking club.
ex.zh: 我們一起為週末烹飪俱樂部設計食譜。

ex.en: Universities should collaborate with local businesses to develop practical solutions to regional environmental problems.
ex.zh: 大學應與當地企業合作，為區域環境問題制定切實可行的解決方案。

col: collaborate on a project｜合作開展項目
words.tip: 與某人合作用with；合作做某項目用on。

tr: a. 合作的, 協作的
def: s. accomplished by collaboration

tr: n. 拼貼畫
def: n. a paste-up made by sticking together pieces of paper or photographs to form an artistic image
n. any collection of diverse things

tr: n. 崩潰, 倒塌, 虛脫
vi. 倒塌, 崩潰, 瓦解
vt. 使倒塌, 摺疊
[計] 摺疊
倒塌；崩潰；倒下
def: n. an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion
n. a natural event caused by something suddenly falling down or caving in
v. break down, literally or metaphorically

ex.en: The old garden shed collapsed during last night's storm.
ex.zh: 昨晚的暴風雨中，花園裡的舊棚屋倒塌了。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can cause bridges to collapse, making regular inspections essential for public safety.
ex.zh: 維護不善可能導致橋梁坍塌，因此定期檢查對公共安全至關重要。

col: collapse from exhaustion｜因筋疲力盡而倒下
the collapse of negotiations｜談判破裂
words.tip: 表示倒塌或崩潰時通常是不及物動詞，不用被動。

tr: vt. 校對, 校勘
[計] 整理
def: v. compare critically; of texts
v. to assemble in proper sequence

tr: a. 並行的, 附隨的, 旁系的
n. 旁系親屬, 擔保品
def: n. a security pledged for the repayment of a loan
a. descended from a common ancestor but through different lines
s. serving to support or corroborate

tr: n. 碰撞, 衝突, 牴觸
[計] 衝突
def: n. (physics) a brief event in which two or more bodies come together
n. an accident resulting from violent impact of a moving object
n. a conflict of opposed ideas or attitudes or goals

tr: a. 會話的, 口語的, 口語體的
口語的；非正式的
def: s. characteristic of informal spoken language or conversation
used in informal conversation rather than formal writing

ex.en: This podcast helps me learn colloquial expressions used by friends.
ex.zh: 這個播客幫助我學習朋友之間常用的口語表達。

ex.en: Although colloquial language suits personal blogs, academic essays generally require a more formal style.
ex.zh: 雖然口語化語言適合個人博客，但學術文章通常需要更正式的文風。

words.tip: 指日常交談中的非正式用語，不等於俚語。

tr: n. 談話, 會話, 討論
def: n. a conversation especially a formal one
n. formal conversation

tr: vi. 共謀, 串通, 勾結
def: v act in unison or agreement and in secret towards a deceitful or illegal purpose

tr: n. 共謀, 勾結
[經] 勾結, 串通, 串同舞弊
def: n. secret agreement

tr: a. 共謀的
def: s. acting together in secret toward a fraudulent or illegal end

tr: vi. 開拓殖民地
vt. 殖民於, 移植於
def: v. settle as a colony; of countries in the developing world
v. settle as colonists or establish a colony (in)

tr: n. 殖民地, 移民隊
[醫] 菌(集)落, 菌叢; 移民區
殖民地
群居動物群；菌落
def: n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government
n. a group of organisms of the same type living or growing together
n. one of the 13 British colonies that formed the original states of the United States

ex.en: The island was once a colony of a distant kingdom.
ex.zh: 這座島曾是一個遙遠王國的殖民地。

ex.en: Historical records reveal how trade policies shaped the economy of the colony over several decades.
ex.zh: 歷史記錄揭示了貿易政策如何在數十年間塑造該殖民地的經濟。

words.tip: 既可指殖民地，也可指蟻群、鳥群或菌落。

tr: n. 著色, 特色, 色彩, 天然顏色
def: n. appearance with regard to color
n. choice and use of colors (as by an artist)

tr: a. 華美的, 富有色彩的, 有趣的
def: a. having striking color
a. striking in variety and interest

tr: a. 巨大的, 巨像似的
def: s. so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe

tr: n. 小馬, 苔繩, 無經驗的年輕人
def: n. a young male horse under the age of four
n. a kind of revolver

tr: [計] 計算機輸出縮微膠片; 計算機輸出膠片縮微機
n. 昏迷, 麻木, 彗發
[化] 彗差; 彗形像差
def: n. a state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness; usually the result of disease or injury
n. (botany) a usually terminal tuft of bracts (as in the pineapple) or tuft of hairs (especially on certain seeds)
n. (astronomy) the luminous cloud of particles surrounding the frozen nucleus of a comet; forms as the comet approaches the sun and is warmed

tr: a. 昏睡的, 昏睡狀態的
[醫] 昏迷的
def: a. relating to or associated with a coma
s. in a state of deep and usually prolonged unconsciousness; unable to respond to external stimuli

tr: n. 爭鬥, 戰鬥
vi. 戰鬥, 爭鬥
vt. 與...戰鬥, 與...鬥爭
抗擊；遏制
戰鬥；搏鬥
def: n. an engagement fought between two military forces
to fight against something harmful
fighting between opposing forces or individuals

ex.en: We opened the windows to combat the afternoon heat.
ex.zh: 我們打開窗戶來抵禦午後的炎熱。

ex.en: Governments can combat air pollution by improving public transport and enforcing stricter limits on industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過改善公共交通和加強工業排放限制的執行來治理空氣汙染。

col: combat climate change｜應對氣候變化
words.tip: 作動詞直接接問題或危害，不必加against。

tr: a. 好鬥的, 好事的
def: s inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits
s striving to overcome in argument
s having or showing a ready disposition to fight

tr: v. (使)聯合, (使)結合
n. (企業的)聯合, 聯合收割機
結合；使聯合
聯合收割機
def: n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field
v. add together from different sources
v. join for a common purpose or in a common action

ex.en: Combine the flour and butter in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把麵粉和黃油放在一個大碗裡混合。

ex.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市可以將公共交通改善與更安全的騎行路線建設相結合，減少對私家車的依賴。

col: combine A with B｜把A與B結合
combine theory and practice｜理論與實踐相結合
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；收割機名詞讀/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

tr: a. 易燃的, 燃燒性的, 易動激情的
n. 易燃物, 可燃物
def: n. a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power
a. capable of igniting and burning

tr: n. 喜劇女演員
def: n. a female actor in a comedy
n. a female comedian

tr: a. 清秀的, 標緻的, 美麗的
def: s according with custom or propriety
s very pleasing to the eye

tr: a. 可吃的
n. 食物
def: n. any substance that can be used as food

tr: a. 彗星的, 彗星似的
def: a. of or relating to or resembling a comet

tr: n. 應得的懲罰
def: n an outcome (good or bad) that is well deserved

tr: n. 連環漫畫, 喜劇演員, 滑稽的人
a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜劇的
滑稽的；喜劇的
漫畫書；連環漫畫
喜劇演員
def: a. of or relating to or characteristic of comedy
funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚會上的每個人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以讓教育節目更有吸引力，幫助兒童記住重要信息。

words.tip: comic可指喜劇相關；comical側重滑稽可笑。

tr: n. 逗點, 逗號
逗號
def: n. a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate the separation of elements within the grammatical structure of a sentence
n. anglewing butterfly with a comma-shaped mark on the underside of each hind wing
A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.

ex.en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
ex.zh: 我加了一個逗號，讓句子更清楚。

ex.en: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
ex.zh: 位置不當的逗號可能改變句意，使學術文章的讀者產生困惑。

col: a misplaced comma｜位置不當的逗號
separate items with commas｜用逗號分隔各項
words.tip: comma是逗號，句號通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

tr: vt. 紀念
紀念；緬懷
def: v. mark by some ceremony or observation
v. call to remembrance; keep alive the memory of someone or something, as in a ceremony
v. be or provide a memorial to a person or an event

ex.en: We planted a tree to commemorate our grandfather's life.
ex.zh: 我們種了一棵樹，紀念祖父的一生。

ex.en: Public ceremonies commemorate historical events and help younger generations understand the experiences that shaped their communities.
ex.zh: 公共紀念儀式緬懷歷史事件，幫助年輕一代理解塑造其社區的經歷。

words.tip: 直接接紀念對象；不一定含有慶祝的喜悅。

tr: v. (使)開始, 得學位
開始；著手
def: v take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
v set in motion, cause to start
v get off the ground

ex.en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
ex.zh: 簡短的歡迎致辭後，晚間音樂會將開始。

ex.en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.
ex.zh: 環境評估完成後，新鐵路的建設將啟動。

words.tip: 比start正式；可接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 開始, 畢業典禮
[法] 開始, 畢業典禮
開始；開端
畢業典禮（美式）
def: n. an academic exercise in which diplomas are conferred
The beginning of something, especially an official activity
A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States

ex.en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
ex.zh: 比賽開始時，我們聽到了一聲哨響。

ex.en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 施工開始前應完成環境評估，以儘量減少對當地生態系統的潛在破壞。

col: the commencement of work｜工作的開始
words.tip: 表示“開始”較正式；美式英語中也指畢業典禮。

tr: vt. 嘉獎, 委託給, 推薦
表揚；稱讚
推薦
def: v. express approval of
v. present as worthy of regard, kindness, or confidence
v. give to in charge

ex.en: The coach commended Lina for helping her teammates.
ex.zh: 教練表揚莉娜幫助了隊友。

ex.en: Inspectors commended the school for providing additional support to students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 督察人員讚揚該校為有不同學習需求的學生提供額外支持。

col: commend someone for something｜因某事表揚某人
commend something to someone｜向某人推薦某物
words.tip: commend是稱讚；command是命令，注意拼寫。

tr: a. 同量的, 同等的, 相稱的
def: a. corresponding in size or degree or extent

tr: n. 註釋, 評論, 說明
[法] 註釋, 評註, 評論
實況解說
評論；評述
def: n a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material
a spoken description of an event as it happens
an explanation or discussion expressing opinions about something

ex.en: We listened to the football commentary while cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我們一邊做晚飯，一邊聽足球比賽的實況解說。

ex.en: Political commentary can help citizens understand complex policies, but it should be clearly distinguished from factual reporting.
ex.zh: 政治評論可以幫助公民理解複雜政策，但應與事實報道明確區分。

words.tip: commentary常指持續解說或深入評述，不只是單條評論。

tr: n. 評論員, 實況廣播員, 註釋者, 時事評論員
def: n. a writer who reports and analyzes events of the day

tr: vt. 使商業化, 使商品化, 使能營利, 在...發展商業
[經] 使商業化, 使商品化, 在...發展商業
def: v. exploit for maximal profit, usually by sacrificing quality
v. make commercial

tr: v. 混合
def: v. mix or blend

tr: v. 憐憫, 同情
def: v. to feel or express sympathy or compassion

tr: n. 委任狀, 任官令, 所委職責, 佣金, 犯, 委託, 所託之事
vt. 委任, 委託製作, 使服役
委員會
佣金；提成
委託製作；委託開展
def: n. a fee for services rendered based on a percentage of an amount received or collected or agreed to be paid (as distinguished from a salary)
n. the act of granting authority to undertake certain functions
n. the state of being in good working order and ready for operation

ex.en: The gallery commissioned a local artist to paint our harbour.
ex.zh: 美術館委託一位本地畫家描繪我們的港口。

ex.en: An independent commission should investigate housing conditions before the government introduces new safety regulations for rental properties.
ex.zh: 在政府出臺新的出租房安全法規前，獨立委員會應調查住房狀況。

col: commission a report｜委託撰寫報告
commission a painting｜委託創作畫作
words.tip: 作委員會是可數名詞；作佣金常用不可數形式。

tr: vt. 委託(託付), 犯罪, 指派...作戰, 使承擔義務
[法] 犯, 做, 把...交託給
犯（罪或錯誤）
承諾；使承擔義務
投入（資金或資源）
def: v. cause to be admitted; of persons to an institution
v. engage in or perform
To do something illegal or seriously wrong.

ex.en: The police arrested someone who had committed a burglary.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了一名入室盜竊者。

ex.en: Governments must commit sufficient resources to public transport if they want to reduce urban traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 如果政府想緩解城市交通擁堵，就必須向公共交通投入充足的資源。

col: commit to doing something｜承諾做某事
words.tip: commit to中的to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 委託, 交押, 承擔義務, 贊助
[醫] 院禁
投入；奉獻精神
承諾；保證
必須履行的責任
def: n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
n. an engagement by contract involving financial obligation
n. a message that makes a pledge

ex.en: Her commitment to gardening keeps the flowers blooming.
ex.zh: 她用心打理花園，讓鮮花一直盛開。

ex.en: Improving public transport requires sustained political commitment and reliable funding rather than occasional investment in isolated projects.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通需要持續的政治決心和可靠的資金，而非偶爾投資零散項目。

col: commitment to a cause｜對事業的投入
words.tip: commitment to中的to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: a. 寬敞的, 方便的
def: a. large and roomy (`convenient' is archaic in this sense)

tr: n. 農產品, 商品, 有用的物品
[經] 商品, 貨物, 日用品
def: n. articles of commerce

tr: n. 尋常事, 老生常談, 普通的東西
a. 平凡的, 普通的
常見的；平常的
常見事物；老生常談
def: s. completely ordinary and unremarkable
s. not challenging; dull and lacking excitement
Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.

ex.en: Electric bikes are commonplace in our neighbourhood now.
ex.zh: 電動自行車如今在我們社區很常見。

ex.en: Remote working has become commonplace in many industries, changing how companies organise their offices.
ex.zh: 遠程辦公在許多行業已變得普遍，改變了企業安排辦公空間的方式。

words.tip: 多指常見到不足為奇，不一定含貶義。

tr: a. 有常識的, 一望而知的, 明明白白的
符合常識的；明智的
def: s. exhibiting native good judgment
Showing practical judgment based on ordinary experience.

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was a commonsense decision in this weather.
ex.zh: 這種天氣帶傘是個明智的決定。

ex.en: Simple commonsense measures, such as improving street lighting, can make residential areas safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明等簡單而符合常識的措施，可以讓住宅區的行人更加安全。

col: a commonsense approach｜務實合理的方法
commonsense precautions｜合乎常識的預防措施
words.tip: 形容詞也寫作common-sense；名詞common sense分寫。

tr: a. 公有的, 公社的
[法] 公共的, 自治體的, 巴黎公社的
def: s. for or by a group rather than individuals
a. relating to a small administrative district or community

tr: a. 緊湊的, 緊密的, 簡潔的
vt. 使緊密結合, 壓縮
vi. 變堅實
def: n. a small cosmetics case with a mirror; to be carried in a woman's purse
n. a small and economical car
v. have the property of being packable or of compacting easily

tr: n. 比較, 對照, 比喻
[經] 比較, 對比
比較；對照
def: n. the act of examining resemblances
n. relation based on similarities and differences
n. qualities that are comparable

ex.en: A quick comparison helped me choose the cheaper bicycle.
ex.zh: 簡單比較一下後，我選中了更便宜的自行車。

ex.en: A comparison of public transport systems reveals significant differences in cost, reliability and environmental impact.
ex.zh: 對公共交通系統的比較揭示了成本、可靠性和環境影響方面的顯著差異。

words.tip: 兩者之間的比較用comparison between A and B。

tr: n. 指南針, 範圍, 音域
vt. 包圍, 達到, 圖謀, 理解
def: n. navigational instrument for finding directions
n. the limit of capability
n. drafting instrument used for drawing circles

tr: n. 同情, 憐憫
def: n. a deep awareness of and sympathy for another's suffering
n. the humane quality of understanding the suffering of others and wanting to do something about it

tr: a. 慈悲的, 富於同情心的, 照顧性的
vt. 憐憫, 同情
def: a. showing or having compassion

tr: a. 能共處的, 可並立的, 適合的
[計] 相容的; 兼容的
兼容的；可並存的
合得來的
def: a. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination
a. capable of being used with or connected to other devices or components without modification
s. capable of forming a homogeneous mixture that neither separates nor is altered by chemical interaction

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.zh: 這個充電器兼容我們的兩臺平板電腦。

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓勵更清潔的生產方式和負責任的資源利用，經濟增長就能與環境保護並行。

words.tip: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

tr: vt. 強迫, 迫使
迫使；強迫
def: v. force somebody to do something
v. necessitate or exact
to force someone to do something

ex.en: Heavy rain compelled us to cancel our picnic.
ex.zh: 大雨迫使我們取消了野餐。

ex.en: Stricter environmental laws could compel manufacturers to reduce waste and adopt cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 更嚴格的環境法規可能迫使製造商減少廢棄物並採用更清潔的生產方式。

col: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行動
be compelled by circumstances｜為形勢所迫
words.tip: 常用compel sb to do，語氣強且較正式。

tr: a. 強制的, 強迫性的, 激發興趣的
def: s. driving or forcing
s. tending to persuade by forcefulness of argument

tr: n. 綱要, 概略
[電] 簡述
def: n. a concise but comprehensive summary of a larger work

tr: v. 償還, 補償, 付報酬
賠償；補償
彌補；抵消
def: v. adjust for
v. make amends for; pay compensation for
v. make payment to; compensate

ex.en: The airline compensated us for our lost luggage.
ex.zh: 航空公司賠償了我們丟失行李的損失。

ex.en: Governments should compensate farmers for income lost when agricultural land is converted into protected habitats.
ex.zh: 政府應補償農民因農田被改為受保護棲息地而損失的收入。

col: compensate someone for a loss｜賠償某人的損失
compensate for a lack of｜彌補……的不足
words.tip: 賠償某人用compensate sb for sth；彌補用for。

tr: a. 賠償的, 補償的, 代償的
[醫] 代償的, 補償的
def: a. Serving for compensation; making amends.

tr: n. 勝任, 職稱, 能力
[醫] 能力, 活性
def: n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually

tr: vt. 編譯, 編輯, 編纂, 收集
[計] 編譯
彙編；編制
編譯
def: v. use a computer program to translate source code written in a particular programming language into computer-readable machine code that can be executed
Collect information from different sources and arrange it together.
Convert computer code into a form a computer can run.

ex.en: We compiled a playlist for our long train journey.
ex.zh: 我們為漫長的火車旅程整理了一份播放列表。

ex.en: Researchers compiled data from several hospitals to examine the relationship between air pollution and childhood asthma.
ex.zh: 研究人員彙總了多家醫院的數據，以研究空氣汙染與兒童哮喘之間的關係。

words.tip: 強調從不同來源收集並整理，不只是寫作。

tr: n. 滿足, 自鳴得意, 自滿
def: n the feeling you have when you are satisfied with yourself

tr: n. 滿足, 自鳴得意, 自滿
def: n. the feeling you have when you are satisfied with yourself

tr: a. 滿足的, 自滿的, 得意的
def: s. contented to a fault with oneself or one's actions

tr: n. 謙恭, 殷勤, 順從
def: n. a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others

tr: a. 謙恭的, 殷勤的, 順從的
def: s. showing a cheerful willingness to do favors for others

tr: a. 補充的, 補足的
[經] 補足的, 補充的
def: s. of words or propositions so related that each is the negation of the other

tr: n. 遵從, 順從, 屈從
[化] 柔順; 順應
遵守；服從
def: n acting according to certain accepted standards
n a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others
n the act of submitting; usually surrendering power to another

ex.en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
ex.zh: 檢查員查看了我們的廚房是否符合衛生規定。

ex.en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.
ex.zh: 定期檢查可以促進企業遵守環境法規，減少工業設施造成的汙染。

words.tip: 通常不可數；表示遵守某規定時用compliance with。

tr: a. 順從的, 屈從的
[電] 適用於, 配合...使用
def: a. disposed or willing to comply

tr: vt. 弄複雜, 使錯綜, 使惡化
vi. 變複雜
使複雜化；使更難處理
def: v. make more complicated
v. make more complex, intricate, or richer
to make something harder to understand or deal with

ex.en: Changing the date now would only complicate our plans.
ex.zh: 現在改日期只會讓我們的計劃更難安排。

ex.en: Unclear regulations can complicate efforts to establish small businesses, particularly in rapidly developing urban areas.
ex.zh: 不明確的法規會增加創辦小企業的難度，在快速發展的城市地區尤其如此。

col: complicate the situation｜使局勢複雜化
complicate the process｜使過程複雜化
words.tip: 及物動詞，後接被弄複雜的事物。

tr: n. 同謀, 串通, 複雜
[法] 共謀, 共犯關係
def: n. guilt as an accomplice in a crime or offense

tr: n. 稱讚, 恭維, 敬意
vt. 稱讚, 褒揚, 恭維
讚美；稱讚
稱讚；讚美
def: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration
v. say something to someone that expresses praise
v. express respect or esteem for

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她對我廚藝的稱讚讓我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教師若針對學生的具體進步給予表揚，就能增強學習動力，鼓勵他們繼續努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜稱讚某人
compliment someone on something｜稱讚某人的某方面
words.tip: compliment是讚美；complement是補充、相輔相成。

tr: n. 元件, 組件, 成分
a. 組成的, 構成的
[計] 組件
組成部分；零部件
組成的；構成的
def: n. an abstract part of something
n. an artifact that is one of the individual parts of which a composite entity is made up; especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system
One of the parts that together form a whole.

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken component inside my laptop.
ex.zh: 技術員更換了我筆記本電腦裡的一個損壞零件。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is a key component of urban planning that aims to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通是旨在緩解交通擁堵的城市規劃的重要組成部分。

col: a key component｜關鍵組成部分
words.tip: a component of表示“……的組成部分”。

tr: a. 鎮靜的, 沉著的
def: a. serenely self-possessed and free from agitation especially in times of stress

tr: n. 鎮靜, 沉著
def: n. steadiness of mind under stress

tr: n. 混合物, 複合詞, 化合物, 院子
a. 複合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥協
vt. 使複合, 使化合
化合物
def: n. a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts
n. (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight
n. an enclosure of residences and other building (especially in the Orient)

ex.en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的化合物。

ex.en: Poor public transport can compound the difficulties faced by people seeking employment in rural areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便會加重農村地區求職者面臨的困難。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；動詞重音在第二音節。

tr: vt. 理解, 包括
def: v get the meaning of something
v to become aware of through the senses
v include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory

tr: a. 可理解的
def: a. capable of being comprehended or understood

tr: adv. 包括地；包括一切地
def: r. in an all-inclusive manner

tr: vt. 壓縮, 壓緊
vi. 受壓縮小
[計] 壓縮程序
壓縮；壓緊
精簡；濃縮
def: n. a cloth pad or dressing (with or without medication) applied firmly to some part of the body (to relieve discomfort or reduce fever)
v. make more compact by or as if by pressing
v. squeeze or press together

ex.en: She compressed the blankets into a small storage bag.
ex.zh: 她把毯子壓緊，裝進了一個小收納袋。

ex.en: Digital tools can compress large files, allowing students with limited internet access to download educational materials more easily.
ex.zh: 數字工具可以壓縮大文件，讓網絡條件有限的學生更方便地下載學習資料。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞“敷布”重音在前。

tr: n. 妥協, 折中, 折中方案, 和解
vi. 妥協處理
vt. 危害
妥協；折中方案
妥協；折中
def: n. a middle way between two extremes
n. an accommodation in which both sides make concessions
v. make a compromise; arrive at a compromise; we all must compromise"

ex.en: We reached a compromise and shared the last biscuit.
ex.zh: 我們達成了折中方案，分著吃了最後一塊餅乾。

ex.en: Governments must find a compromise between expanding housing supply and protecting green spaces in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 政府必須在增加住房供應和保護人口密集城市的綠地之間找到折中方案。

col: a reasonable compromise｜合理的折中方案
words.tip: compromise on表示在某事上讓步；直接接賓語可表損害。

tr: n. 強迫, 強制
[醫] 強迫
def: n. an urge to do or say something that might be better left undone or unsaid
n. an irrational motive for performing trivial or repetitive actions, even against your will
n. using force to cause something to occur

tr: a. 被強制的, 強迫的, 義務的
[經] 強迫的, 強制的
強制的；必修的
def: s. required by rule
required by a law or rule, rather than optional

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is compulsory at this climbing centre.
ex.zh: 在這家攀巖中心必須戴頭盔。

ex.en: Compulsory education helps ensure that all children acquire basic skills regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 義務教育有助於確保所有兒童都能掌握基本技能，不受家庭收入影響。

words.tip: compulsory強調規定必須做，與optional相對。

tr: n. 良心的責備, 後悔, 悔恨
def: n. a feeling of deep regret (usually for some misdeed)

tr: vt. 精讀, 仔細研究, 默記
adv. 反面地, 從反面
a. 欺詐的
n. 反對者, 反對票, 肺結核
[計] 控制台
def: n. an argument opposed to a proposal
r. in opposition to a proposition, opinion, etc.

tr: vt. 如鎖鏈般連接, 使連鎖, 連結
a. 連鎖的, 連結的
def: v. combine two strings to form a single one
v. add by linking or joining so as to form a chain or series

tr: a. 凹的
[醫] 凹的, 凹面的
def: a. curving inward

tr: vt. 承認, 退讓
vi. 讓步
不情願地承認
讓步；讓予
認輸；承認失敗
def: v. admit (to a wrongdoing)
v. be willing to concede
v. give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another

ex.en: He finally conceded that my route was much quicker.
ex.zh: 他終於承認我選的路線快得多。

ex.en: Although critics concede that tourism creates jobs, they argue that its environmental costs are often overlooked.
ex.zh: 儘管批評者承認旅遊業創造就業，他們仍認為其環境代價常被忽視。

col: concede a point｜承認對方某點有理
words.tip: 常含原本反對、後來不得不承認的意味。

tr: n. 自負, 空想, 狂妄
def: n. an elaborate poetic image or a far-fetched comparison of very dissimilar things
n. a witty or ingenious turn of phrase
n. an artistic device or effect

tr: vt. 構思, 認為
vi. 懷孕
構思；設想
懷孕；受孕
def: v. become pregnant; undergo conception
to form an idea or imagine something
to become pregnant or cause a baby to begin developing

ex.en: She conceived the idea while walking through the park.
ex.zh: 她在公園散步時想出了這個主意。

ex.en: Urban planners must conceive new ways of accommodating population growth without sacrificing green spaces or affordable housing.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者必須構思新方法，在不犧牲綠地或保障性住房的前提下應對人口增長。

col: conceive an idea｜構思一個主意
words.tip: conceive an idea指構思；conceive of指設想。

tr: n. 濃縮, 精選
v. 集中, 專心
集中注意力
集中；聚集
濃縮物；濃縮液
def: n. a concentrated form of a foodstuff; the bulk is reduced by removing water
n. a concentrated example of something
v. make denser, stronger, or purer

ex.en: I cannot concentrate with the television playing so loudly.
ex.zh: 電視聲音這麼大，我沒法集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府應將資源集中於預防性醫療，以長期減輕醫院的壓力。

col: concentrate on a task｜專注於任務
concentrate resources on｜將資源集中於
words.tip: concentrate on後接名詞或動名詞，表示專注於。

tr: n. 集中, 專心
[化] 濃度; 濃縮
專注；專心
濃度
集中；聚集
def: n. the strength of a solution; number of molecules of a substance in a given volume
n. the spatial property of being crowded together
n. strengthening the concentration (as of a solute in a mixture) by removing diluting material

ex.en: The constant noise outside made concentration difficult for me.
ex.zh: 外面持續不斷的噪聲讓我難以集中注意力。

ex.en: High concentrations of air pollutants near busy roads can pose serious health risks to residents.
ex.zh: 繁忙道路附近高濃度的空氣汙染物可能嚴重危害居民健康。

col: a high concentration of｜高濃度的；大量集中的
a concentration of wealth｜財富集中
words.tip: 專注通常不可數；某物的濃度用concentration of。

tr: a. 概念的
[醫] 概念的
def: s. being or characterized by concepts or their formation

tr: n. 特許, 讓步, 認可
[經] 核准, 許可, 特殊(權)
讓步；妥協
優惠；減價
特許經營權
def: n. a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business
n. the act of conceding or yielding
n. a point conceded or yielded

ex.en: We made a concession and agreed to leave earlier.
ex.zh: 我們作出讓步，同意早點離開。

ex.en: Offering concessions to students and older people can make public transport more affordable for these groups.
ex.zh: 向學生和老年人提供優惠，可以讓這些群體更負擔得起公共交通費用。

words.tip: make concessions表示讓步；英式英語中也指票價優惠。

tr: vt. 安撫, 說服, 博得...的支持, 調和
[法] 調解, 安撫, 撫慰
def: v cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
v come to terms
v make (one thing) compatible with (another)

tr: a. 安撫的, 和好的, 調和的
def: a. intended to placate

tr: n. 妥貼安排, 優美, 和諧
def: n. Internal harmony or fitness; mutual adaptation of
parts; elegance; -- used chiefly of style of discourse.

tr: a. 簡潔的, 簡明的
簡明扼要的
def: a. expressing much in few words
Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.

ex.en: Her concise directions helped us find the station easily.
ex.zh: 她簡明的指路說明讓我們輕鬆找到了車站。

ex.en: Clear and concise public health advice enables people to understand risks and make informed decisions quickly.
ex.zh: 清晰簡明的公共衛生建議使人們能夠了解風險，並迅速作出明智決定。

words.tip: 不僅指短，還強調信息清楚且無贅述。

tr: a. 決定性的, 確定性的, 最後的
[法] 決定性的, 不容置疑的, 確實的
確鑿的；決定性的
def: a. forming an end or termination; especially putting an end to doubt or question
proving something clearly and leaving no reasonable doubt

ex.en: The camera footage provided conclusive proof of what happened.
ex.zh: 攝像機拍下的畫面為事情的經過提供了確鑿證據。

ex.en: Researchers need conclusive evidence before recommending major changes to national policies on childhood nutrition.
ex.zh: 研究人員在建議大幅調整國家兒童營養政策之前，需要獲得確鑿證據。

words.tip: 常修飾evidence或proof，不等於“最後的”。

tr: n. 調製, 調合, 調合物
[醫] 加熱合劑(藥物); 消化
def: n. any foodstuff made by combining different ingredients
n. an occurrence of an unusual mixture
n. the invention of a scheme or story to suit some purpose

tr: a. 相伴的, 伴隨的, 共存的
n. 伴隨物
def: n an event or situation that happens at the same time as or in connection with another
s following or accompanying as a consequence

tr: n. 一致, 和睦, 協定
def: n. capital of the state of New Hampshire; located in south central New Hampshire on the Merrimack river
n. town in eastern Massachusetts near Boston where the first battle of the American Revolution was fought
v. arrange by concord or agreement

tr: n. 同時發生的事件
a. 同時發生的, 一致的
[計] 並行的; 併發的; 同時發生的; 共行的
同時發生的；並行的
def: s occurring or operating at the same time
Happening or existing at the same time

ex.en: Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
ex.zh: 兩個會議同時舉行，我只能選擇參加其中一個。

ex.en: Concurrent improvements in housing and public transport can make urban development more inclusive and sustainable.
ex.zh: 同步改善住房和公共交通，可以使城市發展更具包容性和可持續性。

words.tip: 強調時間重疊；表示“與…同時”可用concurrent with。

tr: vt. 判刑, 責備, 譴責
[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪
譴責
判處刑罰
宣告建築不宜使用
def: v. express strong disapproval of
v. declare or judge unfit for use or habitation
v. compel or force into a particular state or activity

ex.en: Our neighbours condemned the dumping of rubbish beside the river.
ex.zh: 鄰居們譴責了在河邊傾倒垃圾的行為。

ex.en: Environmental organisations condemn illegal logging because it destroys wildlife habitats and threatens the livelihoods of local communities.
ex.zh: 環保組織譴責非法伐木，因為它破壞野生動物棲息地，並威脅當地社區的生計。

col: condemn someone to prison｜判某人入獄
condemn a building｜宣告建築不宜使用
words.tip: 詞尾n不發音；別與表示“冷凝”的condense混淆。

tr: n. 非難, 宣告有罪, 非難的理由
強烈譴責
判刑；宣告不宜使用
def: n. (law) the act of condemning (as land forfeited for public use) or judging to be unfit for use (as a food product or an unsafe building)
n. the condition of being strongly disapproved of
An expression of strong disapproval

ex.en: His cruel remarks drew condemnation from everyone at dinner.
ex.zh: 他刻薄的話遭到了所有同桌用餐者的譴責。

ex.en: The destruction of protected forests has attracted widespread condemnation from environmental groups and local communities.
ex.zh: 破壞受保護森林的行為引起了環保團體和當地社區的廣泛譴責。

col: condemnation of violence｜對暴力的譴責
words.tip: 常用condemnation of sth；比criticism語氣更強。

tr: vt. 使濃縮, 使壓縮, 縮短
vi. 濃縮, 凝結

v. remove water from
v. cause a gas or vapor to change into a liquid

tr: vi. 謙遜, 屈就, 墮落

tr: vt. 赦, 寬恕

def: v excuse, overlook, or make allowances for; be lenient with

tr: a. 有益於...的, 有助於...的, 助長的
def: s. tending to bring about; being partly responsible for

商議；協商
授予；賦予
def: v. have a conference in order to talk something over
v. present
Discuss something with others before making a decision.

ex.en: The coaches conferred quietly before choosing the final team.
ex.zh: 教練們低聲商議後才確定最終的隊伍陣容。

ex.en: Universities often confer honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to science or public service.
ex.zh: 大學常向在科學或公共服務領域作出傑出貢獻的人士授予榮譽學位。

col: confer a degree on someone｜授予某人學位
words.tip: 商議用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

tr: v. 承認, 坦白, 懺悔, 供認
坦白；供認
承認難以啟齒的事
def: v. confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure
v. confess to God in the presence of a priest, as in the Catholic faith
to admit doing something wrong or illegal

ex.en: I confessed to eating the last slice of cake.
ex.zh: 我坦白自己吃掉了最後一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: Students may be more willing to confess their mistakes when teachers respond calmly and offer constructive guidance.
ex.zh: 如果教師冷靜回應並給予建設性指導，學生可能更願意坦白自己的錯誤。

col: confess to doing something｜坦白做過某事
words.tip: confess to中的to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 心腹朋友, 知己
def: n. someone to whom private matters are confided

tr: vt. 吐露, 委託
vi. 信賴
def: v. reveal in private; tell confidentially

tr: a. 機密的, 獲他人信賴的, 易於信任他人的
[經] 秘密件
機密的；保密的
def: s. entrusted with private information and the confidence of another
s. (of information) given in confidence or in secret
s. denoting confidence or intimacy

ex.en: Please keep this confidential until I tell my family.
ex.zh: 在我告訴家人之前，請對此保密。

ex.en: Hospitals must protect confidential patient information to maintain public trust in the healthcare system.
ex.zh: 醫院必須保護患者的保密信息，以維持公眾對醫療體系的信任。

words.tip: confidential指保密的；confident指有信心的。

tr: adv. 自信地；安心地
def: r. with confidence; in a confident manner

tr: n. 結構, 表面配置, 外形, 配置
[計] 配置
def: n. an arrangement of parts or elements

tr: vt. 沒收, 把...充公, 查抄
a. 被沒收的
def: s. surrendered as a penalty

tr: vt. 合併；異文合併
def: v mix together different elements

tr: n. 戰鬥, 衝突, 矛盾, 爭執

[計] 衝突
衝突；爭執
矛盾；牴觸
def: n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
n. opposition between two simultaneous but incompatible feelings
n. a state of opposition between persons or ideas or interests

ex.en: Sharing a bedroom sometimes causes conflict between the brothers.
ex.zh: 共用一間臥室有時會讓兄弟倆發生爭執。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 當工業高度依賴化石燃料時，經濟增長可能與環境保護相沖突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益衝突
words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節，動詞重音在第二音節。

tr: n. 遵照, 適合, 一致, 相似
[計] 符合度
遵從；從眾
def: n. correspondence in form or appearance
n. acting according to certain accepted standards
n. orthodoxy in thoughts and belief

ex.en: Our art teacher encourages creativity rather than strict conformity.
ex.zh: 我們的美術老師鼓勵創造，而不是一味墨守成規。

ex.en: Strong pressure for conformity in schools may discourage students from questioning established ideas and developing independent judgement.
ex.zh: 學校裡強烈的從眾壓力可能阻礙學生質疑既有觀念和培養獨立判斷力。

col: pressure for conformity｜要求一致的壓力
words.tip: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某規則。

tr: vt. 使混淆, 使狼狽, 挫敗

v mistake one thing for another

tr: vt. 使面對, 對抗, 遭遇, 使對質, 比較
[法] 對證, 使對質, 比較
面對；正視
當面對質；質問
def: v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition
v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
v. present somebody with something, usually to accuse or criticize

ex.en: She finally confronted her fear and entered the swimming pool.
ex.zh: 她終於直面恐懼，走進了游泳池。

ex.en: Cities must confront the challenges of an ageing population by improving housing, healthcare, and public transport.
ex.zh: 城市必須通過改善住房、醫療和公共交通來應對人口老齡化的挑戰。

col: confront someone about something｜就某事質問某人
words.tip: 直接接問題；be confronted with表示面臨。

tr: n. 對抗；對質；面對
def: n. a bold challenge
n. discord resulting from a clash of ideas or opinions
n. a hostile disagreement face-to-face

tr: n. 混亂, 混淆, 無秩序
[計] 含混
困惑；不明白
混淆；混亂
def: n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably
n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
n. a feeling of embarrassment that leaves you confused

ex.en: He stared at the unfamiliar controls in confusion.
ex.zh: 他困惑地盯著那些陌生的控制裝置。

ex.en: Clear instructions can reduce confusion among patients and help them take their medication safely.
ex.zh: 清晰的說明能減少患者的困惑，幫助他們安全服藥。

words.tip: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

tr: v. (使)凍結, (使)凝結
def: v become gelatinous

s. (used of plants) capable of cross-fertilization or of being grafted

tr: n. 適合, 一致, 共同點
def: n. the quality of agreeing; being suitable and appropriate

tr: a. 一致的, 適合的, 符合的
def: a. corresponding in character or kind
s. suitable or appropriate together

tr: n. 松柏目植物, 針葉樹
def: n. any gymnospermous tree or shrub bearing cones

def: v. encourage or assent to illegally or criminally

tr: vt. 克服, 征服, 戰勝
vi. 得勝
征服；攻佔
克服；戰勝
def: v. overcome by conquest
Take control of a country or place by force.
Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.

ex.en: She conquered her fear and climbed onto the diving board.
ex.zh: 她克服了恐懼，爬上了跳板。

ex.en: Throughout history, powerful states have sought to conquer neighbouring territories to gain resources and expand their influence.
ex.zh: 縱觀歷史，強大的國家一直試圖征服鄰近領土，以獲取資源並擴大影響力。

col: conquer a territory｜征服一片領土
conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語：conquer a fear。

tr: n. 良心
[法] 良心, 道德感, 正義感
良心；道德感
內疚；愧疚感
def: n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions
n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct
n. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral

ex.en: My conscience told me to return the lost wallet.
ex.zh: 我的良心告訴我應該歸還撿到的錢包。

ex.en: Consumers may struggle with their conscience when buying cheap products made under poor working conditions.
ex.zh: 購買在惡劣勞動條件下生產的廉價商品時，消費者可能會感到良心不安。

col: a matter of conscience｜良心問題
words.tip: conscience是良心；conscious是有意識的。

tr: a. 有責任心的, 負責的, 本著良心的
[法] 憑良心做的, 有道德感的
認真負責的；盡責的
def: s. characterized by extreme care and great effort
a. guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
Careful to do duties thoroughly and correctly

ex.en: Our conscientious neighbour checks our plants every morning.
ex.zh: 我們認真負責的鄰居每天早晨都會查看我們的植物。

ex.en: Conscientious employees contribute to workplace safety by following procedures carefully and reporting potential hazards promptly.
ex.zh: 盡責的員工通過認真遵守規程並及時報告潛在危險，為工作場所安全作出貢獻。

col: conscientious about your work｜對工作認真負責
words.tip: conscientious是認真負責的；conscious是有意識的。

tr: n. 意識, 知覺, 自覺
[醫] (有)意識, 清醒
清醒狀態；知覺
意識；認識
def: n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings
Awareness or understanding of a particular issue or situation

ex.en: He regained consciousness shortly after the ambulance arrived.
ex.zh: 救護車到達後不久，他就恢復了知覺。

ex.en: Environmental education can raise public consciousness of how everyday consumption affects natural resources and biodiversity.
ex.zh: 環境教育可以提高公眾對日常消費如何影響自然資源和生物多樣性的認識。

words.tip: consciousness指意識或知覺；conscience指良心。

tr: a. 被徵入伍的, 被徵召的
n. 徵兵
vt. 徵召
def: v. enroll into service compulsorily

a. 被獻給神的, 神聖的
def: v. render holy by means of religious rites

tr: a. 連續的, 聯貫的
[計] 連續的; 連接的
連續的；接連的
def: s. in regular succession without gaps
r. in a consecutive manner
following one after another without any interruption

ex.en: It has rained for five consecutive days this week.
ex.zh: 這週已經連續下了五天雨。

ex.en: Several consecutive years of low rainfall have reduced agricultural output and increased pressure on regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 連續數年的降雨偏少導致農業產量下降，並加大了地區供水壓力。

col: for three consecutive years｜連續三年
words.tip: 強調一個接一個、中間無間斷，常修飾天數或次數。

tr: n. 合意, 一致, 同感
[計] 合意
共識；普遍一致的意見
def: n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
ex.zh: 我們終於就去哪裡吃飯達成了共識。

ex.en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 研究人員普遍認為，幼兒教育能改善兒童未來的學習成效。

words.tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共識未必全票一致。

tr: n. 同意, 許可
vi. 同意, 贊同
def: n. permission to do something

tr: a. 作為結果的, 隨之發生的, 推論的, 間接的, 重大的, 自大的, 傲慢的, 自傲的
[法] 結果的, 相應而生的, 接著發生的
def: s. having important issues or results

tr: n. 蜜餞, 果醬
vt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恆
節約；避免浪費
保護；保存
def: n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar
v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction

ex.en: We collect rainwater to conserve water in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們收集雨水，以節約花園用水。

ex.en: Governments should encourage efficient farming methods that conserve water without reducing the supply of affordable food.
ex.zh: 政府應鼓勵高效的耕作方式，在節水的同時保障平價食品的供應。

words.tip: conserve強調節約或保護；reserve強調預留。

tr: a. 相當的, 可觀的, 重要的
相當大的；相當多的
def: a. large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
Large in amount, size, or degree.

ex.en: Repairing the roof took considerable time and effort.
ex.zh: 修理屋頂花了相當多的時間和精力。

ex.en: Expanding public transport requires considerable investment, but it can reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 擴大公共交通需要大量投資，但可以緩解擁堵並改善城市空氣質量。

words.tip: considerable指數量或程度大；considerate指體貼的。

tr: vt. 交付, 儲蓄, 委託, 寄存
[經] 託賣, 寄存, 寄銷
def: v. commit forever; commit irrevocably
v. give over to another for care or safekeeping
v. send to an address

tr: vt. 安慰, 藉慰
n. 控制台
[計] 控制台
安慰；慰藉
控制台；遊戲機
def: n. a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
n. an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)
To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.

ex.en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
ex.zh: 弟弟的球隊輸了比賽後，莉娜試著安慰他。

ex.en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.
ex.zh: 教師應安慰失落的學生，同時幫助他們制定切實可行的策略來提高學習成績。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

tr: vt. 鞏固, 使聯合, 統一
vi. 鞏固
[計] 合併計算
鞏固；加強
合併；整合
def: v. unite into one
v. make firm or secure; strengthen
v. bring together into a single whole or system

ex.en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
ex.zh: 我每晚複習筆記，以鞏固所學內容。

ex.en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 定期的實踐練習有助於學生鞏固知識，並將理論概念應用於陌生情境。

words.tip: 既可指鞏固已有成果，也可指合併多個部分。

tr: n. 一致, 調和, 輔音韻
[醫] 諧和

n. the property of sounding harmonious

輔音；輔音字母
一致的；相符的
def: n. a speech sound that is not a vowel
n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken consonant
s. involving or characterized by harmony

ex.en: Try saying the final consonant slowly and clearly.
ex.zh: 試著把最後一個輔音發得緩慢而清晰。

ex.en: Learners may struggle to pronounce consonant clusters that do not occur in their first language.
ex.zh: 學習者可能難以發出母語中不存在的輔音群。

words.tip: 作形容詞較正式，常用consonant with表示相符。

v. keep company with; hang out with

顯眼的；引人注目的
def: a. obvious to the eye or mind
easy to notice because of being unusual or different

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella was conspicuous among the black ones.
ex.zh: 在一片黑色雨傘中，她的黃色雨傘格外顯眼。

ex.en: Conspicuous consumption can encourage unnecessary spending as people seek to display their wealth through expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 炫耀性消費可能助長不必要的開支，因為人們試圖通過昂貴物品展示財富。

col: conspicuous by its absence｜因缺失而格外引人注意
words.tip: 強調容易被注意到，不一定表示重要。

ex.zh: 警方發現了一起盜竊珍貴畫作的陰謀。

ex.en: False conspiracy theories can spread rapidly online, weakening public trust in scientific institutions.
ex.zh: 虛假的陰謀論會在網上迅速傳播，削弱公眾對科研機構的信任。

col: conspiracy to commit fraud｜實施詐騙的共謀

n. a number representing a quantity assumed to have a fixed value in a specified mathematical context
a. steadfast in purpose or devotion or affection

ex.en: The constant noise outside kept me awake all night.
ex.zh: 外面持續不斷的噪聲讓我整夜無法入睡。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建築保持恆溫可以提高舒適度，但可能增加能源消耗。

words.tip: 可指持續發生，也可指數值不變，須看語境。

tr: n. 星座, 薈萃
[化] 構象
def: n. a configuration of stars as seen from the earth

tr: n. 驚愕, 恐怖, 驚惶失措
def: n fear resulting from the awareness of danger

tr: n. 成分, 選民, 構成物
a. 構成的, 組織的, 選舉的
選區居民；選民
組成部分；成分
組成的；構成的
def: n. a member of a constituency; a citizen who is represented in a government by officials for whom he or she votes
n. (grammar) a word or phrase or clause forming part of a larger grammatical construction
s. constitutional in the structure of something (especially your physical makeup)

ex.en: A constituent asked her local representative about the closed library.
ex.zh: 一位選區居民向當地民意代表詢問圖書館關閉的事。

ex.en: Elected representatives should consult their constituents before supporting policies that significantly affect local housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 民選代表在支持對當地住房和公共交通有重大影響的政策之前，應徵詢選區居民的意見。

words.tip: 選民義可含未投票的選區居民；成分義近component。

tr: vt. 構成, 組成, 任命
[建] 構造, 組成
組成；構成
算作；構成
正式設立
def: v. form or compose
To be the parts that form a whole
To be considered a particular thing

ex.en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
ex.zh: 我們冰箱裡的食物大部分是蔬菜。

ex.en: Rising housing costs constitute a major barrier to financial independence for young adults in large cities.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的住房成本構成了大城市年輕人實現經濟獨立的一大障礙。

col: constitute a committee｜正式成立委員會
words.tip: 表組成時通常以部分作主語，整體作賓語。

tr: n. 構成, 憲法, 體格
[醫] 體質; 結構, 組織
def: n. the act of forming or establishing something
n. the way in which someone or something is composed

n. a United States 44-gun frigate that was one of the first three naval ships built by the United States; it won brilliant victories over British frigates during the War of 1812 and is without doubt the most famous ship in the history of the United States Navy; it has been rebuilt and is anchored in the Charlestown Navy Yard in Boston

tr: vt. 強迫, 限制, 關押
def: v hold back
v restrict

tr: vt. 壓縮, 束緊, 使收縮
vi. 收縮
def: v. become tight or as if tight

tr: vt. 構造, 建造, 對...進行構思, 作圖
n. 構成物
建造；構築
構思；組織
def: v. make by combining materials and parts
v. draw with suitable instruments and under specified conditions
v. create by linking linguistic units

ex.en: Workers are constructing a wooden bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 工人們正在小溪上建造一座木橋。

ex.en: Students should learn to construct clear arguments supported by reliable evidence rather than personal assumptions.
ex.zh: 學生應學會用可靠證據而非個人臆斷來構建清晰的論證。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞construct重音在前。

tr: n. 建築, 構造, 建築物
[化] 施工
建設；建造
建造物；構造物
語法結構
def: n. the act of constructing something
n. a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit
n. the creation of a construct; the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought

ex.en: Construction of the new bridge started early this morning.
ex.zh: 新橋的建設今天一早開始了。

ex.en: The construction of energy-efficient housing can reduce household bills and limit the environmental impact of urban growth.
ex.zh: 建設節能住宅可以降低家庭賬單支出，並減少城市擴張對環境的影響。

words.tip: 表示建造過程時不可數；under construction指在建。

tr: a. 建設性的, 構造上的
[醫] 構成的
def: a. constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development
s. emphasizing what is laudable or hopeful or to the good

tr: vt. 解釋, 分析, 對...逐字直譯
vi. 作句法分析
n. 直譯
理解；解釋
def: v make sense of; assign a meaning to
To understand a statement or action in a particular way.

ex.en: Please don't construe my silence as a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 請不要把我的沉默理解為不感興趣。

ex.en: A failure to consult local residents may be construed as disregard for their concerns about urban development.
ex.zh: 未徵詢當地居民的意見，可能被理解為漠視他們對城市發展的擔憂。

col: construe something as｜將某事理解為
be construed as criticism｜被理解為批評
words.tip: 常用construe A as B，表示“把A理解為B”。

tr: n. 領事, 執政官
[經] 領事
領事
def: n. a diplomat appointed by a government to protect its commercial interests and help its citizens in a foreign country
An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

ex.en: The consul helped us after we lost our passports.
ex.zh: 我們丟失護照後，領事給我們提供了幫助。

ex.en: A consul may support citizens facing difficulties overseas and help strengthen commercial links between countries.
ex.zh: 領事可以為在海外遇到困難的本國公民提供支持，並幫助加強國家間的商業聯繫。

words.tip: consul是領事；consulate是領事館，勿混淆。

tr: vi. 商討, 商量, 協商, 會診
vt. 向...請教, 查閱, 考慮
def: v. get or ask advice from
v. seek information from
v. advise professionally

tr: vt. 完成, 使完美
a. 無上的, 至上的, 完美的
def: v. fulfill sexually
v. make perfect; bring to perfection
s. having or revealing supreme mastery or skill

tr: n. 消費, 消費量, 癆病
[化] 消耗量; 耗量
消耗；消費
食用；飲用；攝入量
def: n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)
n. (economics) the utilization of economic goods to satisfy needs or in manufacturing
n. the act of consuming something

ex.en: Our electricity consumption rises when we use the heater.
ex.zh: 使用暖氣時，我們的用電量就會上升。

ex.en: Governments can reduce fossil fuel consumption by investing in reliable public transport and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過投資可靠的公共交通和可再生能源，減少化石燃料消耗。

col: fit for human consumption｜適合人類食用
words.tip: 通常不可數；消費的人是consumer，不是consumption。

tr: n. 聯繫, 交際, 熟人, 接觸
vi. 接觸, 聯繫
vt. 使接觸
聯繫；接觸
聯繫；聯絡
def: n. close interaction
n. the act of touching physically
n. the state or condition of touching or of being in immediate proximity

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丟了鑰匙，請聯繫接待員。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 經常與家人聯繫可以減輕獨居老年人的孤獨感。

col: keep in contact with｜與……保持聯繫
words.tip: 動詞contact直接接人，不加with；名詞後可加with。

tr: a. 觸染性的, 會蔓延的
[醫] (接)觸(傳)染的
def: s. easily diffused or spread as from one person to another

tr: vt. 包含, 容納, 控制
vi. 自制
含有；容納
控制；遏制
def: v. be divisible by
v. be capable of holding or containing
to have something inside or as a part

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
ex.zh: 這個小盒子裡裝著我所有的縫紉用品。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量鹽分，可能導致嚴重的健康問題。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；表示“含有”時通常不用進行時。

tr: n. 抑制, 牽制, 遏制
[法] 抑制, 牽制, 遏制
def: n. a policy of creating strategic alliances in order to check the expansion of a hostile power or ideology or to force it to negotiate peacefully
n. (physics) a system designed to prevent the accidental release of radioactive material from a reactor
n. the act of containing; keeping something from spreading

tr: vt. 弄汙, 弄髒, 汙染, 毒害
[化] 汙染
汙染；使受汙染
def: v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances

ex.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food while you cook.
ex.zh: 做飯時，不乾淨的手可能會汙染食物。

ex.en: Industrial chemicals can contaminate groundwater, threatening both agricultural production and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 工業化學品可能汙染地下水，威脅農業生產及附近社區居民的健康。

col: contaminated with chemicals｜受到化學品汙染
words.tip: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物汙染。

tr: vt. 注視, 沉思, 盤算
vi. 冥思苦想
認真考慮；深思
考慮做；打算
凝視；端詳
def: v. look at thoughtfully; observe deep in thought
v. consider as a possibility
to think carefully about something for a long time

ex.en: She sat beside the lake, contemplating her next move.
ex.zh: 她坐在湖邊，認真考慮下一步該怎麼辦。

ex.en: Before expanding public transport, planners should contemplate how proposed routes will affect existing communities.
ex.zh: 在擴展公共交通之前，規劃者應仔細考慮擬議線路會如何影響現有社區。

col: contemplate a change｜考慮作出改變
words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞，不接to do。

tr: n. 注視, 沉思, 盤算
[法] 默察, 意圖, 期待
沉思；深思
考慮；打算
def: n. a long and thoughtful observation
n. a calm, lengthy, intent consideration
the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something

ex.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
ex.zh: 他坐在湖邊，靜靜地沉思。

ex.en: Public gardens offer urban residents valuable opportunities for quiet contemplation away from the pressures of daily life.
ex.zh: 公共花園為城市居民提供寶貴的機會，讓他們遠離日常生活的壓力，靜心沉思。

words.tip: 通常不可數；強調安靜深思，不一定是痛苦思索。

tr: a. 沉思的, 愛默想的, 冥想的
[醫] 沉思的
def: n. a person devoted to the contemplative life

tr: n. 同時代的人
a. 同時代的, 屬於同一時期的
當代的；現代的
同時代的；同期的
同時代的人；同輩
def: n. a person of nearly the same age as another
s. characteristic of the present
s. belonging to the present time

ex.en: The gallery displays contemporary paintings in bright, spacious rooms.
ex.zh: 這家畫廊在明亮寬敞的展廳裡陳列當代繪畫。

ex.en: Contemporary architecture increasingly incorporates natural materials to reduce environmental impact and improve the wellbeing of occupants.
ex.zh: 當代建築越來越多地採用天然材料，以減少環境影響並改善居住者的身心健康。

col: a contemporary of someone｜與某人同時代的人
words.tip: 當代藝術中指“當代”；歷史語境也可指“當時的”。

tr: n. 輕視, 輕蔑
[法] 藐視, 侮辱, 輕視
輕蔑；鄙視
藐視法庭
def: n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
n. open disrespect for a person or thing

ex.en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
ex.zh: 他用嘲笑來表示對我建議的輕蔑。

ex.en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.
ex.zh: 當官員輕視公眾的關切時，人們對民主制度的信任可能顯著下降。

col: treat someone with contempt｜輕蔑地對待某人
words.tip: contempt for指鄙視某人或某事；通常不可數。

tr: a. 卑鄙的, 可輕蔑的, 不足掛齒的
def: a. deserving of contempt or scorn

tr: a. 輕蔑的, 鄙視的, 瞧不起人的
輕蔑的；鄙視的
def: s. expressing extreme contempt
showing that you consider someone or something unworthy of respect

ex.en: She gave my muddy shoes a contemptuous glance.
ex.zh: 她輕蔑地瞥了一眼我沾滿泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Leaders who are contemptuous of public concerns risk damaging trust in the institutions they represent.
ex.zh: 輕視公眾關切的領導者可能損害公眾對其所代表機構的信任。

words.tip: contemptuous是鄙視人的；contemptible是可鄙的。

tr: vi. 奮鬥, 鬥爭, 競爭
vt. 為...鬥爭
主張；認為
應對；與……鬥爭
競爭；爭奪
def: v. maintain or assert
v. be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight
To argue that something is true.

ex.en: I contend that our kitchen needs a bigger table.
ex.zh: 我認為我們的廚房需要一張更大的桌子。

ex.en: Some researchers contend that affordable public transport is more effective than road expansion in reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 一些研究者認為，在緩解城市擁堵方面，價格合理的公共交通比擴建道路更有效。

col: contend for the title｜爭奪冠軍
words.tip: contend that表主張；with接困難；for接爭奪目標。

tr: n. 內容, 滿足, 意義, 要旨
a. 滿足的, 滿意的
vt. 使...滿足, 使...安心
[計] 內容
內容；含量
def: n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something
n. the proportion of a substance that is contained in a mixture or alloy etc.
n. the sum or range of what has been perceived, discovered, or learned

ex.en: The content of this podcast always makes me laugh.
ex.zh: 這個播客的內容總能讓我笑起來。

ex.en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
ex.zh: 學校應教學生批判性地評估網絡內容，而不是把每一種說法都當作可靠信息。

col: content yourself with｜使自己滿足於
words.tip: 名詞重音在前，形容詞和動詞在後；目錄用contents。

tr: a. 滿足的, 心安的
def: a. satisfied or showing satisfaction with things as they are

tr: n. 爭論, 爭辯, 所持的論點
[計] 爭用
def: n. a point asserted as part of an argument

tr: a. 好爭吵的, 愛爭論的, 有異議的
[法] 訴訟的, 爭執的, 引起爭論的
def: s. inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits
s. involving or likely to cause controversy

tr: n. 競賽, 爭論
vt. 競爭, 爭取, 爭辯
vi. 競爭
比賽；競爭
質疑；對……提出異議
def: n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
n. a struggle between rivals
v. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐憑她做的檸檬蛋糕贏得了烘焙比賽。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望對官方決定提出異議時，應能獲得價格合理的法律諮詢。

col: a close contest｜勢均力敵的比賽
contest a decision｜對決定提出異議
words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；動詞重音在第二音節。

tr: n. 上下文, 背景, 來龍去脈
n. 上下文
[計] 上下文
背景；具體環境
上下文；語境
def: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it.

ex.en: Her silence made sense once I understood the context.
ex.zh: 瞭解背景後，我就明白她為什麼沉默了。

ex.en: Historical events should be examined in their social context rather than judged solely by contemporary standards.
ex.zh: 研究歷史事件應結合其社會背景，而非僅以當代標準評判。

col: in context｜結合背景；在語境中
words.tip: out of context指脫離語境，常用於斷章取義。

tr: a. 鄰近的, 接近的
[醫] 接觸的
def: s. very close or connected in space or time

tr: a. 大陸的, 洲的
n. 歐洲大陸人
def: a. of or pertaining to or typical of Europe
a. of or relating to or concerning the American colonies during and immediately after the American Revolutionary War
a. of or relating to or characteristic of a continent

tr: n. 繼續, 續集, 補編
[醫] 連續
def: n the act of continuing an activity without interruption
n a part added to a book or play that continues and extends it
n a Gestalt principle of organization holding that there is an innate tendency to perceive a line as continuing its established direction

tr: vt. 扭彎, 曲解
vi. 扭彎
def: v. twist and press out of shape

tr: vt. 反駁, 與...牴觸, 與...矛盾
vi. 反駁
與……矛盾；相牴觸
反駁；否認某人的話
def: v. be in contradiction with
v. deny the truth of
To be inconsistent with another statement, fact, or piece of evidence.

ex.en: Your muddy shoes contradict your claim about staying indoors.
ex.zh: 你說自己一直待在室內，但你鞋上的泥可不是這麼回事。

ex.en: Recent findings contradict the assumption that longer working hours necessarily lead to higher levels of productivity.
ex.zh: 近期研究結果與“工作時間越長，生產效率必然越高”的假設相矛盾。

col: contradict a claim｜與某一說法矛盾
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接人或說法；無需加with。

tr: a. 反駁的, 反對的, 抗辯的
n. 矛盾因素, 對立物
def: n. two propositions are contradictories if both cannot be true (or both cannot be false) at the same time
s. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true and both cannot be false
s. unable to be both true at the same time

tr: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 對立的
n. 相反, 對立面
adv. 相反地
相反的；相違背的
相反的情況
def: n. exact opposition
n. a logical relation such that two propositions are contraries if both cannot be true but both can be false
s. very opposed in nature or character or purpose

ex.en: Contrary to the forecast, sunshine filled our garden.
ex.zh: 與天氣預報相反，陽光灑滿了我們的花園。

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, expanding road networks does not always reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
ex.zh: 與普遍看法相反，擴大道路網絡並不總能緩解大城市的交通擁堵。

col: to the contrary｜表明相反情況的
words.tip: on the contrary用於糾正前述觀點，意為恰恰相反。

tr: vt. 違反, 觸犯, 否認, 反駁, 牴觸, 與...衝突
[法] 觸法, 違反, 否定
def: v go against, as of rules and laws
v deny the truth of

tr: a. 悔悟了的, 後悔的, 痛悔的
def: s. feeling or expressing pain or sorrow for sins or offenses

tr: n. 完全悔悟, 悔改, 悔罪
def: n sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation

tr: v. 發明, 設計, 圖謀
設法做到
巧妙謀劃；設計
def: v make or work out a plan for; devise
v come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
v put or send forth

ex.en: We contrived to fit every suitcase into the tiny car.
ex.zh: 我們設法把所有行李箱都塞進了那輛小汽車。

ex.en: Despite limited funding, the research team contrived to develop an affordable device for monitoring water quality.
ex.zh: 儘管資金有限，研究團隊仍設法開發出一種價格低廉的水質監測設備。

col: contrive to do something｜設法做成某事
contrive a plan｜巧妙制定計劃
words.tip: contrive to do表示設法做到；contrived常指刻意不自然。

tr: n. 控制, 管理, 剋制, 控制器, 操縱裝置
vt. 控制, 操縱, 抑制
[計] 控制; 控制器
控制；管理
控制；管理；抑制
def: n. power to direct or determine
n. a relation of constraint of one entity (thing or person or group) by another
n. (physiology) regulation or maintenance of a function or action or reflex etc

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓緊風箏線，控制好風箏。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更嚴格地控制工業排放可以改善空氣質量，並降低人口密集城市的健康風險。

words.tip: 過去式controlled、現在分詞controlling均雙寫l。

tr: a. 爭論的, 論爭的, 被議論的
有爭議的
def: a. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
causing strong disagreement or public debate

ex.en: The controversial parking rules divided our usually friendly neighbours.
ex.zh: 這些有爭議的停車規定讓平時友好的鄰居們產生了分歧。

ex.en: Charging drivers to enter city centres remains controversial, although it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.

[法] 廢止, 廢絕, 法律的失效

tr: a. 散漫的, 無條理的, 不連貫的
def: s. marked by lack of definite plan or regularity or purpose; jumping from one thing to another

tr: vt. 使分離, 分遣
[機] 摘下, 分離, 卸下
拆下；使分離
使超然；使擺脫影響
def: v. cause to become detached or separated; take off
v. separate (a small unit) from a larger, especially for a special assignment
v. come to be detached

ex.en: You can detach the hood when the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停後，你可以把帽兜拆下來。

ex.en: Researchers must detach themselves from personal preferences when evaluating evidence to ensure that their conclusions remain reliable.
ex.zh: 研究人員評估證據時必須擺脫個人偏好的影響，以確保結論可靠。

col: detach yourself from｜使自己超脫於
words.tip: 常用 detach A from B；detachable 指可拆卸的。

tr: vt. 發現, 察覺, 探測
[法] 發現, 查明, 探測
def: v. discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of

tr: n. 發現, 察覺, 探測
[計] 檢波; 檢測
發現；探測；檢測
def: n. the perception that something has occurred or some state exists
n. the act of detecting something; catching sight of something
n. a police investigation to determine the perpetrator

ex.en: Early detection of the leak saved us expensive repairs.
ex.zh: 及早發現漏水，省去了我們高昂的維修費用。

ex.en: Advances in medical imaging have improved the early detection of diseases, allowing patients to receive treatment sooner.
ex.zh: 醫學影像技術的進步改善了疾病的早期檢測，使患者能夠更早接受治療。

words.tip: 通常不可數；detection of後接被發現或檢測的對象。

tr: vt. 制止, 嚇住, 威懾
阻止；使打消念頭
def: v. try to prevent; show opposition to
To discourage an action by making it seem difficult or risky.

ex.en: The heavy rain did not deter our determined hikers.
ex.zh: 大雨沒有讓我們堅定的徒步者打退堂鼓。

ex.en: Higher parking fees may deter commuters from driving into city centres during peak hours.
ex.zh: 提高停車費可能使通勤者不願在高峰時段開車進入市中心。

col: deter someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
deter potential customers｜使潛在顧客卻步
words.tip: 用deter sb from doing；過去式為deterred。

tr: n. 清潔劑
[化] 洗滌劑
洗滌劑；去汙劑
def: n. a surface-active chemical widely used in industry and laundering
n. a cleansing agent that differs from soap but can also emulsify oils and hold dirt in suspension
s. having cleansing power

ex.en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
ex.zh: 我在啟動洗衣機之前加入了洗滌劑。

ex.en: Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.
ex.zh: 使用過量洗滌劑既浪費錢，也可能增加進入當地水道的化學物質。

words.tip: 泛指洗滌劑時通常不可數；指種類時可數。

tr: v. (使)惡化
def: v. become worse or disintegrate

tr: n. 決定物, 決定因素
a. 決定性的
[計] 判定
def: n. a determining or causal element or factor
n. a square matrix used to solve simultaneous equations

tr: a. 確定的, 堅決的, 決定的
[法] 決定性的, 限定性的, 有限的
def: a. precisely determined or limited or defined; especially fixed by rule or by a specific and constant cause
a. not continuing to grow indefinitely at the apex

tr: a. 制止的, 威懾的, 遏制的
n. 威懾力量(或因素), 制止物
def: s. tending to deter

tr: vt. 厭惡, 憎恨
厭惡；憎恨
def: v dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
to dislike someone or something very strongly

ex.en: I detest waiting outside in the freezing rain.
ex.zh: 我非常討厭在冰冷的雨中站在外面等候。

ex.en: Many commuters detest overcrowded trains, yet they have few affordable alternatives for travelling to work.
ex.zh: 許多通勤者十分厭惡擁擠的列車，卻很少有其他負擔得起的上班出行方式。

words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞：detest doing，不接to do。

tr: vt. 引爆, 使爆炸, 使爆裂
vi. 爆炸, 發爆炸聲
def: v. burst and release energy as through a violent chemical or physical reaction

tr: n. 爆炸, 爆裂, 爆炸聲
[化] 爆轟(化學反應速度高於其聲速); 爆震; 引爆
def: n. the act of detonating an explosive

tr: n. 繞路, 迂迴
v. (使)繞道
def: n. a roundabout road (especially one that is used temporarily while a main route is blocked)
v. travel via a detour

tr: n. 轉移, 縮小, 減損, 貶低, 毀損
def: n. a petty disparagement
n. the act of discrediting or detracting from someone's reputation (especially by slander)

tr: n. 損害, 損害物
[法] 損害, 傷害, 危害
損害；不利影響
def: n. a damage or loss
Harm or damage caused to someone or something.

ex.en: He works late, often to the detriment of his sleep.
ex.zh: 他工作到很晚，常常因此影響睡眠。

ex.en: Prioritising short-term profits to the detriment of environmental protection can create substantial costs for future generations.
ex.zh: 為了優先追求短期利潤而損害環境保護，可能讓後代付出巨大代價。

col: a detriment to health｜對健康的不利因素
words.tip: 最常見於to the detriment of，表示以損害……為代價。

tr: a. 有害的
def: s (sometimes followed by `to') causing harm or injury

tr: vt. 毀壞
[法] 使荒廢, 毀滅, 掠奪
嚴重破壞；摧毀
使極度悲痛；使震驚
def: v. overwhelm or overpower
To cause very severe damage to a place or thing
To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked

ex.en: The storm devastated the village, leaving many homes damaged.
ex.zh: 暴風雨重創了村莊，許多房屋受損。

ex.en: Prolonged droughts can devastate agricultural communities by destroying crops and reducing the income available to farming households.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱會毀壞莊稼、減少農戶收入，給農業社區帶來沉重打擊。

col: devastate a region｜重創一個地區
devastate the economy｜嚴重破壞經濟
words.tip: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重創。

tr: a. 不正常的
n. 不正常的人(或物)
def: n a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior
s markedly different from an accepted norm

tr: vi. 脫離, 偏離
vt. 使偏離
a. 脫離常規的
n. 脫離常規的人
偏離；背離
def: v. turn aside; turn away from
v. be at variance with; be out of line with
v. cause to turn away from a previous or expected course

ex.en: We deviated from our usual route to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 為了避開擁堵，我們沒有走平時的路線。

ex.en: Researchers must explain why they deviate from agreed procedures, as unexpected changes may affect the reliability of results.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須解釋為何偏離約定程序，因為意外變動可能影響結果的可靠性。

col: deviate from a plan｜偏離計劃
deviate from the norm｜偏離常規
deviate from a route｜偏離路線
words.tip: 通常為不及物動詞，用deviate from表示偏離。

tr: n. 背離
[化] 偏差; 誤差; 偏斜
偏離；背離
偏差
def: n. a variation that deviates from the standard or norm
n. the difference between an observed value and the expected value of a variable or function
n. the error of a compass due to local magnetic disturbances

ex.en: A small deviation from our route revealed a quiet beach.
ex.zh: 我們稍稍偏離原定路線，發現了一片安靜的海灘。

ex.en: Any significant deviation from established safety procedures should be investigated to prevent accidents in the workplace.
ex.zh: 任何嚴重偏離既定安全程序的行為都應得到調查，以防止工作場所事故。

col: deviation from the norm｜偏離常態
words.tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“標準差”。

tr: a. 偏僻的, 迂迴的
def: s. indirect in departing from the accepted or proper way; misleading
s. characterized by insincerity or deceit; evasive
s. deviating from a straight course

tr: vt. 設計, 發明, 圖謀, 遺贈給
n. 遺贈
def: n. a will disposing of real property
n. (law) a gift of real property by will
v. give by will, especially real property

tr: a. 全無的, 缺乏的
def: s completely wanting or lacking

tr: n. 愛好者, 獻身者, 虔誠的宗教信徒
def: n an ardent follower and admirer

tr: a. 忠誠的, 信仰的, 虔誠的, 禱告的
def: n. a short religious service
s. relating to worship

tr: vt. 吞食, 揮霍, 吞沒
狼吞虎嚥地吃
如飢似渴地閱讀
吞噬；耗盡
def: v. destroy completely
v. enjoy avidly
v. eat immoderately

ex.en: After swimming, we devoured the warm bread within minutes.
ex.zh: 游泳後，我們幾分鐘就狼吞虎嚥地吃光了熱麵包。

ex.en: Large infrastructure projects can devour public funds unless spending is carefully monitored throughout construction.
ex.zh: 大型基礎設施項目可能耗費鉅額公共資金，除非在整個施工過程中嚴格監督支出。

col: devour a meal｜狼吞虎嚥地吃飯
words.tip: 比eat語氣強；也可比喻大量閱讀或吞噬資源。

tr: a. 虔誠的, 虔敬的, 誠懇的
def: s. deeply religious

tr: n. 靈巧, 機敏
def: n. adroitness in using the hands

tr: a. 靈巧的, 慣用右手的
def: s skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands

tr: v. 診斷
診斷疾病
查明問題原因
def: v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis
v. subject to a medical analysis
to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results

ex.en: The doctor diagnosed asthma after checking my breathing.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查我的呼吸情況後，診斷我患有哮喘。

ex.en: New screening technologies can help doctors diagnose certain diseases before serious symptoms appear.
ex.zh: 新的篩查技術可以幫助醫生在嚴重症狀出現前診斷出某些疾病。

words.tip: 診斷某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

tr: a. 診斷的, 有助於診斷的, 特徵的
n. 診斷, 病的徵候, 診斷法
[計] 診斷的
def: a. concerned with diagnosis; used for furthering diagnosis
s. characteristic or indicative of a disease

tr: n. 圖表；圖解
示意圖；圖解
用圖解表示
def: n. a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts
v. make a schematic or technical drawing of that shows interactions among variables or how something is constructed
a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged

ex.en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
ex.zh: 這張示意圖展示瞭如何組裝架子。

ex.en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
ex.zh: 一張清晰的示意圖能比冗長的講解更有效地幫助學生理解複雜的生物過程。

col: a labelled diagram｜帶標註的示意圖
words.tip: 側重結構或原理的圖解，不等同於數據圖表。

tr: n. 方言, 同源語
方言
def: n. the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
A language variety used in a particular region or community.

ex.en: My grandmother speaks a dialect I sometimes struggle to understand.
ex.zh: 我奶奶說一種我有時聽不太懂的方言。

ex.en: Schools can help preserve local dialects while teaching students the standard language needed for wider communication.
ex.zh: 學校可以在教授學生廣泛交流所需的標準語的同時，幫助保護當地方言。

words.tip: dialect涉及詞彙和語法，accent主要指口音。

tr: a. 透明的, 輕柔的
def: s. so thin as to transmit light

tr: n. 抨擊, 譴責
def: n thunderous verbal attack

tr: n. 兩分, 分裂, 二分法
[醫] 二分(二分之一); 二叉, 二歧
def: n. being twofold; a classification into two opposed parts or subclasses

tr: n. 十個, 十張皮革, 小生意
vi. 做小生意, 易貨, 還價
def: v. negotiate the terms of an exchange

tr: vi. 聽寫, 口述, 口授
vt. 口述, 使聽寫, 命令
n. 命令, 指揮, 指令
口述供記錄
命令；強行規定
def: n. an authoritative rule
n. a guiding principle
v. say out loud for the purpose of recording

ex.en: Please dictate your message slowly while I write it down.
ex.zh: 請慢慢口述你的留言，我來記下來。

ex.en: Financial pressures often dictate which courses universities offer, potentially limiting opportunities in less profitable subjects.
ex.zh: 財務壓力往往決定大學開設哪些課程，可能限制收益較低學科的學習機會。

words.tip: dictate是口述讓別人寫；“做聽寫”用take dictation。

tr: n. 命令者, 獨裁者
def: n. a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
n. a ruler who is unconstrained by law

tr: n. 聲明, 格言, 法官意見
[法] 宣言, 聲明, 法官的意見
def: n an authoritative declaration
n an opinion voiced by a judge on a point of law not directly bearing on the case in question and therefore not binding

tr: a. 教訓的, 說教的, 教導的, 教誨的
[醫] 教導的
def: s. instructive (especially excessively)

tr: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄滅, 漠然, 渴望
vt. 死
n. 骰子, 沖模
死亡；枯死
停止運轉；逐漸消失
def: n. a small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces; used in gambling to generate random numbers
n. a device used for shaping metal
n. a cutting tool that is fitted into a diestock and used for cutting male (external) screw threads on screws or bolts or pipes or rods

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
ex.zh: 如果忘了澆水，這些植物就會枯死。

ex.en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 許多海洋動物吞食塑料垃圾後死亡，這凸顯了減少海洋汙染的迫切需要。

words.tip: die是動詞，dead是形容詞，death是名詞。

tr: n. 頑固分子
[法] 頑固分子, 頑固派, 死不屈從者
def: n one who adheres to traditional views

tr: a. 飲食的
n. 規定食物
def: n. a regulated daily food allowance
a. of or relating to the diet

tr: v. 區別, 區分
區分；辨別
使有別於
def: v. calculate a derivative; take the derivative
v. become different during development
v. become distinct and acquire a different character

ex.en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
ex.zh: 你能根據鳴叫聲分辨這兩種鳥嗎？

ex.en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.
ex.zh: 學校應教學生區分網絡媒體中可靠的證據和缺乏依據的說法。

col: differentiate A from B｜區分甲與乙
words.tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

tr: a. 無自信的, 謙虛謹慎的, 羞怯的
def: s. showing modest reserve
a. lacking self-confidence

tr: v. 散播, 傳播
a. 散開的, 瀰漫的
擴散；傳播；使漫射
分散的；瀰漫的
冗長散漫的
def: v. move outward
s. spread out; not concentrated in one place
s. lacking conciseness

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread diffused through the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味在廚房裡瀰漫開來。

ex.en: Public libraries help diffuse knowledge throughout society by providing free access to reliable information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館通過免費提供可靠信息和教育資源，幫助知識在全社會傳播。

words.tip: 動詞詞尾讀/z/，形容詞讀/s/；勿混defuse（化解）。

tr: n. 散播, 傳播, 蔓延
[醫] 擴散, 彌散, 漫射(光)
def: n. (physics) the process in which there is movement of a substance from an area of high concentration of that substance to an area of lower concentration
n. the spread of social institutions (and myths and skills) from one society to another

tr: n. 消化力, 領悟
[化] 消化; 消化作用; 蒸煮; 蒸煮作用; 煮解; 浸提; 陳化
消化；消化能力
def: n. the process of decomposing organic matter (as in sewage) by bacteria or by chemical action or heat
n. the organic process by which food is converted into substances that can be absorbed into the body
n. learning and coming to understand ideas and information

ex.en: Drinking enough water helps keep your digestion working well.
ex.zh: 喝足夠的水有助於維持良好的消化功能。

ex.en: A balanced diet supports healthy digestion and provides the nutrients needed for growth and daily activity.
ex.zh: 均衡飲食有助於健康消化，並提供生長和日常活動所需的營養。

words.tip: 通常不可數；消化不良常用 indigestion。

tr: n. 尊嚴, 高貴
[法] 尊嚴, 高位, 高貴
尊嚴
莊重；自尊的儀態
def: n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
n. formality in bearing and appearance
n. high office or rank or station

ex.en: The nurse protected his dignity by closing the curtain.
ex.zh: 護士拉上簾子，維護了他的尊嚴。

ex.en: Care services should preserve the dignity of older people by respecting their privacy and personal choices.
ex.zh: 護理服務應尊重老年人的隱私和個人選擇，維護他們的尊嚴。

col: preserve someone's dignity｜維護某人的尊嚴
treat someone with dignity｜有尊嚴地對待某人
words.tip: 通常不可數；with dignity可表示有尊嚴地。

tr: vi. 走向岔道, 離題, 扯到枝節上
def: v. lose clarity or turn aside especially from the main subject of attention or course of argument in writing, thinking, or speaking

tr: n. 離題, 扯到枝節上, 偏離
def: n. a message that departs from the main subject
n. wandering from the main path of a journey

tr: a. 離題的, 枝節的
def: s. of superficial relevance if any
s. (of e.g. speech and writing) tending to depart from the main point or cover a wide range of subjects

tr: v. (使)荒廢, (使)毀壞
def: v. bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin by neglect or misuse

tr: a. 破壞的；荒廢的, 要塌似的
def: v bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin by neglect or misuse
v fall into decay or ruin
s in deplorable condition

tr: vi. 擴大, 詳述, 膨脹
vt. 使膨脹
def: v. become wider

tr: a. 拖拉的
[法] 延期的, 拖延的, 慢的
def: s. wasting time

tr: n. 困境, (進退兩難的)窘境
def: n. state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options

tr: n. 業餘愛好者
a. 外行的, 淺薄的
def: s. showing frivolous or superficial interest; amateurish

tr: n. 勤奮
def: n. conscientiousness in paying proper attention to a task; giving the degree of care required in a given situation
n. persevering determination to perform a task

tr: a. 勤勉的, 用功的
勤奮的；認真盡責的
def: s. quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness
a. characterized by care and perseverance in carrying out tasks
Working carefully and consistently with strong effort

ex.en: Our diligent neighbour checks her vegetable plants every morning.
ex.zh: 我們那位勤快的鄰居每天早晨都會查看自己種的蔬菜。

ex.en: Diligent research helps students develop stronger arguments and avoid relying on inaccurate information in academic essays.
ex.zh: 認真細緻的研究有助於學生提出更有力的論點，避免在學術文章中依賴不準確的信息。

col: diligent in one's work｜工作認真盡責
words.tip: 不僅指努力，也強調認真、細緻和持續投入。

tr: vi. 磨蹭
def: v postpone doing what one should be doing

tr: vt. 沖淡, 稀釋
a. 淡的, 稀釋的
稀釋；沖淡
削弱；減弱
稀釋的；濃度低的
def: v. lessen the strength or flavor of a solution or mixture
To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid.
To reduce the strength, quality, or influence of something.

ex.en: Dilute the juice with water before giving it to children.
ex.zh: 給孩子喝果汁前，先加水稀釋。

ex.en: Excessive commercial involvement may dilute the educational value of programmes designed for young television viewers.
ex.zh: 過多的商業介入可能削弱面向青少年觀眾的電視節目的教育價值。

words.tip: dilute A with B表示用液體B稀釋A。

tr: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的
vt. 使暗淡
[計] 數據解釋模塊
昏暗的；微弱的
模糊的；不清晰的
def: v. switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam
v. become dim or lusterless
v. make dim or lusterless

ex.en: We ate dinner under a dim kitchen light.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房昏暗的燈光下吃了晚飯。

ex.en: Dim lighting in public spaces can make pedestrians feel unsafe, particularly when walking alone at night.

ex.zh: 長期乾旱期間，植物因失水而難以維持形態，葉片往往會下垂。

ex.zh: 午飯後，溫暖的房間讓我昏昏欲睡。

ex.zh: 感到睏倦的司機應在安全地點停車，因為疲勞會顯著增加事故風險。

考慮；心懷
def: v. provide entertainment for
v. take into consideration, have in view
to keep someone interested or amused

ex.en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
ex.zh: 我哥哥模仿動物發出滑稽的叫聲，逗孩子們開心。

ex.en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
ex.zh: 公共博物館應通過引人入勝的展覽和互動活動，讓參觀者既獲得知識又享受樂趣。

col: entertain an audience｜為觀眾提供娛樂
entertain the idea of｜考慮……的想法
words.tip: entertain an idea指考慮某想法，並非已經接受。

tr: vt. 迷住, 奴役, 使做奴隸, 吸引住
def: v hold spellbound

tr: vt. 迷惑, 奴役, 迷住

tr: a. 迷人的
def: v hold spellbound
v hold spellbound
s capturing interest as if by a spell

tr: vt. 誘騙, 引誘, 慫恿
def: v. provoke someone to do something through (often false or exaggerated) promises or persuasion

tr: n. 全部, 整體
[法] 共有制, 整體, 全部
全部；整體
def: n. the state of being total and complete
the whole of something, with no part left out

ex.en: We watched the long film in its entirety.
ex.zh: 我們完整地看完了那部很長的電影。

ex.en: Researchers should examine the report in its entirety before drawing conclusions about the effectiveness of the programme.
ex.zh: 研究人員應完整審閱報告，再對該項目的成效作出結論。

words.tip: 常用 in its entirety，表示完整地、無遺漏地。

tr: vt. 給...權利, 取名為, 給予名稱, 叫做
[法] 給...權利, 使有資格, 稱呼
給予權利或資格
給……命名；題名
def: v. give the right to
v. give a title to
To give someone the right to have or do something.

ex.en: This ticket entitles you to a free lunch.
ex.zh: 憑這張票，你可以免費享用一頓午餐。

ex.en: Employment laws should entitle all workers to paid leave, regardless of the size of their organisation.
ex.zh: 勞動法應賦予所有勞動者享受帶薪休假的權利，無論其所在機構規模大小。

col: entitle someone to benefits｜使某人有資格享受福利
be entitled to compensation｜有權獲得賠償
be entitled to vote｜有權投票
words.tip: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用於被動語態。

tr: n. 全體隨行人員, 陪同人員

tr: n. 入口, 進入點, 入場, 入學, 進入, 開始(階段), 就任
vt. 使出神, 使入迷
[計] 入口
入口；大門
進入；入學資格
def: n. something that provides access (to get in or get out)
n. a movement into or inward
n. the act of entering

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後我在入口處與你碰面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
ex.zh: 大學應確保入學要求兼顧不同教育背景，同時維持適當的學術標準。

words.tip: 某處的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

tr: v. 懇求, 乞求
