tr: n. 潛在性, 可能性, 潛力, 潛能, 勢, 位
a. 有潛力的, 可能的, 潛在的
def: n. the inherent capacity for coming into being
a. existing in possibility

tr: vt. 賦與力量, 加強
vi. 有加強作用
def: v. increase the effect of or act synergistically with (a drug or a physiological or biochemical phenomenon)

tr: n. 喧擾, 騷動, 混亂
v. (使)困擾, (使)煩惱
def: v. make upset or troubled

tr: n. 混合物, 雜曲, 混成曲, 雜集, 大雜燴
def: n. a jar of mixed flower petals and spices used as perfume

tr: a. 盆栽的, 罐裝的
def: a. of plants; planted or grown in a pot
s. preserved in a pot or can or jar
s. (British informal) summarized or abridged

tr: n. 陶器, 陶器廠
[化] 陶器
陶器
製陶；陶藝
陶器作坊；陶器廠
def: n. ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln
n. the craft of making earthenware
n. a workshop where clayware is made

ex.en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
ex.zh: 市場攤位上陳列著色調柔和、帶有泥土色澤的陶器。

ex.en: Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
ex.zh: 傳統陶器能夠揭示早期社會如何儲存食物、交易商品以及表達文化身份。

words.tip: 指陶器統稱時不可數；一件用a piece of pottery。

tr: n. 小袋, 小包, 眼袋, 郵袋, 育兒袋
vt. 裝...入袋中, 使成袋狀
vi. 成袋狀
def: n. a small or medium size container for holding or carrying things
n. an enclosed space
n. (anatomy) saclike structure in any of various animals (as a marsupial or gopher or pelican)

tr: n. 猛撲, 爪
vi. 猛撲, 突襲
vt. 撲住
猛撲；突然襲擊
立即抓住機會或錯誤
def: n. the act of pouncing
v. move down on as if in an attack
To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.

ex.en: Our kitten pounced on a leaf blowing across the garden.
ex.zh: 我們的小貓猛撲向一片被風吹過花園的葉子。

ex.en: News outlets often pounce on minor errors, distracting audiences from more important policy debates.
ex.zh: 新聞媒體常常抓住小錯誤不放，使受眾忽略更重要的政策討論。

col: pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住機會
pounce on a mistake｜揪住錯誤不放
words.tip: 常接on，既可指猛撲，也可指抓住機會或錯誤。

tr: n. 磅, 英鎊, 重擊, 魚塘, 拘留所, 獸欄
vt. 強烈打擊, 搗爛, 監禁, 關入欄內
vi. 連續重擊, 苦幹
英鎊
磅（重量單位）
def: n. 16 ounces avoirdupois
n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 12 ounces troy
n. a nontechnical unit of force equal to the mass of 1 pound with an acceleration of free fall equal to 32 feet/sec/sec

ex.en: I paid one pound for this bag of apples.
ex.zh: 我花了一英鎊買了這袋蘋果。

ex.en: A weaker pound can attract international tourists, but it also raises the cost of imported goods.
ex.zh: 英鎊貶值可以吸引國際遊客，但也會提高進口商品的成本。

col: a pound of butter｜一磅黃油
words.tip: 英鎊和重量單位磅都用pound；複數通常加s。

tr: a. 忙碌的, 愛管閒事的, 自負的, 固執己見的, 實際的, 務實的, 國事的, 國務的
[法] 閒斷的, 固執己見的, 實用主義的
務實的；講求實效的
def: a. of or concerning the theory of pragmatism
Choosing what works in practice rather than following ideals.

ex.en: We took a pragmatic approach and repaired the old sofa.
ex.zh: 我們採取了務實的辦法，把舊沙發修好了。

ex.en: A pragmatic housing policy should balance environmental goals with the immediate needs of local residents.
ex.zh: 務實的住房政策應兼顧環保目標和當地居民的迫切需求。

col: pragmatic solution｜切實可行的解決辦法
words.tip: 強調實際可行和效果，而非理論或理想。

tr: n. (馬)騰躍, 昂首闊步
vi. 騰躍, 昂首闊步
vt. 使騰躍
def: v. spring forward on the hind legs
v. cause (a horse) to bound spring forward
v. ride a horse such that it springs and bounds forward

tr: n. 開玩笑, 惡作劇, 戲謔
vt. 盛裝, 裝飾, 打扮
vi. 炫耀自己
def: v. dress or decorate showily or gaudily
v. dress up showily

tr: vi. 嘮叨, 空談
vt. 瞎扯
n. 嘮叨, 空談, 瞎扯
def: n. idle or foolish and irrelevant talk

tr: v. 傳道, 講道, 說教, 宣講, 鼓吹
n. 說教, 佈道
講道；佈道
宣揚；竭力倡導
說教
def: v. deliver a sermon
v. speak, plead, or argue in favor of
To deliver a religious talk to a group of people.

ex.en: The minister preached about kindness at the morning service.
ex.zh: 牧師在晨間禮拜中以友善為主題講道。

ex.en: Schools should demonstrate respect through everyday practices rather than simply preach the importance of good behaviour.
ex.zh: 學校應通過日常實踐展現尊重，而不應僅僅說教，強調良好行為的重要性。

col: practise what you preach｜身體力行
words.tip: preach to someone常含“對某人說教”的貶義。

tr: n. 引言, 序文, 前言
[計] 前同步; 前同步信號
def: n. a preliminary introduction to a statute or constitution (usually explaining its purpose)
v. make a preliminary introduction, usually to a formal document

tr: a. 不穩定的, 不安的, 危險的
不穩固的；搖搖欲墜的
不穩定的；岌岌可危的
def: s. affording no ease or reassurance
s. not secure; beset with difficulties
not securely positioned and likely to fall

ex.en: The ladder looked precarious on the wet, uneven ground.
ex.zh: 梯子架在溼滑不平的地面上，看起來搖搖欲墜。

ex.en: Workers on short-term contracts often face precarious financial circumstances, making it difficult to plan for the future.
ex.zh: 短期合同工往往面臨不穩定的經濟狀況，難以規劃未來。

col: a precarious position｜岌岌可危的處境
a precarious balance｜不穩固的平衡
precarious finances｜不穩定的財務狀況
words.tip: 不僅表示“不穩定”，還暗含隨時出問題的風險。

tr: vt. 在...之前, 優於, 較...優先
vi. 在前面
先於；在……之前發生
走在……前面
def: v. come before
v. be the predecessor of
v. move ahead (of others) in time or space

ex.en: A short welcome speech will precede the evening meal.
ex.zh: 晚餐前會有一段簡短的歡迎致辭。

ex.en: Thorough environmental assessments should precede major construction projects to identify potential risks to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 大型建設項目啟動前應進行全面的環境評估，以識別對當地生態系統的潛在風險。

col: immediately precede｜緊接著發生在……之前
precede the introduction of｜先於……的引入
words.tip: precede 指先於；proceed 指繼續進行。

tr: n. 先例, 前例
a. 在先的, 在前的
def: n. an example that is used to justify similar occurrences at a later time
n. a subject mentioned earlier (preceding in time)
s. preceding in time, order, or significance

tr: n. 規誡, 規矩, 格言, 訓令
[經] 告誡, 指令
def: n rule of personal conduct
n a doctrine that is taught

tr: n. 沉澱物, 凝結物, 結果
vt. 猛拋, 使陷入, 促成, 使沉澱
vi. 猛地落下
a. 突然的, 猛地落下的, 輕率的
促使發生；引發
def: n. a precipitated solid substance in suspension or after settling or filtering
v. bring about abruptly
v. separate as a fine suspension of solid particles

ex.en: A broken pipe precipitated an emergency visit from the plumber.
ex.zh: 水管破裂，水管工因此緊急上門維修。

ex.en: A sharp increase in food prices could precipitate a wider economic crisis in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 食品價格大幅上漲可能在脆弱地區引發更廣泛的經濟危機。

words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/teɪt/，名詞、形容詞讀/tət/。

tr: a. 陡峭的, 輕率的
def: s done with very great haste and without due deliberation
s extremely steep

tr: a. 精確的, 嚴謹的, 明確的
[機] 精密的, 正確的
def: a. sharply exact or accurate or delimited

tr: vt. 預先排除, 預防, 阻止, 妨礙
[法] 預防, 排除, 消除
使不可能；阻止；排除
def: v. make impossible, especially beforehand
to prevent something or make it impossible

ex.en: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 大雨讓我們原定的湖邊野餐無法進行。

ex.en: High tuition fees may preclude students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education without financial support.
ex.zh: 高昂的學費可能使弱勢家庭的學生在沒有經濟資助的情況下無法接受高等教育。

col: preclude someone from doing something｜使某人無法做某事
preclude further discussion｜使進一步討論無法進行
words.tip: 正式用詞；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

tr: a. 早熟的, 像大人的
[醫] 早熟的
def: a. characterized by or characteristic of exceptionally early development or maturity (especially in mental aptitude)
s. appearing or developing early

tr: n. 事先鉤成的看法, 成見
[法] 先入之見, 成見, 偏見
def: n. an opinion formed beforehand without adequate evidence

tr: n. 先驅者, 前導, 前兆
[化] 前體; 前身; 產物母體
def: n. a substance from which another substance is formed (especially by a metabolic reaction)
n. a person who goes before or announces the coming of another

tr: n. 食肉動物, 掠奪者
[醫] 捕食者
捕食者；食肉動物
掠奪者；剝削者
def: n. any animal that lives by preying on other animals
An animal that hunts and eats other animals.
A person or organisation that exploits others for personal gain.

ex.en: The rabbit froze when it noticed a predator nearby.
ex.zh: 兔子發現附近有捕食者時，一動也不敢動。

ex.en: Protecting natural predators can help farmers control pests without relying heavily on chemical pesticides.
ex.zh: 保護天敵可以幫助農民防治害蟲，減少對化學農藥的依賴。

words.tip: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的獵物。

tr: a. 掠奪成性的, 捕食生物的, 掠奪的
[醫] 捕食的
def: s. living by preying on other animals especially by catching living prey

tr: n. 前任, 先輩, 前身
[醫] 初牙, 前輩, 祖先
前任
前身；上一代產品
def: n. one who precedes you in time (as in holding a position or office)
Someone who held a particular position before another person.
Something that existed before and was replaced by something similar.

ex.en: My predecessor left some helpful notes in the desk.
ex.zh: 我的前任在桌子裡留下了一些有用的筆記。

ex.en: The new transport system uses less energy than its predecessor while carrying substantially more passengers.
ex.zh: 新的交通系統比其前身能耗更低，同時運載的乘客大幅增加。

col: a predecessor in office｜職位上的前任
words.tip: 指某職位的前任或事物的前身，不泛指所有前輩。

tr: vt. 預定, 註定
def: v. decree or determine beforehand
v. foreordain by divine will or decree
v. foreordain or determine beforehand

tr: vt. 預先決定, 預先查明
[經] 預定的, 先定的
def: v. determine beforehand

tr: a. 可預言的
可預測的；意料之中的
老套的；缺乏新意的
def: a. capable of being foretold
Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected.
Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.

ex.en: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
ex.zh: 這部電影老套的結局讓我們笑了，而不是哭了。

ex.en: A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 可預期的收入有助於家庭規劃支出，並減輕財務不確定性帶來的壓力。

words.tip: 既可表示結果可預料，也可貶指情節老套。

tr: n. 嗜好, 偏愛
def: n. a predisposition in favor of something

tr: vt. 預先處置, 使預先有傾向
def: v. make susceptible

tr: a. 佔主導地位的, 卓越的
[法] 佔優勢的, 支配其他的, 主要的
def: s most frequent or common
s having superior power and influence

tr: vt. 掌握, 控制, 支配
vi. 佔主導地位, 佔優勢
def: v. be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance

tr: a. 優秀的, 超群的, 卓越的
def: s greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement

tr: vt. 先買, 先取
vi. 先發制人地叫牌
def: v. acquire for oneself before others can do so
v. take the place of or have precedence over
v. gain possession of by prior right or opportunity, especially so as to obtain the right to buy (land)

tr: vt. 用嘴整理, 打扮, 使得意
vi. 打扮漂亮, 感到得意
def: v. clean with one's bill
v. pride or congratulate (oneself) for an achievement
v. dress or groom with elaborate care

tr: adv. 更可取地, 更好地, 更合意地
def: r. more readily or willingly

tr: vt. 預示, 預見, 預想
def: v. imagine or consider beforehand

tr: a. 懷孕的, 充滿的, 思想豐富的, 成果豐碩的
[醫] 妊娠的, 有孕的
懷孕的；妊娠的
def: a. carrying developing offspring within the body or being about to produce new life
having a baby developing inside the body

ex.en: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
ex.zh: 我表姐懷孕了，預產期在六月。

ex.en: Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.
ex.zh: 便捷可及的醫療服務有助於孕婦在整個孕期獲得定期檢查和可靠的建議。

words.tip: 表示懷孕多久可說six months pregnant。

tr: a. 能抓的, 善於領會的, 貪得無厭的
[醫] 抓握的, 捕捉的
def: a. adapted for grasping especially by wrapping around an object
s. having a keen intellect

tr: a. 歷史以前的, 史前的
def: s. belonging to or existing in times before recorded history
a. of or relating to times before written history
s. no longer fashionable

tr: n. 偏見, 成見, 侵害
vt. 使存偏見, 使有成見, 侵害
偏見；成見
使有偏見；損害
def: v. disadvantage by prejudice
v. influence (somebody's) opinion in advance
An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge or experience.

ex.en: Her neighbours welcomed her warmly, without any prejudice.
ex.zh: 鄰居們熱情地歡迎她，沒有任何偏見。

ex.en: Schools can challenge prejudice by encouraging students to learn about cultures different from their own.
ex.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生了解不同於自身的文化，從而消除偏見。

col: prejudice someone's chances｜損害某人的機會
words.tip: 表示對某群體的偏見，常用prejudice against。

tr: n. 初步做法, 初步措施, 預試, 預選賽
a. 初步的, 開始的, 預備的
def: n. a minor match preceding the main event
n. something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows
s. denoting an action or event preceding or in preparation for something more important; designed to orient or acquaint with a situation before proceeding

tr: n. 前奏, 序幕, 序詩, 前奏曲
vi. 作為前奏
vt. 作為...的開頭
序幕；前奏
前奏曲
def: n. music that precedes a fugue or introduces an act in an opera
v. serve as a prelude or opening to
v. play as a prelude

ex.en: Our short walk was a prelude to a lovely picnic.
ex.zh: 我們先散了會兒步，隨後享受了一次愉快的野餐。

ex.en: Investment in reliable internet infrastructure is often a prelude to broader economic development in rural regions.
ex.zh: 投資建設可靠的互聯網基礎設施，往往是農村地區實現更廣泛經濟發展的序幕。

words.tip: 常用a prelude to，to後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: a. 早產的, 過早的, 不成熟的
n. 早產兒, 過早發生的事物
過早的；時機未到的
早產的
def: a. born after a gestation period of less than the normal time
s. uncommonly early or before the expected time
happening before the expected or appropriate time

ex.en: Our celebration was premature; the match wasn't over yet.
ex.zh: 我們慶祝得太早了，比賽還沒結束。

ex.en: It would be premature to conclude that the policy has succeeded without examining its long-term effects.
ex.zh: 在考察這項政策的長期影響之前，就斷定它已取得成功，為時尚早。

col: premature to conclude｜下結論為時過早
words.tip: premature強調過早；immature常指不成熟。

tr: v. 預謀, 預先考慮
def: v. consider, ponder, or plan (an action) beforehand
v. think or reflect beforehand or in advance

tr: v. 初次公演, 首次露面
n. 初次的演出
a. 首次的, 首位的
def: n. the first public performance of a play or movie

tr: n. 前提, 房屋連地基, 上述各項
vt. 預先提出, 引出, 作為...的前提
vi. 作出前提
前提；假定
房屋及附屬場地
def: n. a statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn
v. set forth beforehand, often as an explanation
v. take something as preexisting and given

ex.en: Your plan rests on the premise that everyone agrees.
ex.zh: 你的計劃建立在所有人都同意這一前提上。

ex.en: The policy is based on the premise that affordable education improves both individual prospects and national productivity.
ex.zh: 這項政策的前提是，負擔得起的教育能改善個人前景並提高國家生產力。

col: on the premise that｜以……為前提
words.tip: 表示房屋及場地時用複數premises。

tr: n. 額外補貼, 獎金, 獎賞, 保險費
[醫] 保險費
def: n. payment for insurance
n. the amount that something in scarce supply is valued above its nominal value
n. a prize, bonus, or award given as an inducement to purchase products, enter competitions initiated by business interests, etc.

tr: n. 預告, 預感, 徵兆
[醫] 先兆, 預兆
def: n a feeling of evil to come
n an early warning about a future event

tr: n. 搶先佔據, 先人之見, 入神
[醫] 成見, 注意散漫, 心不在焉
def: n. an idea that preoccupies the mind and holds the attention
n. the mental state of being preoccupied by something

tr: a. 佔優勢的, 多數的, 主要的, 突出的
def: s having superior power and influence

tr: a. 給人好感的
def: s. creating a favorable impression

tr: a. 反常的, 乖戾的, 荒謬的, 首末倒置的
def: s incongruous; inviting ridicule

tr: a. 先決條件的, 必要的
n. 先決條件, 必備條件
def: n. something that is required in advance
s. required as a prior condition or course of study

tr: n. 特權, 君權, 職權
a. 特權的, 行使特權的
專有權利；特權
def: n. a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)
a special right belonging to a particular person or group

ex.en: Choosing the final design is the team leader's prerogative.
ex.zh: 選定最終設計方案是組長的專有權利。

ex.en: Decisions about public spending should not be the exclusive prerogative of a small group of officials.
ex.zh: 公共支出的決策不應成為少數官員獨享的特權。

words.tip: 指特定身份享有的權利，不是人人都有的普通權利。

tr: n. 預感, 預兆, 預知
vt. 預示, 預言
vi. 預感, 預言
def: n. a foreboding about what is about to happen

tr: n. 預知, 先見
def: n. the power to foresee the future

tr: a. 預知的, 有先見之明的
def: s. perceiving the significance of events before they occur

tr: v. 規定, 指定, 囑咐, 開處方
開藥；開處方
規定；指定
def: v issue commands or orders for
officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional
state officially what must be done or how

ex.en: The doctor prescribed eye drops for my sore eyes.
ex.zh: 醫生給我開了眼藥水，治療眼睛疼痛。

ex.en: Doctors should prescribe antibiotics only when necessary to reduce the risk of bacteria developing resistance.
ex.zh: 醫生應僅在必要時開抗生素，以降低細菌產生耐藥性的風險。

words.tip: prescribe是開藥；describe是描述，注意區分。

tr: n. 贈與, 描述, 介紹

呈現方式；外觀
頒發；贈送
def: n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward)
n. a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view
n. the act of making something publicly available; presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it

ex.en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
ex.zh: 我在姐姐面前練習了一遍報告。

ex.en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
ex.zh: 進行小組報告能讓學生培養溝通能力，並學習如何分工。

words.tip: 作報告用give a presentation；注意present作動詞的重音。

tr: n. 預感
def: n a feeling of evil to come

tr: a. 有助於保存的, 有保存力的
n. 預防藥, 防腐劑
def: n. a chemical compound that is added to protect against decay or decomposition
s. tending or having the power to preserve

tr: vt. 保護, 保持, 保存, 維持, 醃, 禁獵
vi. 加工食品, 禁獵
n. 加工成的食品, 禁獵地, 保護區, 防護物
保護；保存；維持
保藏食物
def: n. a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone
n. a reservation where animals are protected
v. prevent (food) from rotting

ex.en: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
ex.zh: 我們把家裡的老照片保存在一本專用相冊裡。

ex.en: Local authorities should preserve historic buildings while adapting them to meet the needs of modern communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府應保護歷史建築，同時改造它們以滿足現代社區的需求。

col: preserve cultural heritage｜保護文化遺產
words.tip: preserve強調保持原狀；保藏食物也用它。

tr: vi. 統轄, 當主人, 主持
[法] 主持, 負責, 指揮
主持；擔任主席
def: v. act as president
To lead a formal meeting, ceremony, or other official event

ex.en: Our club elected Nina to preside over the next meeting.
ex.zh: 我們俱樂部推選妮娜主持下一次會議。

ex.en: An independent expert should preside over the public hearing to ensure that all participants receive fair treatment.
ex.zh: 公開聽證會應由獨立專家主持，以確保所有參與者都得到公平對待。

col: preside over a meeting｜主持會議
preside at a ceremony｜主持典禮
words.tip: 不直接接會議等賓語，通常用preside over。

tr: n. 壓, 撳, 按, 人群, 印刷機, 壓力, 出版社, 記者, 報刊, 新聞輿論, 緊迫
vt. 壓, 壓榨, 緊抱, 逼迫, 推進, 強迫徵募, 催逼
vi. 壓, 重壓, 催促, 擁擠, 奮力前進, 受壓
按；壓
新聞界；報刊
def: n. the print media responsible for gathering and publishing news in the form of newspapers or magazines
n. a machine used for printing
n. clamp to prevent wooden rackets from warping when not in use

ex.en: Press this button to open the garage door.
ex.zh: 按這個按鈕就能打開車庫門。

ex.en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
ex.zh: 自由的新聞界幫助公民瞭解公共事務，並監督掌權者承擔責任。

col: freedom of the press｜新聞自由
words.tip: 表示新聞界通常用the press；按按鈕不用push down。

tr: a. 緊迫的, 迫切的, 熱切的
n. 壓, 壓榨, 沖壓件, 唱片
def: n. a metal or plastic part that is made by a mechanical press
s. compelling immediate action

tr: n. 聲望, 威望, 威信
[經] 商譽, 聲譽
聲望；威望
def: n. a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
Respect and admiration gained through achievement, quality, or high status.

ex.en: Winning the award brought considerable prestige to her small bakery.
ex.zh: 獲獎為她的小麵包店帶來了很高的聲譽。

ex.en: Some students choose universities for their international prestige rather than the suitability of individual courses.
ex.zh: 一些學生選擇大學看重的是其國際聲望，而非具體課程是否適合自己。

col: a matter of prestige｜關乎聲望的事
words.tip: prestige不可數；形容詞用prestigious。

tr: a. 享有聲望的
def: s. exerting influence by reason of high status or prestige

tr: vt. 假定, 推測, 擅自, 意味著
vi. 擅自行動, 相信
def: v. constitute reasonable evidence for
v. take liberties or act with too much confidence

tr: n. 專橫, 放肆, 假定, 推測
[法] 假定, 推測, 設想
def: n. (law) an inference of the truth of a fact from other facts proved or admitted or judicially noticed
n. audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to
n. a kind of discourtesy in the form of an act of presuming

tr: a. 放肆的, 冒昧的, 傲慢的
def: s excessively forward

tr: vt. 預先假定, 預料, 以...為先決條件
def: v. take for granted or as a given; suppose beforehand
v. require as a necessary antecedent or precondition

tr: n. 預想, 假定, 預先推測
def: n. the act of presupposing; a supposition made prior to having knowledge (as for the purpose of argument)

tr: n. 假裝, 虛偽, 藉口, 自稱, 要求
[法] 假裝, 藉口, 託詞
def: n a false or unsupportable quality
n an artful or simulated semblance
n pretending with intention to deceive

tr: n. 藉口, 虛假, 偽裝
def: n. the act of giving a false appearance
n. pretending with intention to deceive
n. imaginative intellectual play

tr: n. 自負, 驕傲, 主張
def: n. a false or unsupportable quality
n. the advancing of a claim

tr: a. 自負的, 自命不凡的, 誇耀的
自命不凡的；故作高深的
def: a. making claim to or creating an appearance of (often undeserved) importance or distinction
trying to seem more important or impressive than is justified

ex.en: The café felt pretentious, with velvet chairs and tiny portions.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館擺著天鵝絨椅子，食物分量卻很小，讓人覺得裝腔作勢。

ex.en: Public art may alienate local residents if its presentation seems pretentious rather than welcoming and accessible.
ex.zh: 如果公共藝術的呈現方式顯得故作高深，而非親切易懂，就可能疏遠當地居民。

col: a pretentious attitude｜自命不凡的態度
words.tip: 貶義：刻意顯得高雅或重要，不只是有自信。

tr: a. 超自然的, 異常的
def: s. surpassing the ordinary or normal

tr: n. 藉口, 託詞
v. 以...為藉口
藉口；託辭
def: n. something serving to conceal plans; a fictitious reason that is concocted in order to conceal the real reason
A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
ex.zh: 他以頭痛為藉口離開了。

ex.en: Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.
ex.zh: 企業不應以經濟不確定性為藉口，放棄其環保承諾。

col: under the pretext of｜以……為藉口
a pretext for doing something｜做某事的藉口
words.tip: 強調掩蓋真實目的的藉口；常接for或of。

tr: vi. 獲勝, 流行, 盛行
[醫] 流行, 盛行
盛行；普遍存在
獲勝；佔上風
說服
def: v. be valid, applicable, or true
v. continue to exist
v. prove superior

ex.en: A relaxed atmosphere prevails in our kitchen on Sundays.
ex.zh: 每逢星期日，我們的廚房裡總洋溢著輕鬆的氣氛。

ex.en: Where traditional attitudes prevail, public education campaigns may be needed to encourage more equal opportunities for women.
ex.zh: 在傳統觀念盛行的地方，可能需要開展公眾教育活動，為女性爭取更平等的機會。

col: prevail upon someone to do｜說服某人做
words.tip: 獲勝用prevail over；說服用prevail upon sb to do。

tr: a. 普遍的, 流行的
def: s most frequent or common

tr: vi. 支吾其辭, 搪塞

tr: n. 事先查看, 預覽
vt. 事先查看, 預演
[計] 預覽
def: n. an advertisement consisting of short scenes from a motion picture that will appear in the near future
n. a screening for a select audience in advance of release for the general public
v. watch (a movie or play) before it is released to the general public

tr: a. 早先的, 前面的, 過急的
[法] 以前的, 生前的, 前述的
先前的；以前的
def: s. just preceding something else in time or order
s. too soon or too hasty
happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
ex.zh: 上一位租客在陽臺上留下了幾盆植物。

ex.en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
ex.zh: 先前的研究表明，經常運動能提高學齡兒童的專注力和學習成績。

words.tip: previous是形容詞；表示“以前”用副詞previously。

tr: n. 先見, 預知
def: n. a prophetic vision (as in a dream)
n. seeing ahead; knowing in advance; foreseeing

tr: n. 被掠食者, 犧牲者
vi. 捕食
獵物
受害者；受騙者
捕食；欺凌；坑害
def: n. a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
n. animal hunted or caught for food
v. profit from in an exploitatory manner

ex.en: The owl watched its prey from a low branch.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹從一根低矮的樹枝上注視著獵物。

ex.en: When natural prey becomes scarce, some predators move closer to farms in search of food.
ex.zh: 當天然獵物稀缺時，一些捕食者會靠近農場尋找食物。

col: prey on small animals｜捕食小動物
fall prey to fraud｜成為詐騙受害者
words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；動詞常用prey on；勿混pray。

def: n a person regarded as arrogant and annoying

tr: a. 主要的, 最初的, 原始的

s having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state

a. 主要的, 最初的, 根本的
v. 加油啟動, 灌注, 填裝
首要的；主要的
最優質的；絕佳的
def: n. a number that has no factor but itself and 1
n. the second canonical hour; about 6 a.m.
n. the time of maturity when power and vigor are greatest

ex.en: Our prime concern is getting everyone home safely tonight.
ex.zh: 我們最關心的是今晚讓所有人安全到家。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is a prime requirement for cities seeking to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 對於希望減少私家車依賴的城市而言，可靠的公共交通是一項首要需求。

col: in your prime｜處於鼎盛時期
words.tip: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一個例子。

[計] 圖元; 原語; 基元
簡陋的；粗糙的
原始的；早期的
def: n. a person who belongs to an early stage of civilization
n. a mathematical expression from which another expression is derived
n. a word serving as the basis for inflected or derived forms

ex.en: The campsite had only a primitive outdoor cooking area.
ex.zh: 營地只有一個簡陋的戶外烹飪區。

ex.en: Although these tools appear primitive, they reveal considerable skill in selecting and shaping locally available materials.
ex.zh: 儘管這些工具看起來粗糙，卻體現了選擇和加工當地材料的高超技藝。

col: primitive life forms｜原始生命形式
words.tip: 形容設施可指簡陋；用於當代民族或文化可能含貶義。

tr: a. 原始的, 自原始時代的
[醫] 原始的
def: s having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state

tr: a. 更重要的, 較早的, 在先的
n. 小隱修院院長, 大隱修院副院長
先前的；事先的
def: n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot
existing or happening before something else

ex.en: You need prior permission to use this room.
ex.zh: 你需要事先獲得許可才能使用這個房間。

ex.en: Applicants with prior experience in community work may adapt more quickly to roles in public services.
ex.zh: 有社區工作經驗的申請者可能更快適應公共服務崗位。

words.tip: prior常放名詞前；prior to相當於before。

tr: a. 太古的, 原來的, 古時的, 原始的
def: s. completely free from dirt or contamination
s. immaculately clean and unused

tr: n. 隱私, 隱居, 秘密
[計] 個人保密權
隱私；隱私權
獨處；不受打擾的狀態
def: n. the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
Freedom from unwanted access to personal information or private life.

ex.en: Please knock before entering; everyone needs a little privacy.
ex.zh: 進門前請敲門；每個人都需要一點私人空間。

ex.en: Governments should protect individual privacy while allowing researchers to use anonymous data for public health studies.
ex.zh: 政府應保護個人隱私，同時允許研究人員使用匿名數據開展公共衛生研究。

col: in the privacy of your home｜在家中不受打擾地
words.tip: 通常不可數；英美髮音首音節差異明顯。

tr: n. 缺乏, 窮困

n. act of depriving someone of food or money or rights

特權；特殊待遇
榮幸
def: n. a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all
n. (law) the right to refuse to divulge information obtained in a confidential relationship
v. bestow a privilege upon

ex.en: Having the whole garden to myself felt like a privilege.
ex.zh: 能獨自享用整個花園，感覺像是獲得了特殊待遇。

ex.en: Access to quality education should be a universal right rather than a privilege reserved for wealthy families.
ex.zh: 獲得優質教育應是人人享有的權利，而不是富裕家庭獨享的特權。

words.tip: 表示榮幸常用have the privilege of doing。

tr: n. 探索, 調查, 探針, 探測器
v. 用探針探測, 調查, 探索
深入調查；探查
深入調查
探針；探測器
def: n. an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities
n. a flexible slender surgical instrument with a blunt end that is used to explore wounds or body cavities
n. an exploratory action or expedition

ex.en: The electrician probed behind the wall for damaged wires.
ex.zh: 電工探查牆後是否有損壞的電線。

ex.en: Independent investigators should probe the causes of industrial accidents to prevent similar incidents in the future.
ex.zh: 獨立調查人員應深入調查工業事故的原因，以防今後發生類似事件。

words.tip: 動詞可直接接調查對象，也可用probe into。

tr: n. 誠實, 正直
def: n. complete and confirmed integrity; having strong moral principles

tr: a. 成問題的, 未定的, 疑難的, 有疑問的, 蓋然性的, 或然性的
def: s open to doubt or debate
s making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

tr: n. 程序, 過程, 手續
[計] 規程; 過程
程序；手續；步驟
醫療操作；手術
def: n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result
n. a mode of conducting legal and parliamentary proceedings
an established series of actions for completing a task

ex.en: The receptionist explained the procedure for joining the gym.
ex.zh: 接待員說明了辦理健身房會員的手續。

ex.en: Every laboratory should establish a clear procedure for handling chemicals safely and disposing of waste responsibly.
ex.zh: 每個實驗室都應制定明確規程，以安全處理化學品並妥善處置廢物。

words.tip: procedure 強調規定步驟；process 更側重整個過程。

tr: pl. 收益
[經] 收入, 收款, 所得
def: n the income or profit arising from such transactions as the sale of land or other property
v continue talking
v move ahead; travel onward in time or space

tr: n. 隊伍, 連續, 列隊行進, 湧出

tr: vt. 宣佈, 公告, 宣言, 表明, 讚揚
[法] 宣佈, 宣告, 公佈
def: v. declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
v. state or announce

tr: n. 宣言, 公佈, 佈告, 公告
[法] 宣告, 宣佈, 佈告
def: n. the formal act of proclaiming; giving public notice

tr: n. 傾向, 癖性
def: n. a natural inclination

tr: v. 延遲, 耽擱
def: v. postpone doing what one should be doing
v. postpone or delay needlessly

tr: a. 普羅克汝斯忒斯的, 強求一致的
def: a. of or relating to the mythical giant Procrustes or the mode of torture practiced by him

tr: n. 獲得
[經] 採購
def: n. the act of getting possession of something

tr: n. 刺針, 刺棒, 激勵話, 提醒物
vt. 戳, 刺, 刺激
vi. 戳, 刺
def: n. a pointed instrument that is used to prod into a state of motion
v. urge on; cause to act

tr: n. 浪費者
a. 浪費的, 揮霍的, 豐富的
def: n. a recklessly extravagant consumer

tr: a. 龐大的, 驚人的, 異常的
def: s so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
s of momentous or ominous significance
s far beyond what is usual in magnitude or degree

tr: a. 世俗的, 不敬神的, 褻瀆的
vt. 褻瀆, 玷汙
褻瀆的；粗俗的
褻瀆
def: a. not concerned with or devoted to religion
s. not holy because unconsecrated or impure or defiled
Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.

ex.en: The coach apologised for his profane language after the match.
ex.zh: 教練為賽後說的粗話道了歉。

ex.en: Museums should explain why objects considered ordinary by outsiders may be sacred, making careless treatment seem profane.
ex.zh: 博物館應解釋為何外人眼中的普通物品可能是神聖之物，以致隨意對待會顯得褻瀆。

col: profane a sacred place｜褻瀆聖地
words.tip: 形容詞常修飾language；動詞指褻瀆神聖事物。

tr: vt. 提供, 貢獻, 提議
n. 提供, 提議
def: n a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
v present for acceptance or rejection

tr: n. 精通, 熟練, 精練
熟練；精通
def: n. the quality of having great facility and competence
n. skillfulness in the command of fundamentals deriving from practice and familiarity
A high level of skill or ability in something.

ex.en: Her proficiency in French helped us order dinner easily.
ex.zh: 她熟練掌握法語，讓我們輕鬆點好了晚餐。

ex.en: Universities often require evidence of English proficiency to ensure students can participate fully in academic discussions.
ex.zh: 大學通常要求提供英語能力證明，以確保學生能夠充分參與學術討論。

col: proficiency in English｜英語熟練程度
words.tip: 常用proficiency in接語言、學科或技能。

tr: n. 高手, 專家
a. 精通的, 熟練的
熟練的；精通的
def: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
a of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill
Able to do something well through training and practice.

ex.en: After months of practice, she became proficient at sewing.
ex.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她的縫紉技術變得很熟練。

ex.en: Graduates who are proficient in a second language may have better access to international employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 熟練掌握第二語言的畢業生可能更容易獲得國際就業機會。

col: proficient at using software｜熟練使用軟件的
words.tip: 常用proficient in某領域或at某項活動。

tr: n. 側面, 輪廓, 傳略

[計] 提問檔; 剖面圖法; 剖面法
側面；側面輪廓
簡介；概況

n. an outline of something (especially a human face as seen from one side)
n. biographical sketch

ex.en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
ex.zh: 她用軟鉛筆畫出了祖父的側面輪廓。

ex.en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 公共展覽能提高當地藝術家的知名度，並吸引遊客前往小城鎮。

col: raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度
keep a low profile｜保持低調
words.tip: in profile指呈側面；a high profile指高關注度。

tr: a. 有利潤的, 有利益的, 賺錢的

tr: n. 獲暴利的人, 奸商
vi. 獲暴利, 賺大錢
def: n. someone who makes excessive profit (especially on goods in short supply)
v. make an unreasonable profit, as on the sale of difficult to obtain goods

tr: n. 放蕩, 不檢點, 浪費
def: n. dissolute indulgence in sensual pleasure

tr: a. 放蕩的, 不檢點的, 浪費的
n. 放蕩者, 享樂者
def: n a dissolute man in fashionable society
n a recklessly extravagant consumer
s recklessly wasteful

tr: a. 極深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 淵博的
深遠的；強烈的
深刻的；深邃的
def: a. showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth
s. of the greatest intensity; complete
s. coming from deep within one

ex.en: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
ex.zh: 見到兒時的老師讓我心中充滿了深深的感激。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的互聯網接入對偏遠社區的教育機會產生了深遠影響。

words.tip: 常修飾impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。

tr: n. 深度, 深奧, 深刻, 深厚
def: n. intellectual depth; penetrating knowledge; keen insight; etc

tr: a. 很多的, 豐富的, 浪費的, 慷慨的
大量的；過多的
def: s produced or growing in extreme abundance
Produced or expressed in very large amounts

ex.en: He offered profuse apologies for spilling my tea.
ex.zh: 他打翻了我的茶，連聲道歉。

ex.en: Profuse sweating during outdoor exercise can increase fluid loss, making regular water intake particularly important.
ex.zh: 戶外運動時大量出汗會增加水分流失，因此定期補水尤為重要。

words.tip: 常修飾出汗、道歉或感謝，強調量大或反覆。

tr: n. 祖先, 先輩, 原本
[醫] 祖先, 祖代
def: n. an ancestor in the direct line

tr: n. 子孫, 後裔, 成果
[醫] 後代, 後裔
def: n the immediate descendants of a person

tr: n. 預測, 預後
[醫] 預後
def: n. a prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop
n. a prediction of the course of a disease

tr: vt. 預兆, 預言, 預測
[醫] 預測(疾病的結局)
def: v make a prediction about; tell in advance
v indicate by signs

tr: vt. 禁止, 阻止
[經] 禁止
正式禁止
阻止；使不可能
def: v command against
To officially forbid an action through rules or laws.
To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.

ex.en: The pool rules prohibit running on the wet floor.
ex.zh: 泳池規定禁止在溼滑的地面上奔跑。

ex.en: Governments should prohibit the dumping of untreated industrial waste into rivers to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府應禁止將未經處理的工業廢物傾倒入河，以保護公眾健康。

col: prohibit someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
prohibit the use of｜禁止使用
words.tip: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

tr: a. 禁止的, 禁止性的
[經] 禁止性的, 抑制的
def: s. tending to discourage (especially of prices)

tr: n. 發射體, 拋射物
a. 發射的, 投射的
def: n. a weapon that is forcibly thrown or projected at a targets but is not self-propelled
s. impelling or impelled forward

tr: n. 發射, 計劃, 突出部分, 設計, 推測
[計] 投影
def: n. a prediction made by extrapolating from past observations
n. the projection of an image from a film onto a screen
n. any structure that branches out from a central support

tr: n. 計劃人, 發起人, 規劃人, 放映機, 映畫器, 幻燈機, 幻燈, 探照燈, 發射器
[計] 投影儀
def: n. an optical device for projecting a beam of light
n. an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen

tr: vi. 增殖, 激增, 擴散
vt. 使激增
def: v. grow rapidly
v. cause to grow or increase rapidly

tr: a. 有生殖力的, 多產的, 豐富的
[醫] 多育的, 多產的, 繁殖的
多產的；成果豐碩的
繁殖旺盛的
def: s. bearing in abundance especially offspring
Producing many works, results or achievements.
Producing many young, flowers, fruits or seeds.

ex.en: My aunt is a prolific painter with two studios.
ex.zh: 我姑姑是位多產的畫家，擁有兩間畫室。

ex.en: Prolific researchers can contribute substantially to scientific progress, but publication quantity should not outweigh quality.
ex.zh: 成果豐碩的研究者能大力推動科學進步，但發表數量不應比質量更受重視。

col: a prolific breeder｜繁殖力強的動物
words.tip: 強調產出多，不等於作品質量一定高。

tr: a. 冗長的, 說話羅唆的
def: a. tediously prolonged or tending to speak or write at great length

tr: n. 開場白, 序言, 序幕
vt. 為...作序, 加上...前言
def: n. an introduction to a play

tr: vt. 延長, 拖延, 拖長
[化] 冷凝管
def: v. lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
v. lengthen or extend in duration or space

tr: n. 散步, 騎馬, 舞會
vi. 漫步, 兜風
vt. 在...散步
def: n. a formal ball held for a school class toward the end of the academic year
n. a public area set aside as a pedestrian walk
n. a square dance figure; couples march counterclockwise in a circle

tr: n. 突起, 突出, 顯著, 突出物, 凸出
[醫] 隆凸, 凸
顯著；重要；知名
def: n. the state of being prominent: widely known or eminent
n. relative importance
The state of being noticeable, important, or widely known.

ex.en: The gallery gave her painting prominence near the entrance.
ex.zh: 畫廊把她的畫擺在入口附近的顯眼位置。

ex.en: Environmental issues have gained prominence in public debate as communities experience more frequent extreme weather events.
ex.zh: 隨著各地遭遇極端天氣事件的頻率上升，環境議題在公共討論中日益受到關注。

words.tip: 通常不可數；rise to prominence指嶄露頭角。

tr: a. 卓越的, 顯著的, 突出的, 凸出的
重要的；著名的
顯眼的；突出的
def: s having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
s conspicuous in position or importance
Important, well known, or influential

ex.en: A prominent local artist opened the exhibition yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天，一位當地著名藝術家為展覽揭幕。

ex.en: Universities play a prominent role in developing technologies that support the transition to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 大學在開發支持向可再生能源轉型的技術方面發揮著重要作用。

words.tip: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形顯眼。

tr: a. 約定的, 約好的, 約定支付的
[經] 約定支付的
承諾的；約定支付的
def: a. relating to or having the character of a promise
containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay

ex.en: She signed a promissory note before borrowing the money.
ex.zh: 她借錢前簽署了一張本票。

ex.en: A promissory note provides written evidence of debt, helping lenders establish their legal right to repayment.
ex.zh: 本票提供書面的債務憑證，幫助出借人確立依法獲得償還的權利。

words.tip: 主要用於法律金融語境，常見搭配為promissory note。

tr: vt. 促進, 晉升, 創辦, 推銷
[經] 促進, 推廣, 推銷
促進；提倡
晉升；提拔
宣傳；推銷
def: v. contribute to the progress or growth of
v. give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v. be changed for a superior chess or checker piece

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我們當地的俱樂部通過免費的週末騎行活動推廣騎車。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 學校可以通過提供營養餐並鼓勵學生定期鍛鍊來倡導更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促進經濟增長
be promoted to manager｜獲晉升為經理
words.tip: 晉升到某職位用be promoted to＋職位。

tr: n. 晉級, 創建, 增進
[經] 推廣, 推銷, 促進
def: n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
n. act of raising in rank or position
n. encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something

tr: n. 激勵, 提示, 提醒物, 提詞, 付款期限
a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提詞員的
vt. 激勵, 鼓動, 提示
adv. 準時地
[計] 提示符; DOS內部命令:設定DOS命令行的提示符
def: n. a cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)
n. (computer science) a symbol that appears on the computer screen to indicate that the computer is ready to receive a command
v. serve as the inciting cause of

tr: n. 敏捷, 機敏
def: n. the characteristic of doing things without delay

tr: vt. 發佈, 公佈, 發表, 傳播
[法] 頒佈, 公告, 散播
def: v. put a law into effect by formal declaration

tr: a. 俯伏的, 面向下的, 有...傾向的
[醫] 旋前的, 伏的, 俯的
易於遭受的；有傾向的
俯臥的
def: s. having a tendency (to); often used in combination
s. lying face downward
Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way

ex.en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我的皮膚在寒冷天氣裡容易乾燥。

ex.en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升和極端風暴日益頻繁，沿海居民區越來越容易遭受洪災。

words.tip: prone to後接名詞或動名詞，通常指不好的情況。

tr: n. 叉狀物, 耙子
vt. 刺, 貫穿, 翻掘
def: n. a pointed projection

tr: a. 發出音的, 讀出來的, 顯著的, 斷然的, 明顯的
[法] 顯著的, 明顯的, 明確的
def: v speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way
v pronounce judgment on
s strongly marked; easily noticeable

tr: vt. 校正, 校對
def: v. read for errors

tr: n. 支柱, 支持者, 倚靠人, 道具, 螺旋槳
vt. 支撐, 維持
def: n. a support placed beneath or against something to keep it from shaking or falling

tr: n. 宣傳, 宣傳活動
[醫] 宣傳
def: n. information that is spread for the purpose of promoting some cause

tr: vt. 繁殖, 傳播, 傳送
vi. 繁殖, 蔓延
傳播；宣傳
繁殖；使增殖
def: v. transmit from one generation to the next
v. travel through the air
v. transmit

ex.en: Unverified stories propagate quickly when people share them online.
ex.zh: 人們在網上轉發時，未經核實的說法會迅速傳播。

ex.en: Community nurseries can propagate native plants from cuttings, supporting habitat restoration without removing specimens from the wild.
ex.zh: 社區苗圃可以通過扦插繁殖本土植物，支持棲息地修復，而不必從野外移取植株。

col: propagate from cuttings｜通過扦插繁殖
words.tip: 既可指傳播觀念，也可指繁殖植物；語體較正式。

tr: vt. 推進, 驅使
[機] 推進
def: v. cause to move forward with force

tr: n. 傾向, 愛好, 習性
def: n an inclination to do something
n a natural inclination
n a disposition to behave in a certain way

tr: n. 預言, 預言能力
預言
預言能力
def: n. knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)
n. a prediction uttered under divine inspiration
a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge

ex.en: In the story, an ancient prophecy finally came true.
ex.zh: 故事中，一個古老的預言終於應驗了。

ex.en: Low expectations can become a self-fulfilling prophecy when students receive less encouragement and fewer opportunities to improve.
ex.zh: 當學生得到的鼓勵和進步機會更少時，低期望可能成為自我實現的預言。

col: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我實現的預言
the gift of prophecy｜預言天賦
words.tip: prophecy是名詞；動詞prophesy詞尾讀/saɪ/。

tr: n. 預言者, 先知, 提倡者
先知
預言者
def: n. an authoritative person who divines the future
n. someone who speaks by divine inspiration; someone who is an interpreter of the will of God
Someone believed to communicate messages from a god.

ex.en: The old painting shows a prophet addressing a crowd.
ex.zh: 這幅古畫描繪了一位先知向人群講話的情景。

ex.en: Throughout history, religious communities have preserved the teachings of prophets through oral traditions and written accounts.
ex.zh: 縱觀歷史，宗教群體通過口述傳統和書面記載保存了先知的教誨。

col: a prophet of doom｜災難預言者
the teachings of a prophet｜先知的教誨
words.tip: 與profit（利潤）同音；動詞為prophesy。

tr: a. 預言的, 先知的, 預示的
def: a. foretelling events as if by supernatural intervention

tr: vt. 慰撫, 安撫, 和解, 謀求...的好感
def: v. make peace with

tr: a. 順利的, 適合的, 吉祥的, 慈悲的
def: a. presenting favorable circumstances; likely to result in or show signs of success

tr: n. 建議, 命題, 主張
vt. 向...提議, 向...提出猥褻的要求
提議；建議
主張；命題
def: n. (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false
n. an offer for a private bargain (especially a request for sexual favors)
n. a task to be dealt with

ex.en: Your proposition sounds sensible, but we need more time.
ex.zh: 你的提議聽起來很合理，但我們還需要些時間。

ex.en: The proposition that smaller classes always improve learning outcomes requires careful evaluation across different educational contexts.
ex.zh: 小班教學總能改善學習效果這一主張，需要結合不同教育背景仔細評估。

col: an attractive proposition｜有吸引力的提議
support a proposition｜支持一項主張
words.tip: 作主張講可接 that 從句；提議常用 proposal。

tr: a. 所有者的, 所有權的, 私有的
n. 所有者, 業主, 所有權
def: a. protected by trademark or patent or copyright; made or produced or distributed by one having exclusive rights

tr: n. 禮貌, 規矩, 適當
[計] 專有權
def: n. correct or appropriate behavior

tr: n. 推進, 推進力
[醫] 前衝, 慌張步態
推進；推進力
def: n. a propelling force
n. the act of propelling
The force or process that moves something forward

ex.en: This small boat relies on electric propulsion to move quietly.
ex.zh: 這艘小船靠電力推進，行駛時很安靜。

ex.en: Advances in electric propulsion could reduce both noise pollution and fuel consumption in coastal shipping.
ex.zh: 電力推進技術的進步有望減少沿海航運的噪聲汙染和燃料消耗。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞，常用於船舶、飛機和航天器。

tr: vt.vi. (使)閉會, (使)休會
[法] 使休會, 使閉會
def: v. adjourn by royal prerogative; without dissolving the legislative body

tr: a. 散文的, 散文體的, 平凡的
def: s not fanciful or imaginative
s lacking wit or imagination
s not challenging; dull and lacking excitement

tr: vt. 剝奪...的公民權, 使失去法律保護, 把...充軍, 把...放逐, 排斥, 禁止
def: v command against

tr: n. 散文
v. 寫散文
a. 散文的, 平凡的
散文；非韻文
def: n. ordinary writing as distinguished from verse
n. matter of fact, commonplace, or dull expression
Ordinary written language, rather than poetry

ex.en: Her clear prose makes this book easy to enjoy.
ex.zh: 她清晰流暢的文筆讓這本書讀起來輕鬆愉快。

ex.en: Reading well-crafted prose can help students develop a wider vocabulary and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 閱讀精心寫就的散文可以幫助學生擴大詞彙量，更清晰地表達複雜觀點。

words.tip: 不可數；不限於文學散文，也包括小說等非韻文。

tr: vt. 告發, 起訴, 徹底進行, 執行, 從事
vi. 告發, 起訴, 作檢察官
def: v. conduct a prosecution in a court of law
v. bring a criminal action against (in a trial)
v. carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in

tr: n. 執行, 經營, 起訴
刑事起訴；檢控
控方
def: n. the institution and conduct of legal proceedings against a defendant for criminal behavior
n. the lawyers acting for the state to put the case against the defendant
The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.

ex.en: The shop owner faced prosecution for selling stolen bicycles.
ex.zh: 那位店主因出售偷來的自行車而面臨刑事起訴。

ex.en: Effective prosecution of environmental offences requires reliable evidence and sufficient resources for specialist legal teams.
ex.zh: 有效起訴環境違法行為需要可靠的證據，也需要為專業法律團隊提供充足資源。

col: the prosecution case｜控方的案情陳述
words.tip: the prosecution指刑事案件控方，不是民事原告。

tr: vt. 使改變宗教信仰
vi. 勸誘改變宗教信仰
def: v. convert to another faith or religion

tr: n. 景色, 展望
vt. 勘探, 勘察
vi. 勘探, 有前途
可能性；預期
前景；成功機會
def: n. the possibility of future success
v. search for something desirable
v. explore for useful or valuable things or substances, such as minerals

ex.en: The prospect of a beach holiday cheered us up.
ex.zh: 想到即將去海邊度假，我們的心情好了起來。

ex.en: Access to vocational training can improve employment prospects for young people in economically disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 獲得職業培訓的機會能改善經濟欠發達地區年輕人的就業前景。

col: a realistic prospect｜切實的可能性
words.tip: 前景常用複數prospects；of後可接動名詞。

tr: n. 繁榮, 茂盛, 成功
[經] 繁榮
繁榮；富足
def: n. an economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment
n. the condition of prospering; having good fortune
The state of being economically successful and financially secure.

ex.en: The busy harbour brought prosperity to our town.
ex.zh: 繁忙的港口為我們的小鎮帶來了繁榮。

ex.en: Investment in education can support long-term prosperity by giving workers the skills needed in a changing economy.
ex.zh: 教育投資能讓勞動者掌握經濟轉型所需的技能，從而促進長期繁榮。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；形容詞用prosperous。

tr: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸運的
[經] 繁榮的, 昌盛的
繁榮的；富裕的
def: s in fortunate circumstances financially; moderately rich
s very lively and profitable
s marked by peace and prosperity

ex.en: The once quiet village is now a prosperous market town.
ex.zh: 這個曾經安靜的村莊如今已成為繁榮的集鎮。

ex.en: A prosperous economy can generate the resources needed to improve education, healthcare, and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 繁榮的經濟能夠創造改善教育、醫療和公共基礎設施所需的資源。

words.tip: 常修飾國家、地區或經濟，強調經濟上的興旺。

tr: a. 拜倒的, 降伏的, 俯臥的, 衰竭的, 沮喪的
vt. 弄倒, 使屈服, 使俯伏, 使平臥
俯臥的；伏地的
精疲力竭的；悲痛難支的
使俯伏；使衰弱
def: v. get into a prostrate position, as in submission
v. render helpless or defenseless
v. throw down flat, as on the ground

ex.en: After crawling under the fence, he lay prostrate on the grass.
ex.zh: 從圍欄下爬過去後，他俯臥在草地上。

ex.en: Extreme heat can leave outdoor workers prostrate with exhaustion, highlighting the importance of regular breaks.
ex.zh: 酷熱會使戶外工作者疲憊不堪，凸顯了定時休息的重要性。

col: prostrate with exhaustion｜疲憊得無法動彈
words.tip: 勿與prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一個r。

tr: n. 主人公, 主角, 領導者
def: n. the principal character in a work of fiction

tr: a. 千變萬化的, 變化不定的, (海神)普羅透斯的
def: s. taking on different forms

tr: a. 給予保護的, 保護的
[醫] 保護的, 防護的, 保護劑, 保護物, 油綢
防護的；保護性的
關切保護的
def: a. intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind
s. showing care
s. (usually followed by `of') solicitously caring or mindful

ex.en: Wear protective gloves before handling those sharp metal pieces.
ex.zh: 拿那些鋒利的金屬片之前，要戴上防護手套。

ex.en: Employers should provide protective equipment and regular training to reduce injuries in dangerous workplaces.
ex.zh: 僱主應提供防護裝備和定期培訓，以減少危險工作場所中的傷害事故。

col: protective of someone｜關切保護某人
words.tip: 表示關切保護某人，用be protective of。

ex.en: Retailers increasingly allow customers to redeem loyalty points for products made from recycled materials.
ex.zh: 越來越多的零售商允許顧客用會員積分兌換再生材料製成的產品。

words.tip: redeem A for B 表示用券或積分A兌換B。

tr: a. 贖回的, 救世的, 贖身的
def: a. of or relating to or resulting in redemption
s. bringing about salvation or redemption from sin

tr: vt. 重新寄送, 使改道, 使改方向
[計] 重定向, 重新引導
def: v. channel into a new direction

tr: n. 重新分配, 再分發
[計] 重新分配
def: n. distributing again

tr: a. 芬芳的, 有...香味的, 令人想起...的
def: s. (used with `of' or `with') noticeably odorous

tr: a. 可怕的, 厲害的, 可敬的
def: s. worthy of respect or honor

tr: n. 賠償, 補救, 矯正
vt. 糾正, 賠償, 救濟
def: n. act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil

tr: n. 過多, 冗長, 累贅, 多餘, 冗餘位, 冗餘度, 冗餘碼, 多餘信息
[計] 冗餘
裁員；職位撤銷
冗餘；多餘重複
備用配置；冗餘備份
def: n. repetition of messages to reduce the probability of errors in transmission
n. the attribute of being superfluous and unneeded
n. (electronics) a system design that duplicates components to provide alternatives in case one component fails

ex.en: After the factory closed, Elena faced redundancy and financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 工廠關閉後，埃琳娜面臨裁員和經濟上的不確定性。

ex.en: Automation may increase productivity, but employers should offer retraining to workers at risk of redundancy.
ex.zh: 自動化可能提高生產率，但僱主應為面臨裁員風險的員工提供再培訓。

words.tip: 英式英語常指裁員；技術語境可指保障運行的備用配置。

tr: a. 多餘的, 過多的, 冗長的
[醫] 過多的, 多餘的
多餘的；不必要的
因崗位取消而被裁的
def: s more than is needed, desired, or required
s repetition of same sense in different words
unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something

ex.en: This spare cable is redundant now we use wireless speakers.
ex.zh: 既然我們用無線音箱了，這根備用線就多餘了。

ex.en: Factory workers may be made redundant when automated systems take over tasks previously performed by people.
ex.zh: 當自動化系統接手原先由人完成的任務時，工廠工人可能會被裁員。

words.tip: 英式英語中be made redundant指崗位取消而被裁員。

tr: n. 煙, 水蒸氣, 臭氣散發
vi. 冒煙, 發臭氣, 散發
vt. 用煙燻, 散發
def: v. smell badly and offensively
v. be wet with sweat or blood, as of one's face
v. give off smoke, fumes, warm vapour, steam, etc.

tr: n. 卷軸, 一卷, 紡車, 旋轉, 蹣跚
vt. 卷...於軸上, 繞, 使旋轉
vi. 蹣跚地走, 旋轉, 眩暈, 搖晃, 退縮
[計] 卷; 盤
卷軸；一卷膠片等
def: n. a roll of photographic film holding a series of frames to be projected by a movie projector
n. music composed for dancing a reel
n. winder consisting of a revolving spool with a handle; attached to a fishing rod

ex.en: She wound the loose fishing line onto the reel.
ex.zh: 她把鬆散的釣魚線繞到了卷線輪上。

ex.en: Local businesses continued to reel from the sudden closure of the region's largest factory.
ex.zh: 該地區最大工廠突然關閉，當地企業持續受到嚴重衝擊。

col: a reel of film｜一卷膠片
reel from the shock｜因震驚而不知所措
reel off a list｜一口氣列舉
words.tip: reel from表示受衝擊；reel off表示一口氣說出。

tr: n. 重考, 再檢查, 再審查
[法] 再審問, 再調查, 再檢查
def: n (law) questioning of a witness by the party that called the witness after that witness has been subject to cross-examination
n a subsequent examination of a patient for the purpose of monitoring earlier treatment

tr: n. 餐廳
def: n. a communal dining-hall (usually in a monastery)

tr: n. 指示物
def: n. something referred to; the object of a reference
n. the first term in a proposition; the term to which other terms relate
n. something that refers; a term that refers to another term

tr: a. 反射的, 反映的, 沉思的
def: a. capable of physically reflecting light or sound
s. devoted to matters of the mind

tr: n. 折光, 折射
[醫] 折射, 屈光
def: n. the change in direction of a propagating wave (light or sound) when passing from one medium to another

tr: n. 重複的話, 疊句, 副歌
vi. 節制, 避免, 剋制
剋制；避免做
副歌；反覆出現的話
def: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers
v. resist doing something
To deliberately stop yourself from doing something.

ex.en: Please refrain from feeding the ducks near the bridge.
ex.zh: 請不要給橋邊的鴨子餵食。

ex.en: Visitors should refrain from touching fragile exhibits so that museums can preserve them for future generations.
ex.zh: 參觀者應避免觸碰易損展品，以便博物館將其保存下來，留給後代。

col: refrain from doing something｜避免做某事
words.tip: 動詞常用refrain from doing，語氣較正式。

tr: vt. 使清新, 使恢復, 使生氣蓬勃
vi. 提起精神, 恢復精神, 吃點心, 喝飲料
vt. 刷新, 重新整理
vi. 刷新, 重新整理
[計] 刷新, 重新整理
def: v. make (to feel) fresh
v. make fresh again
To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable.

ex.en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很遠的路後，衝個涼讓我恢復了精神。

ex.en: Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.
ex.zh: 定時休息能讓員工恢復精神，幫助他們在需要持續腦力投入的任務中保持專注。

words.tip: 人感覺精神恢復用refreshed；令人清爽用refreshing。

tr: vt. 使冷卻, 使清涼, 冷藏
[機] 冷凍
def: v. preserve by chilling
v. cool or chill in or as if in a refrigerator

tr: a. 輝煌的, 燦爛的
def: s radiating or as if radiating light

tr: vt. 再磨光, 刷新
def: v. make brighter and prettier

tr: vt. 反駁, 駁斥；駁倒
駁倒；證明錯誤
def: v. overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof
v. prove to be false or incorrect
to prove that a statement or argument is wrong

ex.en: These photos refute the claim that our gate was broken.
ex.zh: 這些照片證明，關於我們大門損壞的說法不實。

ex.en: Reliable scientific evidence can refute misleading claims about nutrition and help consumers make informed dietary choices.
ex.zh: 可靠的科學證據能夠駁倒有關營養的誤導性說法，幫助消費者作出明智的飲食選擇。

col: refute a claim｜駁倒某種說法
words.tip: 強調用證據證明錯誤，不只是表示不同意。

tr: vt. 款待, 使快樂
vi. 享用
n. 盛宴, 佳餚, 款待
def: v. provide with choice or abundant food or drink

tr: vt. 使再生, 重建, 革新
vi. 新生, 再生
a. 新生的, 再生的
[計] 再生; 重寫
def: v. reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new
v. amplify (an electron current) by causing part of the power in the output circuit to act upon the input circuit
v. return to life; get or give new life or energy

tr: n. 政權, 當權期間, 政體, 社會制度, 體制, 情態
[醫] 制度, 生活制度
政權；政治體制
管理制度；生活安排
def: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
n (medicine) a systematic plan for therapy (often including diet)
a government or system of government, especially an authoritarian one

ex.en: The new regime promised to reopen the public library.
ex.zh: 新政權承諾重新開放公共圖書館。

ex.en: An authoritarian regime may restrict public debate, making it harder for citizens to influence government decisions.
ex.zh: 威權政權可能限制公共討論，使公民更難影響政府決策。

words.tip: 指政權時常含貶義；也可指稅制或鍛鍊安排。

tr: a. 團的, 附屬於團的
n. 團服, 軍服
def: a. belonging to or concerning a regiment

tr: n. 退回, 復歸權, 迴歸, 倒退, 退步, 退化, 退行
vi. 退回, 復歸, 迴歸, 倒退, 退步, 退化, 退行
def: n. the reasoning involved when you assume the conclusion is true and reason backward to the evidence
v. go back to a statistical means
v. get worse or fall back to a previous condition

tr: a. 後退的, 退化的, 迴歸的
[醫] 退化的, 退行的, 消退的, 迴歸的
def: a. (of taxes) adjusted so that the rate decreases as the amount of income increases
a. opposing progress; returning to a former less advanced state

tr: adv. 懊悔地, 抱歉地
遺憾地；惋惜地
def: r. with regret (used in polite formulas)
In a way that expresses sadness or disappointment about something.

ex.en: I regretfully declined the invitation because I was working.
ex.zh: 因為要工作，我遺憾地謝絕了邀請。

ex.en: The council regretfully announced that budget constraints would delay the construction of a new community centre.
ex.zh: 市政委員會遺憾地宣佈，預算限制將導致新社區中心推遲建設。

words.tip: regretfully強調人的遺憾；regrettably評價事情可惜。

tr: a. 受控制的, 統制的, 調整的
[經] 規則的
def: s restricting according to rules or principles

tr: v. (使)回湧, (使)迴流, (使)反胃
def: v. pour or rush back
v. feed through the beak by regurgitating previously swallowed food
v. repeat after memorization

tr: vt. 恢復原狀, 修復, 使康復
[法] 恢復, 使恢復心理健康, 修復
def: v. help to readapt, as to a former state of health or good repute
v. reinstall politically
v. restore to a state of good condition or operation

tr: vt. 預演, 排演, 使熟練掌握, 練習, 複述
vi. 排練, 練習, 演習
排練；預演
def: v. engage in a rehearsal (of)
to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly

ex.en: We rehearsed our dance in the empty school hall.
ex.zh: 我們在空蕩蕩的學校禮堂裡排練舞蹈。

ex.en: Students who rehearse their presentations with classmates often develop greater confidence and communicate their ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 與同學一起預演展示的學生，往往會更自信，也能更清晰地表達觀點。

col: rehearse for a performance｜為演出排練
words.tip: rehearse後直接接排練內容；為演出排練用for。

tr: a. 統治的；在位的；本屆的；起支配作用的
def: v have sovereign power
v be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance
s exercising power or authority

tr: vt. 付還, 償還, 賠償
[經] 償付, 賠還, 付還; 償還
def: v. pay back for some expense incurred

tr: vt. 使轉世化身, 使重新體現
a. 轉世化身的, 再生的
def: v. be born anew in another body after death
v. cause to appear in a new form
s. having a new body

tr: vt. 使復原, 使恢復, 使復立
def: v. restore to the previous state or rank

tr: vt. 反覆地說, 重申, 反覆地做
[法] 重述, 重申, 反覆地做
重申；再次強調
def: v to say, state, or perform again
to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it

ex.en: Before we left, Dad reiterated the importance of staying together.
ex.zh: 出發前，爸爸再次強調了不要走散的重要性。

ex.en: The report reiterates that investment in public transport is essential for reducing urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 該報告重申，投資公共交通對減少城市空氣汙染至關重要。

words.tip: 是動詞，不是形容詞；可接名詞或 that 從句。

tr: vt. 使歡喜
vi. 欣喜, 高興, 慶祝
欣喜；歡慶
def: v. feel happiness or joy
Feel or show great happiness about something.

ex.en: We rejoiced when our missing cat finally came home.
ex.zh: 失蹤的貓終於回家了，我們欣喜不已。

ex.en: Residents rejoiced at the reopening of their local library, which provides valuable educational resources.
ex.zh: 當地居民為圖書館重新開放而歡欣鼓舞，因為它提供了寶貴的教育資源。

col: rejoice at the news｜為消息感到欣喜
rejoice in someone's success｜為某人的成功歡喜
words.tip: 較正式；常用rejoice at/in或接that從句。

tr: vt. 使再結合, 再加入, 回答
vi. 重新聚合, 回答, 第二次答辯
def: v. join again

tr: n. 回答, 答辯, 答覆
[法] 答辯, 反駁, 第二次答辯
def: n. a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)
n. (law) a pleading made by a defendant in response to the plaintiff's replication

tr: vt. 使年輕, 使復原, 使恢復精神
vi. 返老還童, 復原
def: v. cause (a stream or river) to erode, as by an uplift of the land
v. develop youthful topographical features
v. make younger or more youthful

tr: vt. 再點火, 重新激起
vi. 重新燃燒
def: v. kindle anew, as of a fire
v. arouse again

tr: n. 回覆, 故態復萌, 復發
vi. 故態復萌, 再陷邪道, 再度墮落
def: v. go back to bad behavior

tr: vt. 驅逐, 使降低地位, 把...歸類, 把...委託給
[法] 流放, 判流放刑, 驅逐
def: v. refer to another person for decision or judgment
v. assign to a class or kind

tr: vi. 變寬厚, 變溫和, 動憐憫之心
def: v give in, as to influence or pressure

tr: a. 無情的, 冷酷的, 殘酷的
持續不減的；不懈的
冷酷無情的
def: s not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
s never-ceasing
continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense

ex.en: The relentless rain kept us indoors all weekend.
ex.zh: 雨下個不停，我們整個週末都待在屋裡。

ex.en: Relentless pressure to achieve high grades can undermine students' confidence and damage their mental health.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的高分壓力會削弱學生的信心，並損害他們的心理健康。

words.tip: 不限於“無情的”，也常形容雨、壓力等持續不減。

tr: n. 中肯；關聯；相關性
def: n. the relation of something to the matter at hand

tr: a. 可靠的, 可信賴的
[法] 可靠的, 可信賴的, 確實的
可靠的；可信賴的
def: a. worthy of reliance or trust
Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently

ex.en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我們的舊車在寒冷天氣裡依然很可靠。

ex.en: Access to reliable information helps citizens make informed decisions about their health and finances.
ex.zh: 獲取可靠的信息有助於公民就健康和財務作出明智決定。

words.tip: reliable可形容人、信息或機器，強調值得信賴。

tr: n. 信任, 信賴, 受信賴的人(或事)
[法] 信任, 信賴, 信心
依賴；信賴
def: n. certainty based on past experience
n. the state of relying on something
The state of depending on or trusting someone or something.

ex.en: Cycling to work has reduced my reliance on buses.
ex.zh: 騎車上班減少了我對公交車的依賴。

ex.en: Reducing reliance on fossil fuels requires sustained investment in renewable energy and improvements to public transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 減少對化石燃料的依賴，需要持續投資可再生能源，並改善公共交通基礎設施。

col: heavy reliance on｜對……的嚴重依賴
reduce reliance on｜減少對……的依賴
words.tip: reliance是不可數名詞，通常與on搭配。

tr: n. 遺物, 遺蹟, 紀念物, 遺風, 殘留物
def: n. an antiquity that has survived from the distant past

tr: vt. 減輕, 救濟, 解除, 使免除, 換...的班, 使得到調劑, 使不單調, 襯托, 使顯著
vi. 救濟, 當替補投手, 呈鮮明突出
def: v. provide physical relief, as from pain
v. free from a burden, evil, or distress
v. take by stealing

tr: a. 寬慰的, 解除的, 減輕的
寬慰的；放心的
def: v provide physical relief, as from pain
v free someone temporarily from his or her obligations
v grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to

ex.en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 終於找到鑰匙時，我鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.
ex.zh: 儘管有人提議削減預算，居民聽說當地醫院仍將繼續運營，都鬆了一口氣。

col: relieved to hear｜聽到後感到放心
words.tip: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that從句。

tr: n. 宗教, 信仰
[法] 宗教, 宗教信仰, 信仰
宗教；宗教信仰
def: n. a strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny
n. an institution to express belief in a divine power
belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
ex.zh: 今天我們在學校瞭解了不同的宗教。

ex.en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
ex.zh: 學校可以教授宗教知識，同時鼓勵學生尊重持不同信仰的人。

words.tip: 泛指宗教時不可數；指某一種宗教時可數。

tr: vt. 放棄, 撤回, 停止, 鬆開, 讓與
[法] 讓與, 把...交給, 放棄
放棄；交出
def: v part with a possession or right
v do without or cease to hold or adhere to
v turn away from; give up

ex.en: She reluctantly relinquished her seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 她不情願地讓出了靠窗的座位。

ex.en: National governments may be reluctant to relinquish control over energy policy to international organisations.
ex.zh: 各國政府可能不願將能源政策的控制權交給國際組織。

col: relinquish a claim｜放棄權利主張
words.tip: 正式及物動詞，直接接control、power、rights等。

tr: n. 滋味, 風味, 美味, 愛好, 食慾, 調味品
vt. 調味, 喜歡, 玩味
vi. 有味道
享受；期待並樂於做
樂趣；享受
def: n. spicy or savory condiment
n. the taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth
To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it.

ex.en: I relish quiet mornings with tea and a book.
ex.zh: 我很享受喝著茶、讀著書的寧靜早晨。

ex.en: Many students relish the opportunity to study abroad because it exposes them to different cultures and perspectives.
ex.zh: 許多學生非常珍惜出國學習的機會，因為這能讓他們接觸不同的文化和觀點。

col: relish a challenge｜樂於接受挑戰
relish the opportunity｜欣然把握機會
words.tip: 動詞後接名詞或動名詞，不接to do。

tr: n. 不情願, 勉強
[電] 磁阻
不情願；勉強
def: n. (physics) opposition to magnetic flux (analogous to electric resistance)
n. a certain degree of unwillingness
Unwillingness or hesitation to do something.

ex.en: With obvious reluctance, Leo handed his favourite toy back.
ex.zh: 利奧明顯很不情願地把心愛的玩具還了回去。

ex.en: Some commuters show reluctance to use public transport because services are infrequent and unreliable.
ex.zh: 一些通勤者不願乘坐公共交通，因為班次稀少且不可靠。

col: overcome one's reluctance｜克服不情願的心理
words.tip: 通常不可數，常接to do，表示不願做某事。

tr: n. 剩餘物, 其他人, 殘餘, 餘數
v. 削價出售(圖書)
a. 剩餘的, 出售削價剩書的
[計] 餘數
剩餘部分；其餘的人
def: n. something left after other parts have been taken away
n. the part of the dividend that is left over when the dividend is not evenly divisible by the divisor
n. the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend

ex.en: We ate half the cake and refrigerated the remainder.
ex.zh: 我們吃了半個蛋糕，把剩下的放進了冰箱。

ex.en: After funding essential services, the council allocated the remainder of its budget to improving public parks.
ex.zh: 在為基本服務撥款後，地方議會將剩餘預算用於改善公共公園。

tr: n. 名望, 名氣, 聲望
vt. 認為, 以為
名聲；聲譽
認為；據說
def: n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor
the general opinion people have of someone or something
to consider someone or something to have a particular quality

ex.en: The workshop hired a violin maker of considerable repute.
ex.zh: 這家工坊聘請了一位頗有聲望的小提琴製作師。

ex.en: Research institutions of international repute often attract talented students and substantial investment from overseas.
ex.zh: 享有國際聲譽的研究機構往往能吸引優秀學生和大量海外投資。

col: of international repute｜享有國際聲譽的
words.tip: 動詞多用被動式be reputed to be，意為“據說是”。

tr: n. 必需品, 要素, 必要物品
a. 必要的, 需要的
必需的；必要的
必需品；必要條件
def: n anything indispensable
s necessary for relief or supply
needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: She has the requisite skills to repair this bicycle.
ex.zh: 她具備修理這輛自行車所必需的技能。

ex.en: Applicants without the requisite qualifications may benefit from training programmes designed to improve access to skilled employment.
ex.zh: 不具備必要資歷的申請者或可受益於旨在幫助人們進入技術崗位的培訓項目。

col: a requisite for success｜成功的必要條件
words.tip: 較正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 強調先決。

tr: vt. 報答, 酬答, 還禮
def: v. make repayment for or return something

tr: vt. 廢止, 使無效, 取消, 撤消, 解除
[經] 取消, 廢除
正式撤銷；廢除
def: v cancel officially
Officially cancel a decision, agreement, or rule.

ex.en: The club rescinded its decision to close the pool.
ex.zh: 俱樂部撤銷了關閉游泳池的決定。

ex.en: The council agreed to rescind the parking restrictions after residents raised concerns about access to local shops.
ex.zh: 居民對前往當地商店的便利性提出擔憂後，地方議會同意撤銷停車限制。

words.tip: 是正式用語中的動詞，通常不表示退款。

tr: n. 廢止, 取消, 使無效, 撤消
[經] 解除, 取消
def: n (law) the act of rescinding; the cancellation of a contract and the return of the parties to the positions they would have had if the contract had not been made

tr: n. 援救, 解救, 營救
vt. 援救, 救出, 營救
營救；解救
營救；救援行動
def: n. recovery or preservation from loss or danger
v. free from harm or evil
v. take forcibly from legal custody

ex.en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，消防員從屋頂救下了一隻小貓。

ex.en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
ex.zh: 沿海社區需要裝備精良的隊伍，在嚴重洪災阻斷道路、損壞房屋時營救居民。

col: rescue someone from｜從……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前來解圍
words.tip: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示從險境中救出某人。

tr: vt. 相似, 類似
像；與……相似
def: v. appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
To look like or be similar to someone or something

ex.en: These clouds resemble small boats floating across the sky.
ex.zh: 這些雲朵像小船一樣飄過天空。

ex.en: Modern learning spaces increasingly resemble collaborative workplaces rather than traditional classrooms with fixed rows of desks.
ex.zh: 現代學習空間越來越像協作型工作場所，而非課桌排列固定的傳統教室。

words.tip: 直接接賓語：resemble someone，不加to或with。

tr: vt. 憤恨, 憎惡, 怨恨
def: v. feel bitter or indignant about

tr: a. 岔恨的, 易怨恨的, 不滿的, 顯然不滿的
憤憤不平的；怨恨的
def: a. full of or marked by resentment or indignant ill will
angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly

ex.en: He felt resentful when his brother took all the credit.
ex.zh: 哥哥把功勞全攬走時，他感到憤憤不平。

ex.en: Employees may become resentful if promotion decisions appear to favour personal connections rather than professional ability.
ex.zh: 如果晉升決定似乎更看重人脈而非專業能力，員工可能會心生不滿。

col: resentful of someone｜對某人心懷怨恨
words.tip: 強調因自覺受到不公平對待而不滿，不只是生氣。

tr: n. 怨恨, 憤恨
def: n. a feeling of deep and bitter anger and ill-will

tr: vi. 住, 居留, 屬於
[法] 居住
def: v. make one's home in a particular place or community

tr: n. 居民, 常駐程序, 居住者, 留鳥
a. 居留的, 定居的
居民；住戶
居住的；常駐的
def: n. someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
a. living in a particular place
Someone who lives in a particular place.

ex.en: Every resident received a key to the shared garden.
ex.zh: 每位住戶都拿到了一把公共花園的鑰匙。

ex.en: Local residents should be consulted before major changes are made to roads and public spaces.
ex.zh: 在對道路和公共空間進行重大改造之前，應徵求當地居民的意見。

words.tip: resident指人；residential形容住宅或居住區。

tr: a. 住宅的, 與居住有關的
[法] 有關居住的, 房產的:居所的, 適於居住的
def: a. used or designed for residence or limited to residences
a. of or relating to or connected with residence

tr: a. 殘渣的, 剩餘的
n. 殘渣, 剩餘, 餘數
殘留的；剩餘的
def: n. (often plural) a payment that is made to a performer or writer or director of a television show or commercial that is paid for every repeat showing
a. relating to or indicating a remainder
remaining after most of something has gone or been removed

ex.en: Residual heat kept the kitchen warm after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，餘熱讓廚房仍然暖和。

ex.en: Residual chemicals in agricultural soil may affect water quality long after farmers stop using them.
ex.zh: 即使農民停止使用化學品很久，農田土壤中的殘留物仍可能影響水質。

words.tip: 常用於技術語境，強調處理後仍殘留。

tr: vt. 辭職, 放棄, 使順從
vi. 辭職, 屈從
辭職；辭去
使自己接受不如意的事
def: v. accept as inevitable
To officially leave a job or position.
To accept an unpleasant situation because you cannot change it.

ex.en: She decided to resign and open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她決定辭職，開一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Employees may resign when excessive workloads and limited career opportunities make their positions increasingly difficult to sustain.
ex.zh: 當工作量過大、職業發展機會有限，使崗位越來越難以維持時，員工可能會辭職。

col: resign from a job｜辭去工作
resign as chair｜辭去主席職務
words.tip: resign oneself to後接名詞或動名詞，表示無奈接受。

tr: n. 辭職, 辭呈, 聽從
[經] 辭職
辭職；辭職信
無奈的接受；聽任
def: n. acceptance of despair
n. the act of giving up (a claim or office or possession etc.)
n. a formal document giving notice of your intention to resign

ex.en: She handed in her resignation after finding another job.
ex.zh: 她找到另一份工作後提交了辭職信。

ex.en: The resignation of experienced nurses can place additional pressure on hospitals already struggling with staff shortages.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的護士辭職，會給本已面臨人員短缺的醫院帶來額外壓力。

col: hand in your resignation｜提交辭職信
words.tip: 辭職用resignation；另一義是無奈接受，不是反抗。

tr: a. 服從的, 聽任的, 已辭職的
def: v leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily
v give up or retire from a position
v part with a possession or right

tr: n. 彈回, 有彈力, 恢復力
[化] 回彈; 彈性; 彈回性; 回能; 彈能
復原力；抗逆力
回彈性
def: n. the physical property of a material that can return to its original shape or position after deformation that does not exceed its elastic limit
n. an occurrence of rebounding or springing back
The ability to recover or adapt after difficulties

ex.en: Her resilience helped her rebuild after the flood.
ex.zh: 她憑藉堅韌的復原力在洪災後重建了生活。

ex.en: Strong community networks can increase resilience by providing practical and emotional support during economic crises.
ex.zh: 緊密的社區網絡能在經濟危機期間提供實際幫助和情感支持，從而增強抗逆力。

col: show remarkable resilience｜展現非凡的復原力
words.tip: 通常不可數，強調受挫後的恢復與適應能力。

tr: a. 彈回的, 有彈力的
[醫] 回彈的, 回能的
適應力強的；能復原的
有回彈力的
def: s. recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like
Able to recover quickly after difficulties or damage
Able to return to its original shape after being bent

ex.en: These resilient plants recovered quickly after the summer drought.
ex.zh: 這些生命力頑強的植物在夏季乾旱後很快恢復了生機。

ex.en: Investing in local support networks can help communities become more resilient to economic and environmental shocks.
ex.zh: 投資地方支持網絡可以幫助社區更好地應對經濟和環境衝擊。

col: resilient to shocks｜能抵禦衝擊的
words.tip: 既可形容人或經濟的韌性，也可指材料回彈。

tr: a. 共鳴的, 反響的, 洪亮的, 共振的
[醫] 反響的, 叩響的, 共鳴的, 共振的
def: s. characterized by resonance

tr: n. 度假勝地, 手段, 憑藉, 常去之地
vi. 訴諸, 常去
度假勝地
訴諸；求助於
應急手段；最後辦法
def: n. a hotel located in a resort area
a place people visit for holidays and leisure
to use something undesirable because other options have failed

ex.en: We stayed at a quiet resort beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我們住在湖邊一處安靜的度假村。

ex.en: Governments should not resort to cutting education budgets when seeking solutions to short-term financial problems.
ex.zh: 政府在尋求短期財政問題的解決辦法時，不應採取削減教育預算的措施。

col: as a last resort｜作為最後的辦法
words.tip: resort to中to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: vi. 迴響, 鳴響, 反響, 馳名, 被傳遍
vt. 使迴響, 傳頌
def: v. ring or echo with sound

tr: a. 資源豐富的, 策略的, 機智的
[法] 資源豐富的, 善於遂機應變的, 足智多謀的
def: s. having inner resources; adroit or imaginative

tr: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 問候
vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
尊重；敬佩
尊重；遵守
方面
def: n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point
n. an attitude of admiration or esteem
v. regard highly; think much of

ex.en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
ex.zh: 她認真傾聽，沒有打斷同事，以此表達尊重。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.
ex.zh: 學校應鼓勵學生尊重不同觀點，同時評估每種論點背後的證據。

words.tip: 名詞常接for；動詞直接接賓語，不加for。

tr: a. 呼吸的
[醫] 呼吸的
def: a. pertaining to respiration

tr: n. 暫緩, 緩期執行
vt. 使暫緩
def: n. a pause from doing something (as work)
n. a pause for relaxation

tr: a. 輝煌的, 燦爛的
def: s having great beauty and splendor

tr: a. 回答的, 應答的, 易感應的
def: a. containing or using responses; alternating
a. readily reacting or replying to people or events or stimuli; showing emotion

tr: n. 再聲明, 重述
[經] 重報, 重新陳述, 再聲明
def: n. a revised statement

tr: n. 歸還, 償還, 賠償
[醫] 整復, 恢復, 轉回(胎頭)
def: n. the act of restoring something to its original state
n. getting something back again

tr: a. 不願向前走的, 倔強的, 難駕御的
def: s. impatient especially under restriction or delay

tr: n. 難以駕御；倔強
def: n the anxious feeling you have when you have the jitters
n characterized by nervousness and quickness to take fright

tr: a. 不安靜的, 慌張的, 休息不充分的
[醫] 不安靜的, 不寧的
坐立不安的；難以休息的
不滿足現狀的
def: s. worried and uneasy
s. ceaselessly in motion
a. lacking or not affording physical or mental rest

ex.en: The restless child kept swinging her legs under the table.
ex.zh: 那個坐不住的孩子不停地在桌下晃腿。

ex.en: Students may become restless during lengthy lectures if they have few opportunities to participate actively.
ex.zh: 如果缺少積極參與的機會，學生在長時間的講座中可能會坐立不安。

col: a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
words.tip: restless指難以安靜；restful指令人放鬆的。

tr: n. 恢復, 歸還, 復位
[醫] 恢復, 康復, 復位, 回覆, 修復
def: n. the reign of Charles II in England; 1660-1685
n. the act of restoring something or someone to a satisfactory state
n. some artifact that has been restored or reconstructed

tr: a. 恢復健康的, 滋補的
n. 興奮藥, 補藥
def: n a medicine that strengthens and invigorates
n a device for treating injury or disease
s tending to impart new life and vigor to

tr: vt. 回覆, 恢復, 歸還, 修補, 修復
vt. 還原
vi. 還原
[計] 還原; DOS外部命令:從備份盤中取回文件
恢復；使復原
def: v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition
v. give or bring back
v. bring back into original existence, use, function, or position

ex.en: The engineers restored power before our food went bad.
ex.zh: 工程師們在我們的食物變質之前恢復了供電。

ex.en: Planting native trees can help restore damaged ecosystems and provide essential habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 種植本土樹木有助於修復受損的生態系統，併為當地野生動物提供必要的棲息地。

col: restore a historic building｜修復歷史建築
restore something to its owner｜將某物歸還原主
words.tip: restore A to B：使A恢復到B狀態或歸還給B。

tr: a. 精力充沛的；精力恢復的
def: v return to its original or usable and functioning condition
v return to life; get or give new life or energy
v give or bring back

tr: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束縛
[法] 抑制, 遏制, 制止
制止；限制行動
剋制；抑制
def: v. keep under control; keep in check
v. to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement
v. hold back

ex.en: She gently restrained the dog from chasing a squirrel.
ex.zh: 她輕輕拉住狗，不讓它去追松鼠。

ex.en: Governments may use tighter lending rules to restrain excessive borrowing and reduce risks in the housing market.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過收緊貸款規定來遏制過度借貸，降低住房市場風險。

col: restrain someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
words.tip: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。

tr: vt. 限制, 限定, 約束
[醫] 限制
限制；限定
def: v. place restrictions on
v. place under restrictions; limit access to
v. place limits on (extent or access)

ex.en: These tight shoes restrict my movement when I dance.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋太緊，跳舞時讓我施展不開。

ex.en: Local authorities may restrict private vehicle access to city centres in order to reduce air pollution.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能限制私家車進入市中心，以減少空氣汙染。

col: restrict something to｜將某事物限定於
words.tip: restrict A to B表示“把A限定在B範圍內”。

tr: vt. 重新開始, 取回, 恢復
vi. 再開始
n. 摘要, 個人簡歷
[計] 繼續執行
重新開始；繼續
def: v. take up or begin anew
v. return to a previous location or condition
v. assume anew

ex.en: We will resume our walk when the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停後，我們會繼續散步。

ex.en: Schools can resume normal teaching once damaged buildings have been repaired and essential safety checks are complete.
ex.zh: 受損建築修復且必要的安全檢查完成後，學校便可恢復正常教學。

col: resume normal service｜恢復正常服務
words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞；名詞résumé意為簡歷。

tr: vi. 再起, 復活, 復生
def: v. rise again

tr: n. 再起, 復活, 再現
def: n bringing again into activity and prominence

tr: vi. 復活
vt. 使復活, 復興, 恢復, 盜掘
def: v. cause to become alive again
v. return from the dead

tr: v. (使)復甦, (使)復興
def: v. cause to regain consciousness

tr: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 記得, 付定金聘請
[經] 保留, 留存
保留；保持
記住
聘請；留聘
def: v. hold back within
v. allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature
v. secure and keep for possible future use or application

ex.en: This old house still retains its original wooden doors.
ex.zh: 這座老房子仍保留著原來的木門。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help companies retain experienced employees while improving overall job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 靈活的工作安排能幫助企業留住經驗豐富的員工，同時提高整體工作滿意度。

words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接賓語；記住知識也可用retain。

tr: vt. 報復, 回敬
vi. 報復, 以牙還牙
def: v. make a counterattack and return like for like, especially evil for evil

tr: n. 報復
[法] 報仇, 報復, 回敬
def: n. action taken in return for an injury or offense

tr: n. 阻止, 延遲
vt. 妨礙, 延遲, 使減速
vi. 減速, 延遲
def: v. cause to move more slowly or operate at a slower rate
v. be delayed

tr: vi. 作嘔, 反胃
vt. 嘔吐
n. 反胃, 嘔吐聲
def: n an involuntary spasm of ineffectual vomiting
v eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
v make an unsuccessful effort to vomit; strain to vomit

tr: n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 記憶, 停滯, 固位
[計] 保貿, 保持
保留；留住
記憶；記憶保持
滯留；瀦留
def: n. the act of retaining something
the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving
the ability to keep information in your memory

ex.en: Our manager improved staff retention by offering flexible hours.
ex.zh: 我們的經理通過提供彈性工作時間，提高了員工留任率。

ex.en: Regular revision and adequate sleep can improve the retention of information among students preparing for examinations.
ex.zh: 定期複習和充足睡眠能幫助備考學生更好地記住所學信息。

words.tip: 通常不可數；動詞形式為retain。

tr: a. 保持的, 有保持力的, 記性好的
def: a. good at remembering
a. having the capacity to retain something
s. having the power, capacity, or quality of retaining water

tr: a. 無言的, 沉默的, 不情願的
[法] 言不盡意的, 沈默寡言的, 有保留的
寡言的；不願透露的
def: s. temperamentally disinclined to talk
s. reluctant to draw attention to yourself
unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings

ex.en: He was reticent about his plans for the weekend.
ex.zh: 他不願多談自己的週末計劃。

ex.en: Employees may remain reticent about workplace problems if they fear that speaking openly could damage their careers.
ex.zh: 如果擔心坦率發言會損害職業發展，員工可能不願談及工作場所的問題。

col: reticent about personal matters｜不願談論私事
words.tip: 側重不願開口或透露信息，不等於一般的不情願。

tr: n. 隱居
vi. 引退, 退役, 退休, 退去, 撤退, 退卻
vt. 使...撤退, 辭退
退休；退役
退出比賽
def: v. go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position
v. withdraw from active participation
v. withdraw from circulation or from the market, as of bills, shares, and bonds

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些時間種花種菜。

ex.en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
ex.zh: 隨著預期壽命延長，一些政府鼓勵人們推遲退休，以減輕養老金制度的壓力。

ex.zh: 她用叉子戳了戳土豆，看看熟了沒有。

ex.zh: 沉重的行李箱朝他擺來時，他踉蹌著往後退。

ex.en: Employers could stagger working hours to ease congestion and reduce pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 僱主可以錯開工作時間，以緩解擁堵並減輕公共交通的壓力。

words.tip: stagger作動詞；staggering常指驚人之大。

ex.zh: 多年生意停滯之後，我們的店終於吸引到了新顧客。

ex.en: Prolonged economic stagnation can reduce employment opportunities and discourage investment in essential public services.
ex.zh: 長期經濟停滯可能減少就業機會，並抑制對基本公共服務的投資。

col: a period of stagnation｜一段停滯期
words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞，常用於經濟或發展停滯。

ex.zh: 製造商正在開發防汙面料，這有望減少洗滌所需的水和能源。

ex.zh: 乘客上車時，我們的公交車一直停著沒動。

ex.zh: 我們推著自行車爬上了陡坡。

ex.zh: 住房成本急劇上漲可能迫使年輕勞動者離開大城市。

ex.zh: 她小心地駕駛小船，避開了岩石。

ex.zh: 我的祖母打破了老年人不喜歡科技的刻板印象。

ex.zh: 學校應挑戰性別刻板印象，讓所有學生都能自由追求自己的興趣。

ex.zh: 食品包裝上常有黏性殘留物，必須先清除才能有效回收材料。

ex.zh: 他悶悶不樂地聳了聳肩，盯著地板。

ex.en: Students who feel excluded may become sullen and less willing to participate in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 感到被排斥的學生可能變得鬱鬱不樂，也更不願參與課堂討論。

col: a sullen mood｜悶悶不樂的心情
words.tip: 強調生氣或不快時沉默、不友好的樣子。

a short account giving the main points of something
presenting only the main facts or points

ex.en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
ex.zh: 你能簡要說說這次會議的內容嗎？

ex.en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
ex.zh: 報告開頭清晰的概要有助於讀者迅速瞭解主要研究結果。

words.tip: a summary of後接概括對象；in summary用於總結。

tr: vt. 召喚, 召集, 號召, 振奮, 喚起, 鼓起

鼓起；振作
def: v. call in an official matter, such as to attend court
v. ask to come
To officially order someone to come or request their presence.

ex.en: The manager summoned everyone to her office after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後，經理把所有人召集到她的辦公室。

ex.en: Governments must summon the political will to address environmental problems despite opposition from powerful industries.
ex.zh: 儘管遭到強勢行業的反對，政府仍須拿出解決環境問題的政治決心。

col: summon someone to court｜傳喚某人出庭
words.tip: summon sb to某處；summon up courage指鼓起勇氣。

tr: a. 奢侈的, 華麗的

def: s. lighted by sunlight

def: v retire and pension (someone) because of age or physical inability
v declare to be obsolete
v become obsolete

tr: a. 極度的, 華麗的, 極好的
極好的；卓越的
def: s. surpassingly good
Extremely good in quality or performance.

ex.en: We enjoyed a superb meal overlooking the quiet harbour.
ex.zh: 我們一邊俯瞰寧靜的港灣，一邊享用了一頓極棒的飯菜。

ex.en: The museum offers superb educational facilities, allowing visitors of all ages to explore scientific ideas through practical activities.
ex.zh: 這家博物館提供一流的教育設施，讓各年齡段的參觀者通過實踐活動探索科學概念。

words.tip: 本身已含程度很高之意，通常不說very superb。

tr: a. 傲慢的, 自大的, 目空一切的
def: s. expressive of contempt

tr: a. 職責以外的, 多餘的, 非本質的, 不必要的

a. of, affecting, or being on or near the surface
s. of little substance or significance

tr: adv. 表面, 表面性, 淺層, 不深, 表皮, (貶)膚淺, 一知半解, 淺薄, 平方, 浮面
def: r. in a superficial manner

tr: n. 多餘, 過剩, 多餘物, 過剩品, 奢侈

tr: n. 優越, 高傲
[化] 優越性
優越性；優勢
優越感；高傲
def: n. the quality of being superior
n. the quality of being at a competitive advantage
n. displaying a sense of being better than others

ex.en: The newer camera showed its superiority in low light.
ex.zh: 這臺較新的相機在弱光下展現了優勢。

ex.en: The technological superiority of larger firms can make it difficult for small businesses to compete effectively.
ex.zh: 大公司的技術優勢可能使小企業難以有效參與競爭。

words.tip: 表示相對優勢用superiority over，不用than。

tr: a. 最上的, 無比的, 過度的
n. 最好的人(物), 最高程度, 最高級
def: n. an exaggerated expression (usually of praise)
n. the superlative form of an adjective or adverb
