tr: vt. 代替, 取代, 接替
[法] 替代, 替換, 充任
取代；替代
def: v take the place or move into the position of
To replace something older or no longer useful.

ex.en: This new timetable supersedes the one on our fridge.
ex.zh: 這份新時刻表取代了我們冰箱上的舊時刻表。

ex.en: Digital payment systems may eventually supersede cash in many settings, although accessibility concerns must first be addressed.
ex.zh: 數字支付系統最終可能在許多場景中取代現金，但必須先解決使用便利性方面的問題。

col: supersede existing rules｜取代現有規則
supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
words.tip: 注意拼寫結尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被動式。

tr: n. 上部構造, 上層建築
[化] 超結構
上部結構
社會上層建築
def: n. structure consisting of the part of a ship above the main deck
The part of a structure built above its base or deck.
Institutions and beliefs supported by a society's economic system.

ex.en: Workers painted the ship's superstructure white before its departure.
ex.zh: 工人在船出發前把船的上層結構漆成了白色。

ex.en: Engineers must ensure that a building's foundations can safely support its entire superstructure under varying environmental conditions.
ex.zh: 工程師必須確保建築地基在不同環境條件下都能安全支撐整個上部結構。

col: ideological superstructure｜意識形態上層建築
words.tip: 建築中指基礎以上部分；船舶中指甲板以上部分。

tr: v. 監督, 管理, 指導
監督；指導；照看
def: v watch and direct
v keep tabs on; keep an eye on; keep under surveillance
watch and guide people to ensure work or activities go properly

ex.en: An adult must supervise the children near the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子們在泳池附近時，必須有成人照看。

ex.en: Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的護士應指導新員工，確保患者獲得安全有效的護理。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接人或活動：supervise staff。

給予支持和幫助的

giving help, encouragement, or understanding

ex.en: My supportive sister helped me practise before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前，支持我的姐姐幫我做了練習。

ex.en: A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions without worrying about making mistakes.
ex.zh: 充滿支持的課堂環境能鼓勵學生提問，而不必擔心犯錯。

col: a supportive family｜給予支持的家庭
a supportive environment｜支持性的環境
words.tip: 常用be supportive of表示支持某人或某事。

抑制；忍住
鎮壓；壓制
隱瞞；禁止發表

v. put out of one's consciousness
v. reduce the incidence or severity of or stop

ex.en: I tried to suppress a sneeze during the concert.
ex.zh: 音樂會期間，我努力忍住了一個噴嚏。

ex.en: Attempts to suppress scientific findings can undermine public trust and delay effective responses to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 試圖隱瞞科學發現會損害公眾信任，並延誤對環境問題的有效應對。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接情緒、反應、活動或信息。

tr: n. 至高, 霸權
a. 至高的, 終極的, 極端的, 最大的
最高的；至高無上的
極大的；極度的
def: s. final or last in your life or progress
s. highest in excellence or achievement
s. greatest or maximal in degree; extreme

ex.en: The council has supreme authority over the island.
ex.zh: 該委員會對這座島擁有最高權力。

ex.en: In many countries, the supreme court can review whether new legislation complies with the constitution.
ex.zh: 在許多國家，最高法院可以審查新法律是否符合憲法。

words.tip: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比較級或最高級。

v. 推測, 臆測

Form an opinion using limited evidence
An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain

ex.en: Seeing wet umbrellas, I surmised that it was raining.
ex.zh: 看到溼漉漉的雨傘，我猜外面正在下雨。

ex.en: Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
ex.zh: 研究人員推測彈性工作時間能改善員工身心狀況，但仍需更有力的證據加以確認。

words.tip: 較正式，強調證據不足；動詞常接that從句。

tr: vt. 戰勝, 超越, 克服
def: v. be on top of

超過；勝過
def: v. be or do something to a greater degree
to be greater or better than someone or something

ex.en: Your homemade cakes surpass anything sold at our local bakery.
ex.zh: 你自制的蛋糕比我們附近麵包店賣的任何蛋糕都好。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 隨著各國政府採取更有力的減碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超過目前的預測。

col: surpass previous levels｜超過以往水平
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語，不加than。

def: n a quantity much larger than is needed
s more than is needed, desired, or required

n. 交出, 放棄, 投降
投降；屈服
交出；放棄
def: n. the delivery of a principal into lawful custody
v. give up or agree to forgo to the power or possession of another
v. relinquish possession or control over

ex.en: The soldiers surrendered and walked forward with empty hands.
ex.zh: 士兵們投降了，空著雙手向前走來。

ex.en: Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.
ex.zh: 用戶不應為了使用必要的在線服務而被迫放棄對個人信息的控制權。

words.tip: surrender to sb指向某人投降；交出物品直接接賓語。

s conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods

vt. 代理, 替代
def: n. someone who takes the place of another person

tr: n. 監視, 監督

def: n. close observation of a person or group (usually by the police)

tr: vt. 比...活得長, 生存, 生還, 倖免於
vi. 活下來, 倖存
倖存；存活
繼續存在；挺過
比…活得長
def: v. continue to live through hardship or adversity
v. continue in existence after (an adversity, etc.)
stay alive despite danger, illness, or hardship

ex.en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
ex.zh: 我們的小仙人掌三個星期沒澆水也活下來了。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
ex.zh: 小企業若與本地顧客保持牢固聯繫，就更有可能挺過經濟低迷期。

col: survive an accident｜在事故中倖存
words.tip: 表示從事故中倖存，直接說survive an accident。

tr: n. 生還者, 倖存者
[法] 生還者, 生存者, 辛存者
倖存者
def: n. one who lives through affliction
n. one who outlives another
n. an animal that survives in spite of adversity

ex.en: Rescuers pulled a survivor from the flooded house.
ex.zh: 救援人員從被淹的房屋中救出了一名倖存者。

ex.en: Every disaster survivor should have access to safe housing, medical treatment, and long-term psychological support.
ex.zh: 每位災難倖存者都應能獲得安全住所、醫療服務和長期心理支持。

words.tip: survivor指人；survival指倖存或生存。

tr: a. 易受影響的, 易感動的, 容許...的
[法] 易感的, 易受影響的, 容許
易受影響的；易患病的
def: a. (often followed by `of' or `to') yielding readily to or capable of
s. easily impressed emotionally
easily affected or harmed by something

ex.en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
ex.zh: 這些幼苗特別容易遭受霜凍損害。

ex.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
ex.zh: 兒童可能更容易受到網絡廣告影響，因為他們缺乏評估商業宣傳的經驗。

words.tip: 常用susceptible to，to後接名詞。

tr: n. 被懷疑者, 嫌疑犯
a. 令人懷疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
v. 懷疑, 猜想
懷疑；猜想
嫌疑人
def: n. someone who is under suspicion
v. imagine to be the case or true or probable
v. hold in suspicion; believe to be guilty

ex.en: I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
ex.zh: 我懷疑是貓把杯子從桌上碰掉了。

ex.en: Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.
ex.zh: 研究人員推測，長時間使用屏幕可能影響睡眠質量，不過仍需更多證據。

col: suspect someone of something｜懷疑某人有某種行為
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞、形容詞讀/ˈsʌspekt/。

tr: vt. 懸, 吊, 使懸浮, 暫停, 中止, 推遲
vi. 暫停, 中止, 懸浮, 停止償付債務
[計] 暫停
def: v. hang freely
v. cause to be held in suspension in a fluid
v. bar temporarily; from school, office, etc.

tr: n. 懸疑, 焦慮, 懸念, 懸而不決
[經] 未定, 暫記
def: n. apprehension about what is going to happen
n. an uncertain cognitive state
n. excited anticipation of an approaching climax

tr: n. 懸掛, 暫停, 中止
[化] 懸浮; 懸浮體; 懸浮液
暫停；停職；停學
車輛懸架
懸浮液；懸浮狀態
def: n. a mixture in which fine particles are suspended in a fluid where they are supported by buoyancy
n. an interruption in the intensity or amount of something
n. a mechanical system of springs or shock absorbers connecting the wheels and axles to the chassis of a wheeled vehicle

ex.en: The storm caused the suspension of all ferry services.
ex.zh: 暴風雨導致所有渡輪服務暫停。

ex.en: The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 建築工程的暫時停工讓研究人員得以評估該項目對當地野生動物的影響。

words.tip: 表示暫時中止；車輛語境中指懸架。

tr: n. 懷疑, 覺察, 嫌疑
[法] 懷疑, 疑心, 嫌疑
懷疑；嫌疑
猜疑；不信任
一點兒；少許
def: n. the state of being suspected
n. being of a suspicious nature
a belief that something is wrong without definite proof

ex.en: I had a suspicion that someone had moved my keys.
ex.zh: 我懷疑有人動過我的鑰匙。

ex.en: A lack of transparency can increase public suspicion of how government contracts are awarded.
ex.zh: 缺乏透明度會加深公眾對政府合同授予方式的懷疑。

col: on suspicion of theft｜涉嫌盜竊
words.tip: 常用suspicion of或suspicion that從句。

tr: a. 可疑的, 多疑的, 懷疑的
[法] 懷疑的, 令人懷疑的, 可疑的
可疑的
懷疑的；不信任的
def: s openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
s not as expected
Making you think something is wrong, dishonest, or illegal.

ex.en: I noticed a suspicious charge on my bank statement.
ex.zh: 我發現銀行賬單上有一筆可疑的扣款。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly suspicious of environmental claims that companies make without providing clear evidence to support them.
ex.zh: 消費者越來越懷疑企業那些缺乏明確證據支持的環保聲明。

ex.zh: 騎車人突然轉向，避開了路上的樹枝。

ex.zh: 養護不善的道路可能迫使司機突然轉向，增加與其他車輛相撞的風險。

swerve off the road｜突然偏離道路
words.tip: 強調突然改變方向；普通轉彎通常用turn。

ex.zh: 學生在討論擬採用的方法之前，應先簡要概述計劃開展的研究。

ex.zh: 她收拾行李很有條理，之後什麼都很容易找到。

ex.zh: 在我們辦公室，討論薪資仍是禁忌。

ex.zh: 公眾教育可以挑戰圍繞精神疾病的禁忌，鼓勵更多人尋求支持。

a. 迷人的, 可愛的, 會傳染的
def: n the act of someone who picks up or takes something
v carry out
v require (time or space)

tr: n. 天才, 才能, 有才幹的人, 天資
天賦；才能
人才；有才能的人
def: n. a person who possesses unusual innate ability in some field or activity
A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表親畫動物很有天賦。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 學校應在培養學業技能的同時培育創造性才能，幫助學生髮展更廣泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天賦
words.tip: 表示某方面的天賦，用a talent for加名詞或動名詞。

tr: a. 天資高的, 有才能的
有天賦的；有才能的
def: a. endowed with talent or talents
Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有繪畫天賦的表親畫了這幅漂亮的花園圖。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 學校應為有才華的學生提供機會，讓他們在標準課程之外發展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天賦的音樂家
a talented artist｜有才華的藝術家
words.tip: talented強調天賦；skilled強調熟練技能。

tr: n. 符木, 記賬, 得分, 比分, 計數器, 標籤, 符合, 對應物
vt. 記錄, 點數, 計算, 加標籤於, 使符合
vi. 記帳, 符合, 吻合, 記分
[計] 計數
def: v. keep score, as in games

tr: n. 小手鼓
def: n. a shallow drum with a single drumhead and with metallic disks in the sides

tr: a. 馴服的, 柔順的, 被開墾的, 順從的, 乏味的, 平淡的
vt. 馴養, 馴服, 制服, 失去鋒芒
vi. 變得馴服
馴服的；不怕人的
馴服；控制
def: v. correct by punishment or discipline
s. flat and uninspiring
a. very restrained or quiet

ex.en: The tame rabbit ate directly from my hand.
ex.zh: 那隻溫順的兔子直接吃我手裡的食物。

ex.en: Even tame animals require careful handling, especially when young children are learning to interact with them.
ex.zh: 即使是馴服的動物也需要謹慎對待，尤其是在幼兒學習與它們互動時。

words.tip: tame指不怕人或被馴服，不等於天生無害。

tr: vt. 用粘土填塞, 搗固, 夯實
n. 搗棒, 夯
def: n. a tool for tamping (e.g., for tamping tobacco into a pipe bowl or a charge into a drill hole etc.)

tr: vi. 干預, 撥弄, 賄賂, 損害, 篡改
vt. 篡改
n. 搗棒, 打夯機, 填塞者
def: v. play around with or alter or falsify, usually secretively or dishonestly

tr: a. 切線的, 相切的, 正切的, 離題的, 扯遠的
[醫] 正切的, 切線的
def: a. of or relating to or acting along or in the direction of a tangent

tr: n. 可觸知的東西, 有形資產
a. 可觸摸的, 有實體的, 非相像的, 有形的, 明確的
def: a. perceptible by the senses especially the sense of touch
a. (of especially business assets) having physical substance and intrinsic monetary value

tr: n. 纏結, 糾結的一團, 困惑, 糾紛, 混亂
vt. 使纏結, 纏住
vi. 纏結, 亂作一團
纏結的一團
使纏結；纏在一起
def: n. a twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven
n. something jumbled or confused
A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things

ex.en: My headphones were buried in a tangle of cables.
ex.zh: 我的耳機埋在一團纏結的線纜裡。

ex.en: Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
ex.zh: 小企業常面臨錯綜複雜的法規，使業務擴張既費錢又費時。

col: a tangle of wires｜纏成一團的電線
a tangle of regulations｜錯綜複雜的法規
words.tip: a tangle of既可指實物纏結，也可指複雜困局。

tr: a. 有強烈鹽味的, 氣味刺鼻的, 有刺激性的
def: s tasting sour like a lemon

tr: vt. 逗弄, 使乾著急
引逗；使可望不可即
def: v harass with persistent criticism or carping
To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread tantalized us outside the bakery.
ex.zh: 麵包店外，新鮮麵包的香氣饞得我們直流口水。

ex.en: Early discoveries tantalize researchers with the possibility of finding affordable treatments for currently incurable diseases.
ex.zh: 早期發現讓研究人員對找到價格可負擔的療法、治療目前尚無法治癒的疾病充滿期待。

col: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人
tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暫一瞥
tantalizing prospect｜誘人卻未實現的前景
words.tip: 英式也寫tantalise；強調勾起慾望卻暫時得不到。

tr: a. 同等的, 相等的, 相當於...的
[法] 相等的, 相當的, 同等的
def: s being essentially equal to something

tr: n. 發脾氣, 發怒
[醫] 暴怒, 發脾氣
def: n a display of bad temper

tr: a. 尖端細的
def: n. the act of gradually lowering the size or amount

tr: a. 慢的, 遲到的, 勉強的, 拖拉的, 遲的
def: s after the expected or usual time; delayed

tr: n. 失澤, 失澤膜, 汙點
vt. 使失去光澤, 玷汙
vi. 失去光澤, 被玷汙
def: n. discoloration of metal surface caused by oxidation
v. make dirty or spotty, as by exposure to air; also used metaphorically

tr: vi. 耽擱, 逗留, 留住, 等候
n. 逗留
a. 塗了焦油的
def: v. leave slowly and hesitantly

tr: a. 酸的, 辛辣的, 尖酸的
vt. 妖豔打扮
n. 果餡餅, 妓女
def: n. a small open pie with a fruit filling
n. a pastry cup with a filling of fruit or custard and no top crust

tr: a. 沒味道的, 無鑑賞力的
def: a. lacking flavor
a. lacking aesthetic or social taste

tr: a. 好吃的, 可口的
美味的；可口的
def: a. pleasing to the sense of taste
having a pleasant flavour

ex.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
ex.zh: 這道美味的湯很適合寒冷的夜晚。

ex.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
ex.zh: 學校食堂可以提供用新鮮蔬菜和全穀物製作的美味餐食，鼓勵更健康的飲食。

words.tip: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

tr: n. 破布條, 破衣服, 梭編工人
vt. 把...扯碎
vi. 變破爛
def: n a small piece of cloth or paper

tr: n. 閒談, 閒話, 饒舌
vi. 閒談, 談論, 洩露秘密
vt. 洩露
def: n. disclosing information or giving evidence about another

tr: a. 穿破的, 粗糙的, 不值錢的
def: s showing signs of wear and tear
s tastelessly showy

tr: n. 辱罵, 嘲弄
vt. 嘲弄, 奚落
a. 很高的
def: n aggravation by deriding or mocking or criticizing
v harass with persistent criticism or carping

tr: a. 拉緊的, 整潔的, 緊張的
def: s. pulled or drawn tight
s. subjected to great tension; stretched tight

tr: v. 使繃緊, 拉緊
def: v. become taut or tauter
v. make taut or tauter

tr: a. 廉價而俗麗的
n. 廉價而俗麗之物
def: s tastelessly showy
s cheap and shoddy

tr: a. 繁重的, 費力的
[法] 徵稅的, 評定的負擔頗重的
def: v levy a tax on
v set or determine the amount of (a payment such as a fine)
v use to the limit

tr: n. 淚滴, 眼淚, 撕, 扯, 裂縫, 激怒, 飛奔
vi. 流淚, 撕破, 趕快, 飛奔, 被撕破
vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
撕破；扯開
眼淚
def: n. a drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted by the lacrimal glands
n. the act of tearing
v. separate or cause to separate abruptly

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
ex.zh: 小心別把紙袋撕破了。

ex.en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
ex.zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋適合反覆使用。

words.tip: 撕裂讀/teə/，眼淚讀/tɪə/；動詞變化為 tore、torn。

tr: n. 揶揄, 戲弄, 逗惹
vt. 戲弄, 取笑, 強求, 梳理, 使起毛
取笑；戲弄
愛逗弄別人的人
def: n. someone given to teasing (as by mocking or stirring curiosity)
n. the act of harassing someone playfully or maliciously (especially by ridicule); provoking someone with persistent annoyances
v. annoy persistently

ex.en: My cousins always tease me about my enormous backpack.
ex.zh: 表親們總拿我的超大背包打趣。

ex.en: Schools should teach children that teasing classmates about their appearance can seriously damage their confidence.
ex.zh: 學校應教導孩子，取笑同學的外貌可能嚴重損害他們的自信心。

col: tease someone about something｜拿某事取笑某人
words.tip: 常用tease sb about sth；可親暱，也可傷人。

tr: n. 技巧, 技術, 方法
[化] 工藝方法; 技巧
方法；技巧；手法
技藝；技術水平
def: n. a practical method or art applied to some particular task
A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教練向我示範了一種更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教師可以運用多種評估方法，在學生落後之前發現他們的學習困難。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
words.tip: technique重在具體方法；technology指科技。

tr: a. 沉悶的, 冗長乏味的
冗長乏味的；單調的
def: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
s using or containing too many words
boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions

ex.en: Sorting all these old receipts is a tedious job.
ex.zh: 整理這些舊收據是一件單調乏味的差事。

ex.en: Automation can free employees from tedious tasks, allowing them to focus on more creative and rewarding work.
ex.zh: 自動化可以讓員工擺脫單調的任務，專注於更有創意和成就感的工作。

words.tip: 常形容因耗時長或反覆重複而乏味的任務。

tr: n. 單調乏味, 沉悶
def: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious
n dullness owing to length or slowness

tr: vi. 充滿, 充足, 傾注
vt. 倒出
充滿；有大量
下傾盆大雨
def: v. be teeming, be abuzz
to contain large quantities of living things or moving people
to rain very heavily

ex.en: The pond was teeming with tiny fish this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，池塘裡滿是小魚。

ex.en: Healthy coral reefs teem with marine life, making their protection essential for maintaining ocean biodiversity.
ex.zh: 健康的珊瑚礁生活著大量海洋生物，因此保護珊瑚礁對維持海洋生物多樣性至關重要。

words.tip: 常用teem with，表示充滿生物、人或活動。

tr: vi. 步履不穩地走動, 踉蹌, 搖晃, 搖擺不定, 搖搖欲墜, 玩蹺蹺板
n. 踉蹌, 搖擺, 蹺蹺板
def: v. move unsteadily, with a rocking motion

tr: a. 絕對戒酒的, 完全的, 絕對的
n. 絕對戒酒主義
def: v. practice teetotalism and abstain from the consumption of alcoholic beverages

tr: n. 魯莽, 蠻勇
def: n fearless daring

tr: n. (鋼等的)硬度, 脾氣, 心情, 中和劑, 傾向, 回火
vt. 使回火, 鍛鍊, 調和, 使緩和
vi. 回火
脾氣；易怒的性情
緩和；節制
def: n. a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
n. a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger
n. the elasticity and hardness of a metal object; its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屜又卡住了，他大發脾氣。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府應認真考慮新技術可能帶來的社會後果，避免一味熱衷於推廣。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以謹慎節制熱情
words.tip: lose your temper 是發脾氣；動詞常用 temper A with B。

tr: a. 溫和的, 適度的, 有節制的, 溫帶的
氣候溫和的
剋制的；適度的
def: a. (of weather or climate) free from extremes; mild; or characteristic of such weather or climate
a. not extreme in behavior
Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold

ex.en: We enjoy walking outdoors in this temperate climate.
ex.zh: 這裡氣候溫和，我們喜歡在戶外散步。

ex.en: Temperate regions may experience significant changes in rainfall patterns as global temperatures continue to rise.
ex.zh: 隨著全球氣溫持續上升，溫帶地區的降雨模式可能發生顯著變化。

words.tip: 氣候義指不太冷也不太熱；不等於熱帶的。

tr: n. 暴風雨, 騷動
vt. 使受大風暴影響, 使騷動, 使激動
def: n. (literary) a violent wind

tr: a. 有暴風雨的, 暴亂的
def: s characterized by violent emotions or behavior
s (of the elements) as if showing violent anger

tr: n. 速度, 節奏, 進行速度, (棋的)一著
音樂速度；節拍快慢
活動或發展的速度
def: n. (music) the speed at which a composition is to be played
n. the rate of some repeating event
The speed at which music is played.

ex.en: The drummer increased the tempo, and everyone danced faster.
ex.zh: 鼓手加快了節奏，大家也跳得更快了。

ex.en: The tempo of urban life has accelerated as digital services make daily tasks increasingly immediate.
ex.zh: 隨著數字服務讓日常事務的處理越來越即時，城市生活節奏也加快了。

col: the tempo of life｜生活節奏
words.tip: 指音樂的快慢，不等於表示節奏型的rhythm。

tr: a. 時間的, 暫時的, 現世的, 世俗的, 顳的, 太陽穴的
n. 世間萬物, 教會財產
時間的
世俗的；非宗教的
顳部的
def: s. not eternal
a. of or relating to or limited by time
a. of or relating to the temples (the sides of the skull behind the orbit)

ex.en: We arranged the family photos in temporal order.
ex.zh: 我們把家庭照片按時間順序排列。

ex.en: Understanding temporal patterns in electricity demand can help cities manage their energy supplies more efficiently.
ex.zh: 瞭解用電需求隨時間變化的規律，有助於城市更高效地管理能源供應。

words.tip: temporal指時間的；temporary才表示暫時的。

tr: a. 暫時的, 臨時的
n. 臨時工, 臨時僱員
[計] 臨時
暫時的；臨時的
def: n a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis
a not permanent; not lasting
s lacking continuity or regularity

ex.en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
ex.zh: 新書桌送來之前，先用這張臨時桌子就行。

ex.en: Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
ex.zh: 在家庭等待合適的永久住房期間，臨時住處提供了必要的棲身之所。

words.tip: 強調持續時間有限，反義詞為permanent。

tr: vi. 隨潮流, 拖延, 妥協, 調停
def: v. draw out a discussion or process in order to gain time

tr: n. 誘惑, 誘惑物
[法] 誘惑, 誘惑物
誘惑；誘惑物
def: n. something that seduces or has the quality to seduce
n. the desire to have or do something that you know you should avoid
A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.

ex.en: I resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
ex.zh: 我忍住了再吃一塊蛋糕的誘惑。

ex.en: Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.
ex.zh: 學生可能會受到誘惑，抄襲網上的材料，而不是形成自己的觀點。

col: give in to temptation｜經不住誘惑
the temptation to do something｜做某事的誘惑
words.tip: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的誘惑。

tr: a. 誘惑人的, 吸引人的
def: v dispose or incline or entice to
v provoke someone to do something through (often false or exaggerated) promises or persuasion
v give rise to a desire by being attractive or inviting

tr: a. 可守的, 站得住(腳)的, 合理的, 成立的
站得住腳的；可維持的
def: s. based on sound reasoning or evidence
Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

ex.en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
ex.zh: 我們核實後，他的藉口就再也站不住腳了。

ex.en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
ex.zh: 經濟增長總能改善公眾福祉這一假設，已不能在所有情境下成立。

col: a tenable position｜站得住腳的立場
a tenable argument｜經得起推敲的論點
no longer tenable｜不再站得住腳
words.tip: 常形容論點或立場站得住腳，不等於舒適。

tr: a. 緊握的, 固執的, 不屈不撓的, 黏著力強的
[醫] 堅韌的
堅韌不拔的；執著的
緊抓不放的；難消除的
def: a good at remembering
s stubbornly unyielding
s sticking together

ex.en: The tenacious runner kept going despite the steep hill.
ex.zh: 儘管山坡陡峭，那位意志頑強的跑者仍繼續前進。

ex.en: Tenacious researchers often overcome repeated setbacks before producing discoveries that significantly improve public health.
ex.zh: 堅韌不拔的研究人員往往要克服重重挫折，才能取得顯著改善公共健康的發現。

col: a tenacious campaigner｜堅持不懈的倡導者
words.tip: 核心是堅持不放棄；也可形容抓得緊或難消除。

tr: n. 固執, 不屈不撓, 頑固, 黏性, 韌性
[機] 堅軔
def: n persistent determination

tr: vi. 走向, 有某種的傾向, 易於, 照顧, 注意
vt. 照料, 護理
往往會；傾向於
照料；護理
def: v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined
v. have care of or look after
v. manage or run

ex.en: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
ex.zh: 我午飯吃得多之後往往會犯困。

ex.en: People tend to use public transport more frequently when services are reliable, affordable, and easy to access.
ex.zh: 當公共交通可靠、價格合理且乘坐方便時，人們往往會更頻繁地使用它。

col: tend to do something｜往往會做某事
tend to the injured｜照料傷者
words.tip: tend to do表示往往會；tend to someone表示照料。

tr: a. 有偏見的, 有傾向的, 淘氣的
def: s. having or marked by a strong tendency especially a controversial one

tr: n. 信條, 教義, 宗旨, 原則
def: n a religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof

tr: a. 可拉長的, 可伸長的, 張力的, 拉力的
[機] 拉的
def: a. of or relating to tension

tr: n. 緊張, 不安, 拉緊, 張力, 壓力, 電壓
vt. 拉緊, 使緊張
緊張局勢；緊張關係
緊張；焦慮
張力；拉力
def: n. (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
n. the physical condition of being stretched or strained
n. a balance between and interplay of opposing elements or tendencies (especially in art or literature)

ex.en: Tension grew between the neighbours over the shared driveway.
ex.zh: 鄰居們因共用車道問題，關係越來越緊張。

ex.en: Competition for limited water supplies can increase tension between farming communities and nearby cities.
ex.zh: 爭奪有限的水資源可能加劇農業社區與附近城市之間的緊張關係。

tr: n. 變形, 變質, 變化, 改革, 變換
[化] 轉化; 變換
徹底變化；改造；轉型

n. (mathematics) a function that changes the position or direction of the axes of a coordinate system
n. a rule describing the conversion of one syntactic structure into another related syntactic structure

ex.en: The dusty attic underwent a transformation into a cosy bedroom.
ex.zh: 佈滿灰塵的閣樓經過改造，變成了溫馨的臥室。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could accelerate the transformation of industrial regions into centres of sustainable production.
ex.zh: 對可再生能源的投資可以加快工業地區向可持續生產中心的轉型。

col: undergo a transformation｜經歷徹底變化
words.tip: 常用transformation from A into B表示由A變成B。

tr: vt. 違反, 犯罪, 侵犯
vi. 越界, 違法
違反；越過界限
def: v. act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
v. spread over land, especially along a subsiding shoreline
v. pass beyond (limits or boundaries)

ex.en: Players who transgress the rules may leave the game.
ex.zh: 違反規則的選手可能離場。

ex.en: Companies that transgress environmental laws should face penalties proportionate to the damage they cause.
ex.zh: 違反環境法律的企業應受到與其造成的損害相稱的處罰。

col: transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限
transgress social norms｜違反社會規範
words.tip: 正式用詞，可直接接law、rules等賓語。

tr: n. 頃刻, 無常, 短暫

[計] 瞬變過程; 過渡過程; 過渡的; 瞬變的; 瞬時峰值電壓
def: n. one who stays for only a short time
n. (physics) a short-lived oscillation in a system caused by a sudden change of voltage or current or load

運輸；運送
公共交通系統

v. revolve (the telescope of a surveying transit) about its horizontal transverse axis in order to reverse its direction

ex.en: The glasses broke while they were in transit.
ex.zh: 這些玻璃杯在運輸途中破碎了。

ex.en: Investment in public transit can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通可以緩解交通擁堵，並改善發展中城市居民的就業可達性。

words.tip: in transit指運輸途中；public transit多用於美式英語。

tr: a. 變遷的, 過渡期的
[醫] 轉變的, 過渡的; 過渡型單核白細胞
def: a. of or relating to or characterized by transition

tr: n. 暫時, 短暫

半透明的
def: s. allowing light to pass through diffusely
Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.

ex.en: Soft sunlight came through the translucent bathroom window.
ex.zh: 柔和的陽光透過浴室的半透明窗戶照進來。

ex.en: Translucent panels allow natural light into offices while maintaining privacy for people working inside.
ex.zh: 半透明板材讓自然光進入辦公室，同時保護室內工作人員的隱私。

words.tip: 與transparent不同：能透光，但看不清後面的物體。

tr: vt. 傳輸, 傳染, 傳達, 遺傳, 發射, 傳播

[計] 傳送
傳輸；發送
傳播；傳染

to send signals, information, or energy between places
to pass a disease from one living thing to another

ex.en: These tiny sensors transmit temperature readings to my phone.
ex.zh: 這些微型傳感器把溫度讀數傳送到我的手機上。

ex.en: Improved satellite networks can transmit vital information to remote communities during floods and other natural disasters.
ex.zh: 洪災及其他自然災害發生時，改進後的衛星網絡能向偏遠社區傳送重要信息。

words.tip: 過去式transmitted，進行式transmitting，均雙寫t。

tr: vt. 使變形, 使變質
vi. 變形, 變質
def: v. alter the nature of (elements)

tr: vt. 調換, 顛倒順序, 移項
vi. 互換位置
[計] 轉置

v. transfer a quantity from one side of an equation to the other side reversing its sign, in order to maintain equality
v. put (a piece of music) into another key

tr: n. 吊鞦韆
def: n. a swing used by circus acrobats

tr: n. 外傷, 損傷
[醫] 創傷, 外傷
def: n. an emotional wound or shock often having long-lasting effects

tr: n. 越過, 橫貫, 橫斷物, 屏障, 否認, 反駁
vt. 橫過, 穿過, 經過, 詳細研究, 反對, 在...來回移動
vi. 橫越, 橫斷, 旋轉, 來回移動
a. 橫亙的, 橫貫的
橫越；穿過
def: v. travel across or pass over
v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
To travel across or through an area.

ex.en: We traversed the snowy valley before reaching the mountain hut.
ex.zh: 我們穿過積雪覆蓋的山谷，才到達山間小屋。

ex.en: New railway routes traverse remote regions, connecting isolated communities with essential services and larger markets.
ex.zh: 新鐵路線路穿越偏遠地區，讓孤立的社區能夠獲得基本服務並進入更大的市場。

col: traverse rough terrain｜穿越崎嶇地形
words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接地點賓語：traverse the desert。

tr: n. 拙劣的模仿作品, 嘲弄, 滑稽模仿
vt. 滑稽地模仿, 歪曲
def: v. make a travesty of

tr: a. 不可信任的, 危險的, 背叛的, 不可靠的
[法] 奸詐的, 背叛的, 背信棄義的
def: s. dangerously unstable and unpredictable

tr: n. 背叛, 變節
[法] 背叛, 變節, 背信棄義

def: n. the grooved surface of a pneumatic tire
n. the part (as of a wheel or shoe) that makes contact with the ground
n. structural member consisting of the horizontal part of a stair or step

tr: n. 論文, 專著
專題論著；專論
def: n. a formal exposition
a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject

ex.en: I found a dusty treatise on gardening upstairs.
ex.zh: 我在樓上找到了一本落滿灰塵的園藝專著。

ex.en: The philosopher's treatise on education argues that practical experience should play a central role in learning.
ex.zh: 這位哲學家的教育論著主張，實踐經驗應在學習中發揮核心作用。

words.tip: 常用a treatise on，指系統詳盡的專論而非短文。

tr: n. 條約, 談判
[經] 協議, 協定, 協商
條約；國家間協議
def: n. a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
a formal agreement between countries

ex.en: We heard about the new treaty on the radio.
ex.zh: 我們從廣播中聽說了這項新條約。

ex.en: An international treaty can establish shared environmental standards, but its success depends on effective enforcement.
ex.zh: 國際條約可以確立共同的環境標準，但其成功取決於有效執行。

words.tip: 通常指國家間正式協議，不表示談判過程。

tr: vi. 牛拉貨車, 艱苦跋涉

長途艱苦跋涉
長途跋涉；徒步遠行
def: n. a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
n. any long and difficult trip
v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains

ex.en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
ex.zh: 我們穿越森林的徒步旅程在一處瀑布旁結束。

ex.en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
ex.zh: 在偏遠山區徒步的遊客可以通過僱用嚮導和購買當地物資來支持當地經濟。

col: a mountain trek｜山地徒步旅行
trek through the forest｜徒步穿越森林
go on a trek｜去長途徒步
words.tip: 現代常指艱苦徒步；trekked、trekking要雙寫k。

tr: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
巨大的；極大的
極好的；精彩的
def: s extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman
s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers
s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact

ex.en: Moving that heavy sofa upstairs took a tremendous effort.
ex.zh: 把那張沉重的沙發搬上樓費了極大的力氣。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places tremendous pressure on housing, transport networks and essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速發展給住房、交通網絡和基本公共服務帶來了巨大壓力。

col: a tremendous achievement｜了不起的成就
words.tip: 常強調程度或數量極大，不只指體積大。

n. a small earthquake

ex.en: A slight tremor made the cups rattle on their hooks.
ex.zh: 一次輕微震動使掛鉤上的杯子碰得叮噹響。

ex.en: Sensitive monitoring equipment can detect a minor tremor that people living nearby may not notice.
ex.zh: 靈敏的監測設備能夠探測到附近居民可能察覺不到的輕微地震。

col: a tremor in her voice｜她聲音中的顫抖
words.tip: 通常作名詞；聲音中的顫抖用a tremor in the voice。

[醫] 震顫的
def: s (of the voice) quivering as from weakness or fear

def: s having keenness and forcefulness and penetration in thought, expression, or intellect
s characterized by or full of force and vigor
s clearly or sharply defined to the mind

tr: n. 趨勢, 傾向, 走向
vi. 傾向, 轉向
[計] 趨勢
趨勢；潮流
成為熱門話題
def: n a general direction in which something tends to move
n general line of orientation
n a general tendency to change (as of opinion)

ex.en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
ex.zh: 在家種菜是這裡流行的一種風尚。

ex.en: The growing trend towards remote working may reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
ex.zh: 遠程辦公日益普及的趨勢可能緩解大城市的交通擁堵。

col: a growing trend｜日益明顯的趨勢
words.tip: 朝向某種趨勢常用a trend towards後接名詞。

tr: n. 新式樣的創立者, 新式樣的推廣者
n. 恐懼, 驚惶, 憂慮

擅自進入；非法侵入
擅自進入；非法侵入行為
def: n. a wrongful interference with the possession of property (personal property as well as realty), or the action instituted to recover damages
n. entry to another's property without right or permission
v. enter unlawfully on someone's property

ex.en: Please don't trespass on the farm to take photographs.
ex.zh: 請不要為了拍照而擅自進入農場。

ex.en: Clear boundaries around protected habitats can discourage trespass and reduce disturbance to nesting birds.
ex.zh: 在受保護棲息地周圍劃定清晰邊界，可以阻止擅自闖入並減少對築巢鳥類的干擾。

col: trespass on private property｜擅闖私人地產
trespass on someone's land｜擅自進入他人的土地
words.tip: 表示擅闖某地常用trespass on，不指一般過失。

s having concealed difficulty
s marked by skill in deception

[計] 庫存管理檢查規則程序

ex.zh: 我會在樹籬擋住窗戶之前修剪它。

ex.en: Local authorities can trim operating costs by improving energy efficiency in public buildings rather than reducing essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通過提高公共建築的能源效率來削減運營成本，而不是減少基本服務。

words.tip: 過去式trimmed、現在分詞trimming都雙寫m。

Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original

ex.en: The film ends with a trite speech about friendship.
ex.zh: 影片以一段關於友誼的老套演說結束。

ex.en: Public awareness campaigns may fail when they rely on trite slogans rather than practical advice and convincing evidence.
ex.zh: 公眾宣傳活動如果依賴老套的口號，而非實用建議和有說服力的證據，就可能失敗。

words.tip: 強調因反覆使用而失去新意，不只是年代久遠。

tr: n. 凱旋, 勝利, 歡欣

勝利的喜悅

An important victory or impressive achievement.
Great happiness and pride after achieving success.

ex.en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
ex.zh: 贏得當地國際象棋錦標賽對阿米爾來說是一次重大勝利。

ex.en: The successful restoration of the wetland represents a triumph for conservation groups and local residents.
ex.zh: 溼地的成功修復是環保團體和當地居民取得的一項重大成果。

words.tip: 作動詞時常用triumph over，表示戰勝。

ex.zh: 我們為一個無關緊要的細節爭論，浪費了整個下午。

ex.en: Public debates sometimes focus on trivial disagreements rather than the urgent environmental problems affecting future generations.
ex.zh: 公眾討論有時聚焦於瑣碎的分歧，而非影響子孫後代的緊迫環境問題。

逃學的

s. absent without permission
A pupil who stays away from school without permission

ex.en: The teacher found two truants hiding behind the playground.
ex.zh: 老師發現兩個逃學的學生躲在操場後面。

ex.en: Schools should support persistent truants by addressing bullying and family difficulties rather than relying solely on punishment.
ex.zh: 學校應通過解決欺凌和家庭困難來幫助經常逃學的學生，而不是隻依靠懲罰。

words.tip: 英式英語play truant意為逃學，不是普通的請假缺課。

ex.en: After arguing all morning, the neighbours called a truce.
ex.zh: 爭吵了一上午後，鄰居們暫時休戰了。

ex.en: A temporary truce can allow aid workers to deliver essential supplies to communities affected by conflict.
ex.zh: 臨時停戰可以讓援助人員向受衝突影響的社區運送必需物資。

col: agree to a truce｜同意停戰
break a truce｜破壞休戰協議
words.tip: 通常指暫時停止衝突，不等於永久和平。

ex.zh: 我們的教練總是努力維護公平競賽的原則。

ex.en: Independent courts help uphold citizens' rights by ensuring that public authorities act within the law.
ex.zh: 獨立的法院通過確保公共機構依法行事，幫助維護公民權利。

ex.zh: 我們溫文爾雅的主人面帶溫暖的微笑歡迎每一位客人。

ex.en: An urbane manner can help diplomats build trust, although successful negotiations also require substantial expertise.
ex.zh: 溫文爾雅的舉止能幫助外交官建立信任，不過成功的談判也需要紮實的專業知識。

words.tip: urbane指人文雅善交際；urban指城市的。

ex.en: This folding table offers real utility in our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 這張摺疊桌在我們的小廚房裡確實很實用。

ex.en: Reliable access to basic utilities is essential for improving public health and supporting economic development in rural communities.
ex.zh: 穩定獲得基本公共服務，對於改善農村社區的公共衛生和支持經濟發展至關重要。

words.tip: “效用”通常不可數；水電燃氣等服務常用utilities。

tr: vt. 利用
利用；使用
def: v. convert (from an investment trust to a unit trust)
To use something effectively for a particular purpose.

ex.en: We utilize the space under our stairs for storage.
ex.zh: 我們利用樓梯下的空間儲物。

ex.en: Schools can utilize existing buildings more efficiently by sharing facilities with local communities after lessons.
ex.zh: 學校可以在課後與當地社區共享設施，從而更高效地利用現有建築。

col: utilize available space｜利用現有空間
words.tip: 比use正式；英式也常拼作utilise。

v. put into circulation
Complete or total, used to emphasise something

ex.en: The kitchen was in utter chaos after we baked.
ex.zh: 我們烘焙完後，廚房徹底亂成了一團。

ex.en: Without adequate planning, rapid urban expansion can result in utter confusion over land ownership and infrastructure responsibilities.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏充分規劃，快速的城市擴張可能導致土地所有權與基礎設施責任劃分完全混亂。

words.tip: 形容詞utter只放名詞前；副詞用utterly。

a not precisely limited, determined, or distinguished
s lacking clarity or distinctness

ex.en: His vague directions left us wandering around the station.
ex.zh: 他含糊的指路讓我們在車站附近轉來轉去。

ex.en: Vague environmental targets make it difficult for citizens to assess whether government policies are achieving meaningful progress.
ex.zh: 含糊的環境目標讓公民難以判斷政府政策是否取得了實質性進展。

words.tip: be vague about表示對某事說不清或含糊其詞。

tr: n. 含糊, 曖昧

s unproductive of success
failing to achieve the intended result

ex.zh: 我們試著修傘，卻白費了力氣。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, campaigns to reduce private car use may prove to be vain efforts.
ex.zh: 如果沒有價格可負擔的公共交通，減少私家車使用的宣傳活動可能只是徒勞。

words.tip: in vain作狀語，表示“徒勞地”；vain也可指虛榮。

ex.zh: 轉動這個閥門，阻止水流入水箱。

ex.zh: 更換受損的心臟瓣膜可以改善患者的生活質量，並降低嚴重併發症的風險。

ex.zh: 攪拌麵糊之前，加一點香草精。

ex.en: Demand for natural vanilla can provide valuable income for farmers, but unstable prices create financial risks.
ex.zh: 對天然香草的需求能為農民帶來可觀收入，但價格不穩定會造成財務風險。

words.tip: 食品中的vanilla指特定香料，並非泛指所有香草。

ex.zh: 我們的國際象棋俱樂部昨天終於徹底擊敗了最強的對手。

ex.en: Public health campaigns cannot vanquish widespread misinformation without sustained cooperation between educators, researchers, and local communities.
ex.zh: 沒有教育工作者、研究人員和當地社區的持續合作，公共衛生宣傳就無法戰勝廣泛傳播的錯誤信息。

ex.en: His cheerful smile was at variance with his complaints.
ex.zh: 他愉快的笑容與他的抱怨很不相稱。

ex.en: The proposed housing policy is at variance with the government's commitment to protecting green spaces.
ex.zh: 擬議的住房政策與政府保護綠地的承諾相矛盾。

words.tip: at variance with 表示不一致；統計學中指方差。

ex.zh: 我們用各種色彩鮮豔的蔬菜讓午餐更豐富。

ex.zh: 學校應提供豐富多樣的活動，以支持興趣各異的學生。

ex.en: Her vehement refusal surprised everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 她激烈的拒絕讓桌旁的每個人都很驚訝。

ex.en: The proposed closure of the community library met with vehement opposition from residents and local educators.
ex.zh: 關閉社區圖書館的提議遭到了居民和當地教育工作者的強烈反對。

words.tip: 多形容反對、否認或批評的強烈程度，語氣較正式。

n. any substance that facilitates the use of a drug or pigment or other material that is mixed with it

ex.en: We left our vehicle outside the small mountain hotel.
ex.zh: 我們把車停在了山間小旅館外面。

ex.en: Electric vehicles can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their electricity comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 電動車可以減少城市空氣汙染，尤其是在使用可再生能源發電時。

col: a vehicle for change｜推動變革的工具

tr: n. 面紗, 面罩, 藉口, 幕, 帳, 遮蔽物

ex.zh: 她掀起面紗，喝了一小口水。

ex.en: A veil of secrecy around major planning decisions can weaken public trust in local government.
ex.zh: 重大規劃決策被秘密籠罩，會削弱公眾對地方政府的信任。

ex.zh: 球向坡下滾動時速度越來越快。

ex.en: Engineers measure the velocity of flowing water to determine whether a site is suitable for generating electricity.
ex.zh: 工程師測量水流速度，以判斷某處是否適合發電。

ex.zh: 這裡的人們十分敬仰創辦這所學校的長者。

ex.zh: 許多社會十分尊崇歷史建築，因為它們代表著共同的文化成就以及與過去的聯繫。

words.tip: 正式用詞，比respect語氣強；後面直接接賓語。

ex.zh: 做完飯後打開兩扇窗，給廚房通風。

ex.en: Schools should ventilate classrooms regularly to improve indoor air quality and create healthier learning environments.
ex.zh: 學校應定期給教室通風，以改善室內空氣質量，創造更健康的學習環境。

words.tip: 使通風是常用義；表示公開討論時較正式。

tr: n. 口技藝人
def: n. a performer who projects the voice into a wooden dummy

tr: n. 冒險, 風險
vt. 敢於, 冒...的危險
vi. 冒險
風險項目；創業項目
冒險前往；大膽嘗試
def: n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome
n. a commercial undertaking that risks a loss but promises a profit
v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers

ex.en: Their latest business venture is a small bakery.
ex.zh: 他們最新的創業項目是一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Public funding can help young entrepreneurs launch ventures that address environmental problems in their communities.
ex.zh: 公共資金可以幫助年輕創業者開展解決社區環境問題的創業項目。

col: venture an opinion｜冒昧發表意見
words.tip: venture本身不等於風險投資；風險資本是venture capital。

tr: a. 冒險的, 好冒險的, 不顧一切的
def: s disposed to venture or take risks

tr: a. 說實話的, 誠實的, 老實的, 真實的
def: s. habitually speaking the truth
s. precisely accurate

tr: n. 說話老實, 老實, 誠實
def: n. unwillingness to tell lies

tr: a. 用言辭的, 言語的, 口頭的, 逐字的, 動詞的
[醫] 言語的, 口述的
口頭的；非書面的
言語的；與詞語有關的
def: s. communicated in the form of words
a. of or relating to or formed from words in general
a. of or relating to or formed from a verb

ex.en: We made a verbal agreement to share the garden.
ex.zh: 我們口頭約定共用這個花園。

ex.en: Employers should confirm verbal agreements in writing to prevent misunderstandings about working hours and responsibilities.
ex.zh: 僱主應以書面形式確認口頭協議，以防對工作時間和職責產生誤解。

words.tip: verbal也指用詞語表達，不總與written對立。

tr: a. 逐字的, 照字面的
adv. 逐字地
def: r. using exactly the same words

tr: n. 羅嗦, 冗詞, 措辭
def: n. overabundance of words

tr: a. 用字多的, 冗長的, 累贅的
[計] 詳述
def: s using or containing too many words

tr: n. 贅言, 嘮叨, 冗長
def: n an expressive style that uses excessive or empty words

tr: a. 被禁止的
def: s excluded from use or mention

tr: a. 翠綠的, 青翠的, 無經驗的, 不老練的
def: s. characterized by abundance of verdure

tr: n. 裁決, 判決, 判斷性意見, 定論, 結論
[法] 定論, 判斷, 意見
陪審團裁決；裁定
評價；判斷；定論
def: n. (law) the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a judgment
An official court decision about whether someone is guilty.
An opinion or judgment reached after considering something.

ex.en: What is your verdict on my homemade soup?
ex.zh: 你覺得我自己做的湯怎麼樣？

ex.en: A jury should reach its verdict solely on the evidence presented during the trial.
ex.zh: 陪審團應僅依據庭審中呈現的證據作出裁決。

col: a verdict on something｜對某事的評價
words.tip: verdict指裁決；sentence作法律名詞指判處的刑罰。

tr: n. 翠綠, 新綠, 碧綠, 精力旺盛, 新鮮
def: n green foliage
n the lush appearance of flourishing vegetation

tr: n. 邊緣, 邊界, 起始點
vi. 處在邊緣, 接近, 下沉, 趨向
邊緣；臨界點
路邊草地
接近；近乎
def: n. the limit beyond which something happens or changes
n. a grass border along a road
v. border on; come close to

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
ex.zh: 她丟了戒指，幾乎要哭出來了。

ex.en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
ex.zh: 幾種本地物種因棲息地遭到嚴重破壞而瀕臨滅絕。

col: on the verge of extinction｜瀕臨滅絕
on the verge of doing something｜即將做某事
verge on the absurd｜近乎荒謬
words.tip: on the verge of後接名詞或動名詞；動詞常接on。

tr: a. 可核實的, 可證實的
[法] 可檢驗的, 可作證的, 可證實的
def: s. capable of being verified

tr: n. 證實, 查證, 證明屬實
[計] 驗證
核實；驗證
def: n. (law) an affidavit attached to a statement confirming the truth of that statement
The process of checking that something is true or accurate.

ex.en: The website requires identity verification before I can withdraw money.
ex.zh: 這個網站要求先驗證身份，我才能提現。

ex.en: Independent verification of research findings is essential for maintaining public confidence in scientific advice.
ex.zh: 對研究結果進行獨立驗證，對於維持公眾對科學建議的信任至關重要。

words.tip: 常用verification of，表示對身份、事實或結果的核實。

tr: a. 已查清的, 已證實的
def: s. proved to be true

tr: vt. 證明, 查證, 證實, 檢驗, 校驗
[計] 校驗, 檢驗; DOS內部命令:設定寫入磁盤時是否驗證寫入的正確性
核實；查證
def: v. confirm the truth of
v. attach or append a legal verification to (a pleading or petition)
to check that something is true, accurate, or genuine

ex.en: Please verify your address before we send the parcel.
ex.zh: 寄出包裹前，請核實你的地址。

ex.en: Researchers must verify their findings through repeated experiments before presenting them to the wider scientific community.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須通過重複實驗核實發現，才能向更廣泛的科學界公佈。

col: verify someone's identity｜核實某人的身份
verify the accuracy of｜核實……的準確性
words.tip: verify強調核實真偽或準確性，後接名詞或從句。

tr: a. 好像真實的
[法] 貌似真的, 似乎是真的, 很可能的
def: s. appearing to be true or real

tr: a. 名副其實的, 真實的, 確實的, 真的
def: s often used as intensifiers
s not counterfeit or copied

tr: a. 春天的, 和煦的, 青春的
def: a. of or characteristic of or occurring in spring

tr: n. 山坡, 傾斜地帶
a. 精通的, 熟練的
def: n the side or slope of a mountain

tr: a. 多才多藝的, 萬用的, 萬向的
多才多藝的；多用途的
def: s. having great diversity or variety
s. changeable or inconstant
s. competent in many areas and able to turn with ease from one thing to another

ex.en: This versatile pan works well for soups and stir-fries.
ex.zh: 這個多用途鍋做湯、炒菜都很好用。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value versatile graduates who can adapt to different roles and learn new skills.
ex.zh: 僱主越來越重視能適應不同崗位並學習新技能的多面手畢業生。

col: a versatile performer｜多才多藝的表演者
words.tip: 既可形容人多才多藝，也可形容物用途廣泛。

tr: n. 詩, 韻文, 詩句
vt. 用詩表達
vi. 作詩
詩；韻文
詩節；歌詞的一段
def: n. a piece of poetry
n. a line of metrical text
v. compose verses or put into verse

ex.en: We sang the first verse together around the piano.
ex.zh: 我們圍在鋼琴旁，一起唱了第一段歌詞。

ex.en: Studying verse can help language learners recognise rhythm and explore how writers convey complex emotions.
ex.zh: 學習詩歌可以幫助語言學習者辨識韻律，並探索作家如何傳達複雜情感。

words.tip: 泛指韻文時不可數；指某一詩節時可數。

tr: n. 脊椎動物
a. 有椎骨的, 有脊椎的
def: n. animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium
a. having a backbone or spinal column

tr: n. 頂點, 最高點, 頭頂, 天頂
[計] 頂點
def: n. the point of intersection of lines or the point opposite the base of a figure
n. the highest point (of something)

tr: a. 垂直的, 直立的
[醫] 垂直的, 頂的, 頭頂的
垂直的；豎直的
垂直線；豎直位置
def: n. something that is oriented vertically
a. at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
a. relating to or involving all stages of a business from production to distribution

ex.en: The curtains have vertical stripes that make the room look taller.
ex.zh: 窗簾上的豎條紋讓房間顯得更高。

ex.en: Vertical farming could help cities produce fresh vegetables locally while using less land than conventional agricultural methods.
ex.zh: 垂直農業可以幫助城市就地生產新鮮蔬菜，同時比傳統農業方式佔用更少的土地。

words.tip: vertical指豎直方向；horizontal指水平方向。

tr: n. 眩暈, 迷惘
[醫] 眩暈
def: n a reeling sensation; a feeling that you are about to fall

tr: n. 熱情, 氣魄, 神韻, 活力
def: n an energetic style

tr: n. 船, 容器, 脈管
[醫] 管, 脈管, (容)器
船；艦艇
血管；脈管
容器；器皿
def: n. a tube in which a body fluid circulates
n. a craft designed for water transportation
n. an object used as a container (especially for liquids)

ex.en: A large fishing vessel sailed slowly into the harbour.
ex.zh: 一艘大型漁船緩緩駛入港口。

ex.en: Commercial vessels can disturb marine ecosystems through underwater noise, fuel leaks, and the introduction of non-native species.
ex.zh: 商船可能通過水下噪聲、燃油洩漏和引入外來物種干擾海洋生態系統。

words.tip: vessel較正式；blood vessel是“血管”，不是船。

tr: n. 遺蹟, 痕跡, 殘餘, 絲毫, 退化的器官
[醫] 遺蹟, 剩件, 剩餘
def: n an indication that something has been present

tr: a. 殘留的, 遺留的, 退化的
[醫] 遺蹟的, 剩餘的
def: s. not fully developed in mature animals

tr: n. 衣服, 衣裳, 禮服, 法衣, 祭服
def: n. gown (especially ceremonial garments) worn by the clergy

tr: n. 否決權
vt. 否決, 禁止
否決權；否決
否決；禁止
def: n. a vote that blocks a decision
n. the power or right to prohibit or reject a proposed or intended act (especially the power of a chief executive to reject a bill passed by the legislature)
v. vote against; refuse to endorse; refuse to assent

ex.en: The club president used her veto to stop the purchase.
ex.zh: 俱樂部主席行使否決權，叫停了這次購買。

ex.en: Giving every member a veto can protect minority interests but may also delay urgent collective decisions.
ex.zh: 賦予每位成員否決權可以保護少數群體的利益，但也可能拖延緊迫的集體決策。

words.tip: 複數vetoes；動詞過去式vetoed。

tr: vt. 使煩惱, 使苦惱
vi. 煩惱
使煩惱；使惱怒
def: v. subject to prolonged examination, discussion, or deliberation
To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.

ex.en: The constant dripping from the tap began to vex him.
ex.zh: 水龍頭不停滴水，開始讓他心煩。

ex.en: Disagreements over how to fund public transport continue to vex policymakers in many growing cities.
ex.zh: 在許多不斷發展的城市，公共交通資金來源的分歧仍困擾著政策制定者。

col: be vexed by delays｜因延誤而煩惱
words.tip: 較正式的及物動詞，日常多用annoy。

tr: n. 惱怒, 煩惱, 令人惱火的事情
[法] 招人煩惱的事物, 煩惱, 苦悶
def: n anger produced by some annoying irritation
n the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
n something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness

tr: a. 能養活的, 能生長發育的
[醫] 有活力的, 有生機的
可行的；能成功的
能存活的；能發育的
def: s. capable of life or normal growth and development
Able to work successfully in practice.
Able to survive or develop into a living organism.

ex.en: Sharing a flat seems like a viable option.
ex.zh: 合租公寓似乎是個可行的選擇。

ex.en: Public transport must be affordable and reliable to become a viable alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通必須價格合理且運行可靠，才能成為私家車的可行替代選擇。

col: viable seeds｜有發芽能力的種子
words.tip: 主要指方案可行；生物學中指能存活或發育。

tr: n. 振動, 振響, 活力
def: n having the character of a loud deep sound; the quality of being resonant

tr: a. 振動的, 戰慄的, 響亮的, 活躍的
def: s. vigorous and animated
s. of sounds that are strong and resonating
s. of colors that are bright and striking

tr: vi. 振動, 顫動, 激動, 搖擺, 躊躇
vt. 使顫動, 使振動, 使擺動
振動；使振動
def: v. shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: My phone vibrated against the keys in my pocket.
ex.zh: 手機在口袋裡振動，碰得鑰匙直響。

ex.en: Heavy traffic can cause nearby buildings to vibrate, affecting residents' comfort and potentially damaging older structures.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通會使附近建築物振動，影響居民的舒適度，並可能損壞老舊建築。

words.tip: 指快速、小幅度振動，不等於大幅搖擺。

tr: n. 教區牧師, 教堂主持, 代理人
[法] 代表, 代理牧師, 代理主教
def: n. a Roman Catholic priest who acts for another higher-ranking clergyman
n. (Episcopal Church) a clergyman in charge of a chapel
n. (Church of England) a clergyman appointed to act as priest of a parish

tr: a. 代理的, 代用的, 替代的
[醫] 替代的, 錯位的
def: s. experienced at secondhand
s. occurring in an abnormal part of the body instead of the usual site involved in that function
s. suffered or done by one person as a substitute for another

tr: n. 附近, 鄰近, 附近地區, 近處
[法] 附近, 鄰近, 附近地區
附近；周邊地區
def: n. a surrounding or nearby region
The area near a particular place.

ex.en: There are several quiet cafés in the vicinity.
ex.zh: 附近有幾家安靜的咖啡館。

ex.en: Building new housing in the vicinity of railway stations can reduce car dependence and shorten daily commutes.
ex.zh: 在火車站周邊新建住房，可以減少對汽車的依賴並縮短日常通勤時間。

words.tip: 常用in the vicinity of，比near更正式。

tr: a. 邪惡的, 墮落的, 品性不端的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有錯誤的
[醫] 缺點的, 惡的
兇猛的；殘暴的
惡毒的；惡意的
def: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
s having the nature of vice
s bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

ex.en: A vicious dog growled behind the tall metal fence.
ex.zh: 一隻兇猛的狗在高高的金屬圍欄後低吼。

ex.en: Vicious comments on social media can damage young people's confidence and discourage participation in online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒體上的惡毒評論可能損害年輕人的自信，使他們不願參與網上討論。

words.tip: vicious circle指問題互相加劇的“惡性循環”。

tr: n. 變化無常, 變遷, 榮枯, 盛衰
def: n. a variation in circumstances or fortune at different times in your life or in the development of something
n. mutability in life or nature (especially successive alternation from one condition to another)

tr: a. 世事變化的, 變遷的, 有盛衰的
def: a. Full of, or subject to, changes.

tr: vt. 使犧牲, 使受害
[法] 使受害, 使作犧牲, 欺騙
def: v. make a victim of
v. punish unjustly
v. deprive of by deceit

tr: vi. 爭, 競爭, 爭勝
vt. 提出...來競爭, 以...作較量
def: v compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others

tr: n. 警戒, 警覺, 失眠症
[醫] 不眠症, 警醒症
def: n the process of paying close and continuous attention
n vigilant attentiveness

tr: a. 警覺的, 警戒的, 警惕的
[法] 警醒的, 警戒的, 注意的
def: s carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger

tr: a. 精力充沛的, 元氣旺盛的, 茁壯的, 有力的
def: s. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity
s. strong and active physically or mentally

tr: a. 惡劣的, 骯髒的, 低廉的, 卑鄙的
[法] 極壞的, 惡劣的, 卑鄙的
def: s morally reprehensible
s causing or able to cause nausea

tr: vt. 誹謗, 貶低
[法] 詆譭, 中傷, 誹謗
def: v. spread negative information about

tr: a. 壞人似的, 惡棍的, 罪惡的, 極壞的
[法] 歹徒的:邪惡的, 惡的
def: s extremely wicked

tr: vt. 辯護, 證明...無辜, 維護
[法] 辯護, 辯解, 辯明
證明無辜；證明正確
def: v. maintain, uphold, or defend
v. clear of accusation, blame, suspicion, or doubt with supporting proof
To prove someone innocent or show that something was justified.

ex.en: The security footage vindicated the cleaner accused of stealing.
ex.zh: 監控錄像證明了那位被指控偷竊的清潔工是無辜的。

ex.en: The significant decline in road accidents appears to vindicate the council's decision to introduce lower speed limits.
ex.zh: 交通事故顯著減少，似乎證明市政委員會降低限速的決定是正確的。

col: vindicate a decision｜證明決定正確
vindicate an approach｜證明方法正確
feel vindicated｜感到自己得到證明
words.tip: 強調證據或結果證明正確，不只是口頭辯護。

tr: n. 辯護, 證明無辜, 辯明
[法] 辯明, 辯白, 辯護
def: n. the act of vindicating or defending against criticism or censure etc.

tr: a. 有報仇心的, 懷恨的, 懲罰的
[法] 報復的, 有報仇心的, 復仇的
def: s disposed to seek revenge or intended for revenge
s showing malicious ill will and a desire to hurt; motivated by spite

tr: n. 酒, 葡萄收穫(期、量), 釀酒
v. 採葡萄
a. 佳釀的, 古典的, 老式的
def: n. a season's yield of wine from a vineyard
n. the oldness of wines

tr: vt. 違犯, 褻瀆, 違反, 侵犯, 妨礙
[經] 違犯, 違反
違反；違背
侵犯；侵害
def: v. fail to agree with; be in violation of; as of rules or patterns
v. destroy
To act against a law, rule, or agreement.

ex.en: Leaving your car here violates the building's parking rules.
ex.zh: 把車停在這裡違反了這棟樓的停車規定。

ex.en: Collecting personal data without informed consent may violate citizens' privacy and undermine public trust in digital services.
ex.zh: 未經知情同意收集個人數據，可能侵犯公民隱私，並削弱公眾對數字服務的信任。

col: violate someone's privacy｜侵犯某人的隱私
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接法律、協議、權利等賓語。

tr: n. 堇菜, 紫羅蘭
a. 堇菜科的, 紫羅蘭色的
def: n. any of numerous low-growing violas with small flowers
n. a variable color that lies beyond blue in the spectrum

tr: a. 病毒的, 病毒引起的
[醫] 病毒的
def: a. relating to or caused by a virus

tr: a. 男性的
[醫] 男性的, 有男性徵的
有陽剛之氣的；強健的
def: s. characterized by energy and vigor
showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men

ex.en: The sculpture portrays a virile athlete lifting a discus.
ex.zh: 這座雕塑刻畫了一位舉起鐵餅、充滿陽剛之氣的運動員。

ex.en: Advertisements often present a virile male ideal, which may reinforce narrow expectations about men's appearance and behaviour.
ex.zh: 廣告常常展示陽剛的理想男性形象，這可能強化對男性外貌和行為的狹隘期待。

col: virile young man｜強健的年輕男子
words.tip: 不只是“男性的”；強調傳統觀念中的男性力量與活力。

tr: n. 成年, 男性生殖力, 男子氣概, 精力充沛, 雄渾, 剛強有力

v. twist or pull violently or suddenly, especially so as to remove (something) from that to which it is attached or from where it originates

ex.en: She tightened the loose bolt with a wrench.
ex.zh: 她用扳手擰緊了鬆動的螺栓。

ex.en: Leaving a close community can be a real wrench for students who move abroad for university.
ex.zh: 對赴海外上大學的學生來說，離開關係緊密的社區可能十分難捨。

col: wrench something open｜猛力拉開某物
a real wrench｜難以割捨的痛苦
words.tip: 扳手在英式英語中常叫spanner；wrench也可作動詞。

tr: n. 扭, 擰
vt. 奪取, 猛扭, 歪曲, 費力取得
def: v. obtain by seizing forcibly or violently, also metaphorically

tr: a. 可憐的, 不幸的, 卑鄙的
痛苦的；可憐的
惡劣的；糟糕的
def: s of very poor quality or condition
s characterized by physical misery
s very unhappy; full of misery

ex.en: I felt wretched after spending the night coughing.
ex.zh: 咳嗽了一整晚後，我感到十分難受。

ex.en: Families living in wretched housing conditions face greater risks of respiratory illness and other health problems.
ex.zh: 居住條件惡劣的家庭面臨更高的呼吸系統疾病及其他健康問題風險。

words.tip: 開頭w不發音；詞尾-ed在此讀/ɪd/。

tr: n. 扭絞, 擰, 擠
vt. 擰, 絞, 扭, 勒索, 折磨, 使痛苦
vi. 蠕動, 扭動, 絞, 扭, 感到痛苦
擰；絞；榨出
def: v. twist and compress, as if in pain or anguish
v. twist, squeeze, or compress in order to extract liquid
To twist and squeeze something, especially to remove liquid.

ex.en: Wring out the wet towel before hanging it up.
ex.zh: 把溼毛巾擰乾後再掛起來。

ex.en: Where washing machines are unavailable, residents must wring out heavy clothes by hand after washing.
ex.zh: 在沒有洗衣機的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物後必須用手擰乾。

col: wring out a towel｜擰乾毛巾
wring your hands｜焦慮地絞著雙手
wring water from clothes｜擰出衣服裡的水
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為wrung；擰乾常用wring out。

tr: n. 手腕, 腕關節
[醫] 腕
手腕；腕關節
def: n. a joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones
The joint connecting your hand to your arm.

ex.en: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
ex.zh: 她的手腕上戴著一條銀手鍊。

ex.en: Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.
ex.zh: 辦公室員工應調整鍵盤位置，減輕長時間使用電腦時手腕承受的壓力。

words.tip: 開頭的w不發音；手腕是wrist，腳踝是ankle。

def: n. (law) a legal document issued by a court or judicial officer

def: s. obstinately perverse in judgment or opinion

tr: a. 激怒的, 憤怒的
def: s vehemently incensed and condemnatory

tr: a. 製成的, 精細的
work的過去式和過去分詞

v be employed
v have an effect or outcome; often the one desired or expected

tr: a. 扭歪的, 歪曲的, 歪斜的
v. 扭曲, 扭歪

def: s. suffering from xenophobia; having abnormal fear or hatred of the strange or foreign

tr: n. 快艇, 遊艇
vi. 駕遊艇, 乘遊艇
遊艇；帆船
def: n. an expensive vessel propelled by sail or power and used for cruising or racing
v. travel in a yacht
A boat used for pleasure trips or racing.

ex.en: We watched a white yacht sail across the bay.
ex.zh: 我們看著一艘白色帆船駛過海灣。

ex.en: The growing popularity of yacht tourism can generate income for coastal communities but may damage marine habitats.
ex.zh: 遊艇旅遊日益流行，能為沿海社區創造收入，但也可能破壞海洋棲息地。

words.tip: ch不發音；通常指休閒或競賽用船。

tr: v. 猛拉
def: v. pull, or move with a sudden movement

tr: vi. 渴望, 想念, 懷念, 同情
渴望；思念
def: v. have affection for; feel tenderness for
To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

ex.en: After months abroad, she yearned for her mother's cooking.
ex.zh: 在國外待了幾個月後，她十分想念母親做的飯菜。

ex.en: Many urban residents yearn for quieter surroundings, which may explain the growing appeal of rural tourism.
ex.zh: 許多城市居民渴望更安靜的環境，這或許能解釋鄉村旅遊日益增長的吸引力。

words.tip: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表達強烈渴望。

s. lacking stiffness and giving way to pressure
s. tending to give in or surrender or agree

vi. 分成區
[計] 卡片頂部的三行區; 區; 區域
區域；地帶
def: n. a locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features
n. any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude
n. an area or region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
ex.zh: 汽車不得駛入這片安靜的步行區。

ex.en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
ex.zh: 只要有價格合理的公共交通，設立低排放區就能減少空氣汙染。

col: zone land for housing｜將土地劃為住宅用地
words.tip: zone強調特定用途或特徵的區域；area含義更寬泛。
